avatarImageUrl.description: Avatar image reference, trimmed; blank stores no avatar. The product uses a bundled avatar path or a `data:` image URL; the API does not validate the text.

status.description: Lifecycle status, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft (the default), 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Archived. Many runtime features require an Active agent that is not a template.

providerProfileId.description: Identifier of the provider profile the agent uses (see `GET /api/agents/providers`), or null. A profile that does not exist is rejected.

model.description: Model identifier within the provider profile, trimmed; blank uses the profile's default model. A shared (source-managed) profile only accepts the models it publishes, and a local profile only accepts a model that has a price row on the profile.

oneOf.description: Reasoning effort requested for the agent's model, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 Low, 2 Medium, 3 High, 4 ExtraHigh, 5 Max, 6 Minimal; null uses the provider default. A value requires a provider profile and a model whose thinking-effort capability allows it; otherwise the save is rejected. It is stored in `configurationJson` under `modelParameters.reasoningEffort`.

isThinkingEffortOverrideEdited.description: Request-only flag that matters for Ollama provider profiles: true when a null `thinkingEffortOverride` should clear the effort stored in `configurationJson`. When false and the override is null, the stored effort is kept. Reads always return false.

workload.description: Kind of work the agent does, as a JSON integer: 0 General (the default), 1 Management, 2 Hr, 3 Sales, 4 Assistant, 5 Qa, 6 Support, 7 Programming, 8 Spreadsheet, 9 Mail, 10 Research.

chatHistoryMode.description: Where the chat history is kept between turns, as a JSON integer: 0 ProviderDefault (the default), 1 FrameworkManaged, 2 ProviderManaged.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature sent to the model; 0.2 by default. The server does not check its range.

requirePerServiceCallChatHistoryPersiste.description: True to persist the chat history after every model call of a run.

enableBackgroundResponses.description: True to request background (long-running) model responses when the provider supports them.

configurationJson.description: Further configuration as a JSON string containing a JSON object; send back the value as read. On save each typed access setting below replaces its key in this object (`projectStructure`, `processes`, `workspaceTools`, `imageGeneration`, `voiceAccess`, `memory`) and the thinking effort replaces `modelParameters.reasoningEffort`; other keys are kept. Text that is not a JSON object is replaced by an empty object.

isTemplate.description: True to store the agent as a template used to create working agents.

templateKey.description: Canonical key of the agent; blank derives it from `name`. It is normalized to lower-case letters and digits separated by hyphens, must contain a letter or digit and must be unique among all agents and templates, so two agents whose names normalize alike need different explicit keys.

permissions.description: Runtime permissions of the agent's runs. When omitted, the default permissions apply. Its `allowedSecrets` member is ignored on save; send secrets in `allowedSecretReferences`.

allowedSecretReferences.description: Secrets the agent may use; the list replaces the stored one. Entries with the all-zero identifier are dropped and the last entry per secret wins.

projectStructureAccess.description: Project Structure tool access; replaces the stored section, and an omitted object removes the access.

processAccess.description: Processes workspace access; replaces the stored section, and an omitted object removes the access.

workspaceToolAccess.description: Workspace file, command and storage tool access; replaces the stored section, and an omitted object resets it to the default (file reading only).

imageGenerationAccess.description: Image generation tool access; replaces the stored section, and an omitted object removes the access.

voiceAccess.description: Voice settings; replace the stored section, and an omitted object removes them.

memoryAccess.description: Memory provider access; replaces the stored section, and an omitted object removes all memory access. See the schema for the current limitation on provider bindings.

selectedCapabilityIds.description: Identifiers of the catalog capabilities to assign; the list replaces the current assignments. Unknown identifiers are ignored. A kept assignment keeps its proof state; a new one starts with the catalog capability's.

tags.description: Free-form labels; trimmed, blanks dropped and duplicates removed ignoring case.

AgentEditorModel.description: Editable form of a technical agent definition, returned by `GET /api/agents/{agentId}` and accepted by `POST /api/agents` and `PUT /api/agents/by-external-key/{externalNamespace}/{key}`. A save replaces the whole agent with these values: an omitted member takes its default, so send every member as read and change only what you intend to change. The external-key operation additionally requires `id` and `expectedUpdatedAtUtc` to be null, `allowedSecretReferences` and `permissions.allowedSecrets` to be empty, `selectedCapabilityIds` and `tags` to be present, and `configurationJson` to contain no raw secret values. Enum members are JSON integers.

approvalId.description: Opaque identifier of the approval request, issued by the model runtime.

toolName.description: Name of the tool the agent wanted to call.

toolKind.description: Kind of the tool call: `mcp`, `function` or `tool`.

status.description: Decision status, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 Approved, 2 Rejected (including calls rejected because the run was cancelled before they started).

requestedAtUtc.description: When the approval was requested, in UTC.

decidedAtUtc.description: When it was decided, in UTC, or null while pending.

decisionSourceKind.description: Where the decision came from: `chat-session` or `execution-run` (a decision sent for a chat-backed or another run), `auto-approval` (approved automatically), `execution-cancellation` (rejected by the run's cancellation), or an empty string while pending.

AgentExecutionApprovalApiResponse.description: An approval request of an agent execution run and its decision, from the run's approval history.

id.description: Identifier of the artifact record.

artifactKind.description: Kind of artifact, for example `generated-output` (output written or captured by a tool), `converted-document` or `workspace-file`.

displayName.description: Display name, usually the file name.

relativePath.description: Path of the file as recorded by the tool, with forward slashes and no leading slash.

contentType.description: Media type recorded for the file, for example `text/plain`.

producedBy.description: Name of the tool operation that produced or touched the file.

summary.description: Short description of the artifact.

createdAtUtc.description: When the producing tool call completed, in UTC.

AgentExecutionArtifactApiResponse.description: A file that a tool produced or touched during an agent execution run, recorded from the tool's receipt.

value.description: The authority snapshot GUID.

isEmpty.description: Computed: true when `value` is the all-zero GUID.

AgentExecutionAuthorityId.description: Identifier of one resolved execution authority snapshot, as an object whose `value` is a GUID.

id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint.

runState.description: Run state when the checkpoint was saved, as a JSON integer: 0 Idle, 1 Preparing, 2 Running, 3 WaitingOnTool, 4 Persisting, 5 Completed, 6 Failed.

pendingApprovalCount.description: Number of approvals the run was waiting for.

capturedAtUtc.description: When the checkpoint was saved, in UTC.

resumedAtUtc.description: When the run resumed from it, in UTC, or null when it has not resumed.

AgentExecutionCheckpointApiResponse.description: A checkpoint of an agent execution run, saved when the run stopped to wait for tool approvals.

id.description: Identifier of the entry.

createdAtUtc.description: When the entry was written, in UTC.

state.description: Run state reported by the entry, as a JSON integer: 0 Idle (the entry does not change the run state), 1 Preparing, 2 Running, 3 WaitingOnTool, 4 Persisting, 5 Completed, 6 Failed.

phase.description: Short phase label, for example `Approval`; free text for display.

message.description: Human-readable progress message; free text for display.

AgentExecutionLogApiResponse.description: One progress entry of an agent execution run log.

activityOperationId.description: Optional identifier of the activity operation for this command, as a GUID string; when null or omitted the server generates one. It is returned in the `X-CanDoItAll-Agent-Operation-Id` header and can be followed with `GET /api/agents/execution-operations/{operationId}/events/stream`. Use a new identifier for every attempt.

AgentExecutionRecoveryApiRequest.description: Options of an execution-run recovery or cancellation reconciliation command (`POST /api/agents/execution-runs/{executionRunId}/recover`, `POST /api/agents/execution-runs/{executionRunId}/reconcile-cancellation`). An empty object is valid.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent to run; it must exist and must not be the all-zero GUID.

prompt.description: The task or message for the agent; it must not be blank and is trimmed.

chatSessionId.description: Optional identifier of an existing chat session of the agent to add the run to; null or omitted runs without a chat transcript. The session must not be busy with another run or waiting for approvals.

oneOf.description: Optional origin labels of the run (source, correlation, requester), stored with the run and usable as search filters. Null or omitted records a manual run.

autoApprovePendingToolCalls.description: True to run tool calls that would need approval without asking, including approvals raised later in this run. False (the default) stops the run for approval.

oneOf.description: Optional JSON Schema the model's final answer must satisfy; null or omitted returns free text only.

inputAttachmentPaths.description: Optional images to show the model: paths of at most 8 files (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif or .webp, each up to 10 MiB) inside the workspace or a registered external folder, typically staged with `POST /api/agents/attachments/images`. Null or omitted means none.

activityOperationId.description: Optional identifier of the activity operation for this command, as a GUID string; when null or omitted the server generates one. It is returned in the `X-CanDoItAll-Agent-Operation-Id` header and can be followed with `GET /api/agents/execution-operations/{operationId}/events/stream`. It is not an idempotency key: use a new identifier for every attempt.

AgentExecutionRunApiRequest.description: Request to start an agent execution run for the agent named in the body, sent to `POST /api/agents/execution-runs` and to its streaming variant `POST /api/agents/execution-runs/stream`.

id.description: Identifier of the execution run.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent that runs.

chatSessionId.description: Identifier of the chat session the run belongs to, or null for a run without one.

title.description: Title of the run: the chat session title for chat-backed runs, otherwise the prompt cut to 45 characters followed by `...` when longer than 48 characters.

providerName.description: Name of the provider profile the run uses.

model.description: Model identifier taken from the agent when the run started; may be empty.

state.description: Current state, as a JSON integer: 0 Idle, 1 Preparing, 2 Running, 3 WaitingOnTool (stopped until the pending approvals are decided), 4 Persisting, 5 Completed, 6 Failed (also for cancelled runs, whose outcome is 2 Cancelled).

oneOf.description: Final outcome, as a JSON integer, or null while the run is active or waiting: 0 Succeeded, 1 Failed, 2 Cancelled.

createdAtUtc.description: When the run was created, in UTC.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the run last changed, in UTC.

startedAtUtc.description: When the run started, in UTC, or null.

completedAtUtc.description: When the run finished, in UTC, or null while it is active or waiting.

pendingApprovals.description: Tool calls of the run waiting for an approval decision; empty when none waits.

autoApprovePendingToolCalls.description: True when later approval requests of the run are approved automatically.

revision.description: Change counter of the run: 1 when created and increased with each stored change. Compare values to detect that the run changed between reads; no request accepts it as a precondition.

AgentExecutionRunApiResponse.description: An agent execution run: one invocation of an agent for one prompt, started by a chat message or by `POST /api/agents/execution-runs`. It is distinct from the chat session that may contain it and from any workflow or process run that started it.

oneOf.description: The run's chat session with its transcript, or null for a run without one.

approvals.description: Approval history of the run, including decided approvals.

artifacts.description: Files produced or touched by the run's tool calls.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoints saved while the run waited for approvals.

toolReceipts.description: Audit receipts of the run's tool calls.

usageTotals.description: Totals of the run's model-provider usage.

AgentExecutionRunDetailApiResponse.description: Full record of an agent execution run, returned by `GET /api/agents/execution-runs/{executionRunId}` and `GET /api/agents/{agentId}/execution-runs/{executionRunId}`.

chatSessionId.description: Identifier of the run's chat session, or null for a run without one.

responseText.description: Final text produced by the model in this segment; may be empty, for example while the run waits for approvals.

oneOf.description: The reply added to the chat transcript of a chat-backed run; null for a run without a chat session.

metric.description: Usage and duration of this run segment.

state.description: State of the run when the request returned, as a JSON integer: 5 Completed, 3 WaitingOnTool (decide the pending approvals with `POST /api/agents/execution-runs/{executionRunId}/pending-approvals`) or 6 Failed (the answer did not satisfy the requested JSON Schema, or a changing tool call failed without a later successful attempt).

oneOf.description: Validation result of the requested JSON Schema output, or null when the run requested none or is waiting for approvals.

AgentExecutionRunResultApiResponse.description: Result of starting, continuing or recovering an agent execution run. The request returns when the run completes, ends in a failure recorded on the run, or stops to wait for tool approvals. The streaming variants send the same object as `result` of their `agent.command.completed` event, with enum values written as camel-case strings (for example `waitingOnTool` or `schemaValidationFailed`) instead of the forms described here.

prompt.description: The task or message for the agent; it must not be blank and is trimmed.

chatSessionId.description: Optional identifier of an existing chat session of the agent to add the run to; null or omitted runs without a chat transcript. The session must not be busy with another run or waiting for approvals.

oneOf.description: Optional origin labels of the run (source, correlation, requester), stored with the run and usable as search filters. Null or omitted records a manual run.

autoApprovePendingToolCalls.description: True to run tool calls that would need approval without asking, including approvals raised later in this run. False (the default) stops the run for approval.

oneOf.description: Optional JSON Schema the model's final answer must satisfy; null or omitted returns free text only.

inputAttachmentPaths.description: Optional images to show the model: paths of at most 8 files (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif or .webp, each up to 10 MiB) inside the workspace or a registered external folder, typically staged with `POST /api/agents/attachments/images`. Null or omitted means none.

activityOperationId.description: Optional identifier of the activity operation for this command, as a GUID string; when null or omitted the server generates one. It is returned in the `X-CanDoItAll-Agent-Operation-Id` header. Use a new identifier for every attempt.

AgentExecutionRunStartApiRequest.description: Request to start an agent execution run for the agent in the route, sent to `POST /api/agents/{agentId}/execution-runs` and to its streaming variant `POST /api/agents/{agentId}/execution-runs/stream`.

id.description: Identifier of the receipt.

toolFamily.description: Family of the tool, for example `runtime-provider` (a first-party runtime tool), `workspace-file`, `workspace-process`, `mcp-server` or `agent-tool-trace` (a traced call without its own receipt).

toolName.description: Name of the tool or tool operation.

riskClass.description: Risk label recorded for the call, for example `RuntimeProvider:Mutation` or `ReadOnlyWorkspace`; free text.

approvalMode.description: How approval applied to the call, for example `PolicyEnforced` or `NotRequired`; free text.

isolationGuarantee.description: Description of the isolation boundary the call ran in; free text.

startedAtUtc.description: When the call started, in UTC.

completedAtUtc.description: When the call completed, in UTC.

runtimeToolProviderName.description: Name of the runtime tool provider that owns the tool, or an empty string when there is none.

declaredSideEffectMode.description: Side effect the tool declares, as a JSON integer: 0 Unspecified, 1 NoMutation, 2 ManagedProcessArtifacts (writes managed workspace or process files), 3 ExternalArtifactDestination (acts outside the product, for example external actions or media generation), 4 ProductMutation (changes product data such as processes or project structure).

invocationOutcome.description: Outcome of the call, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (not recorded, as for workspace and MCP receipts), 1 Succeeded, 2 Failed, 3 Cancelled.

effectState.description: What is known about the call's effect, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (not confirmed, or not recorded as for workspace and MCP receipts), 1 None, 2 NotCommitted, 3 Committed.

failureCode.description: Stable failure code reported by the tool, or an empty string.

failureMessage.description: Failure message reported by the tool, or an empty string.

canRetryWithCorrectedInput.description: True when the tool reported that the call may be retried with corrected input.

effectSourceKind.description: Kind of the owner record changed by the call, or an empty string.

effectSourceId.description: Identifier of the owner record changed by the call, or an empty string.

AgentExecutionToolReceiptApiResponse.description: Audit receipt of one tool call made during an agent execution run.

packagePath.description: Absolute path of the ZIP package in the server's file system, inside the workspace's export folder. It can be sent to `POST /api/agents/import` on the same host; it is not a download URL.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was exported, for example the number of chat sessions and memory notes. Do not parse it.

AgentExportResult.description: Result of `GET /api/agents/{agentId}/export`: where the server wrote the new export package.

namespace.description: Namespace of the external identity, normalized to lowercase.

key.description: Key of the external identity, normalized to lowercase.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent bound to the external identity; use it with the other `/api/agents` operations.

configurationVersion.description: Configuration version now recorded for the binding: 64 uppercase hexadecimal digits, a hash of the agent's configuration rather than a counter. The response's `ETag` header carries the same value in quotes; send it as `If-Match` with the next write through this identity.

created.description: True when this write created the binding and a new agent (HTTP 201).

replayed.description: True when this receipt was returned for a repeated request with the same `Idempotency-Key`; nothing was written again.

archived.description: True when the bound agent is archived after this write.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes, for example that the requested configuration already matched the stored agent and nothing was changed. Their wording can change.

AgentExternalProvisioningReceipt.description: Receipt of an external-key provisioning write (`PUT` or `DELETE` on `/api/agents/by-external-key/{externalNamespace}/{key}`): the external identity, the agent bound to it and the configuration version to send as `If-Match` with the next write. A replayed request returns the receipt stored by the original write.

namespace.description: Namespace of the external identity, normalized to lowercase.

key.description: Key of the external identity, normalized to lowercase.

agentId.description: Identifier of the bound agent; use it with the other `/api/agents` operations.

configurationVersion.description: Configuration version recorded for the binding by the last provisioning, archive or package import through this identity: 64 uppercase hexadecimal digits. Changes made to the agent through other operations do not update it. Send it as `If-Match` to update or archive through this identity; the `ETag` header carries the same value.

isArchived.description: True when the last write through this identity left the agent archived: a `DELETE`, or a `PUT` or package import of an archived agent. Archiving the agent through other operations does not change it.

updatedAtUtc.description: Instant of the last write to the binding: the provisioning or archive time, or for a package import the imported agent's revision.

AgentExternalProvisioningResource.description: An external identity binding as read by `GET /api/agents/by-external-key/{externalNamespace}/{key}`: which agent the caller-defined namespace and key point to, and the configuration version recorded by the last write through this identity.

AgentFinalizerMode.description: How a typed final answer must be submitted, as a string: `Disabled` (no finalizer tool), `Shadow` (the finalizer tool is offered and its result checked without failing the run), `Required` (the answer must be submitted through the finalizer tool; otherwise the run fails unless the policy allows recovery).

oneOf.description: The image to store (required): a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file of at most 10 MiB (10485760 bytes), recognized by its file name extension (`.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif` or `.webp`). A part content type, when sent, must match the extension.

AgentImageAttachmentUploadRequest.description: Multipart form of an agent image attachment upload: exactly one file part named `file`.

canGenerateImages.description: Adds the image generation tool to the agent's runs.

preferredProviderProfileId.description: Provider profile used for image generation when a tool call names none, or null for the default image provider. It is a default, not a restriction, and the provider's purpose is checked only when the tool runs. The server clears it when `canGenerateImages` is false or the value is the all-zero GUID.

defaultModel.description: Model used for image generation when a tool call names none; trimmed, and empty when `canGenerateImages` is false. It is checked against the provider only when the tool runs.

canStoreImagesAsProjectAssets.description: Allows the image generation tool to prepare generated images as Project Structure assets. It grants no Project Structure write access of its own and is kept even when `canGenerateImages` is false.

AgentImageGenerationAccessSettings.description: Image generation access of an agent, the `imageGenerationAccess` member of the agent editor form, stored in the agent's `configurationJson` under `imageGeneration`. A save replaces that section, and an omitted or empty object removes it. The runtime image generation tool also needs the agent's `canUseTools` permission and, by default, approval of each call.

packagePath.description: Path of the ZIP package in the server's file system, typically the `packagePath` returned by `GET /api/agents/{agentId}/export` on the same host. A relative path is resolved against the server process's working directory. It is not a client file; to upload a package use `POST /api/agents/import-package`.

AgentImportApiRequest.description: Location of an agent export package to import with `POST /api/agents/import`.

kind.description: Contract kind; must be `json-schema`.

name.description: Name of the output: a letter followed by at most 63 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

schema.description: The JSON Schema, a JSON object of at most 64 KiB (UTF-8) with at most 16 nesting levels, 512 schema nodes and 128 properties per object; the root must declare type `object`. Supported keywords: `$schema`, `$id`, `title`, `description`, `type`, `properties`, `required`, `additionalProperties`, `items`, `enum` (1 to 128 values), `const`, `minimum`, `maximum`, `exclusiveMinimum`, `exclusiveMaximum`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `pattern` (at most 256 characters), `minItems`, `maxItems`, `uniqueItems`, `minProperties` and `maxProperties`. Supported types: `object`, `array`, `string`, `number`, `integer`, `boolean` and `null`.

strict.description: True (the default) requires every object schema to set `additionalProperties` to false and to list every declared property in `required`; use a type that includes `null` for optional values.

AgentJsonSchemaOutputContract.description: JSON Schema that the final answer of an agent execution run must satisfy, sent as `structuredOutput` when a run is started. The contract is checked before the run starts; an unsupported contract is rejected with HTTP 400 and an `agents.structured-output-*` code. When the run finishes, the answer is validated and the result is returned as `structuredOutput` of the run result.

AgentJsonSchemaOutputValidationStatus.description: Result of validating a model answer against a JSON Schema output contract, as a string: `Valid`, `ProviderRefusal` (the model refused), `MalformedJson` (not one complete JSON value, or larger than 1 MiB) or `SchemaValidationFailed`. Server-sent event streams write it as camel-case text, for example `schemaValidationFailed`.

AgentLifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a technical agent definition, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Archived. Many runtime features, such as the first-party runtime tools, run recovery and process steps, require an Active agent that is not a template, and Suspended or Archived agents cannot take part in handoffs.

invocationMode.description: When the memory providers are queried, as a JSON integer: 0 Disabled (the default; never, and a `/mem:` directive fails the run), 1 Automatic (every turn, for bindings included in automatic context), 2 ExplicitDirective (only when the prompt starts with `/mem:{alias}`). Another value is rejected.

canUseMemoryTools.description: Adds the memory query and operation status tools to the agent's runs; kept only when the invocation mode is 1 Automatic, otherwise saved as false. The tools also need the agent's `canUseTools` permission.

canUseContextContributions.description: True when the invocation mode is not 0 Disabled. Computed by the server; ignored in requests.

requireContextContributions.description: True to fail a run when memory context cannot be obtained or comes back empty, instead of continuing without it. Not allowed with invocation mode 0 Disabled.

allowAsyncContextContributions.description: Not supported: always saved as false.

canIngestSources.description: Not supported: always saved as false.

oneOf.description: Provider instance the memory tools use first when a tool call names none, or null. It must be bound and, when `allowedProviderInstanceIds` is not empty, listed there. Automatic context does not use it.
Provider instance the memory tools fall back to after the preferred provider and matching assignments, or null. Same constraints as `preferredProviderInstanceId`.

allowedProviderInstanceIds.description: Provider instances the agent may use; empty means every bound provider. Duplicates (ignoring case) are removed and the list is sorted. Every binding and assignment must name an allowed provider.

providerBindings.description: Memory providers bound to the agent, in query order. Aliases and provider instances must each be unique. Known limitation: a save that contains bindings is currently rejected with HTTP 400, because the alias object cannot be read from requests.

allowedCapabilityIds.description: Memory protocol capabilities the agent may use, for example `context.query.sync`, `context.query.async` or `operations.status`; empty means all. A capability cannot be both allowed and denied.

deniedCapabilityIds.description: Memory protocol capabilities the agent may not use; a denial wins over the allowed list.

allowedSourceScopes.description: Source scopes passed to the memory providers with each query, as JSON integers: 0 Workspace, 1 Project, 2 Process, 3 Workflow, 4 Agent, 5 Crm, 6 Resource, 7 Manual. Duplicates are removed. Values are not validated on save and an undefined value makes later reads and runs of the agent fail, so send only these values. Scope 5 Crm is also required by the CRM planning tools and some HR tools.

providerAssignments.description: Rules that select a bound provider for the memory tools by run context. Each scope and key pair may appear once, and each rule's provider must be bound and allowed.

AgentMemoryAccessSettings.description: Memory provider access of an agent, the `memoryAccess` member of the agent editor form, stored in the agent's `configurationJson` under `memory`. It configures the memory providers managed through `/api/memory-providers`; it is unrelated to the workspace memory notes of `/api/agents/{agentId}/memory`. A save validates and replaces the whole section (invalid values are rejected with HTTP 400), and an omitted object removes all memory access. Known limitation: `providerBindings` cannot currently be sent back, so an agent that has bindings cannot be saved through this API without losing its memory access.

AgentMemoryInvocationMode.description: When an agent's memory providers are queried, as a JSON integer: 0 Disabled (never; a prompt that starts with a `/mem:` directive fails the run), 1 Automatic (every turn queries the bindings included in automatic context), 2 ExplicitDirective (only when the prompt starts with `/mem:{alias}`; the directive is removed from the prompt).

value.description: The alias text, lower-case; for example `project-notes`.

AgentMemoryProviderAlias.description: Short name of a memory provider binding, used in `/mem:{alias}` prompt directives. Serialized as an object whose `value` member holds the alias: lower-case, at most 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit and containing only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. The server currently cannot read this object from a request (its value arrives empty), so a save that includes memory provider bindings is rejected with HTTP 400.

scope.description: What `key` is compared with, as a JSON integer: 0 Agent (the agent's own identifier), 1 AgentRole (the name of the agent's workload, for example `Programming`), 2 Workflow and 3 WorkflowNode (the run's source identifier), 4 Process (the process run identifier). Another value is rejected.

key.description: Value compared, ignoring case, with the run context selected by `scope`. Trimmed; must not be blank.

providerInstanceId.description: Memory provider instance to use when the rule matches, serialized as an object whose `value` member holds the instance identifier; it must be bound and allowed for the agent.

AgentMemoryProviderAssignmentSetting.description: Rule that selects a bound memory provider for an agent's memory tools by run context, one entry of `memoryAccess.providerAssignments`. Rules are tried by scope in the order WorkflowNode, Workflow, Process, Agent, AgentRole. Each scope and key pair may appear once.

alias.description: Short name of the binding, unique per agent (ignoring case), serialized as `{ "value": "project-notes" }`. Returned by reads but currently not readable from requests, so a save containing bindings is rejected with HTTP 400.

providerInstanceId.description: Memory provider instance to query, serialized as an object whose `value` member holds the instance identifier; an instance managed through `/api/memory-providers`. Each instance may be bound once per agent.

includeInAutomaticContext.description: True (the default) to query this provider on every turn when the invocation mode is 1 Automatic.

requirement.description: Whether the provider must answer, as a JSON integer: 0 Optional (the default; a failure is tolerated), 1 Required (a failure fails the run). Another value is rejected.

AgentMemoryProviderBindingSetting.description: Memory provider bound to an agent, one entry of `memoryAccess.providerBindings`. The binding order is the order in which providers are queried and their context is presented.

AgentMemoryProviderRequirement.description: Whether a bound memory provider must answer, as a JSON integer: 0 Optional (a failure of the provider is tolerated), 1 Required (a failure of the provider fails the run).

id.description: Identifier of the note, used by `DELETE /api/agents/memory/{memoryId}`.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent the note belongs to.

kind.description: Category of the note, as a JSON integer: 0 Fact, 1 Preference, 2 Context, 3 FollowUp, 4 Architecture.

source.description: Free-text origin of the note, for example `manual`.

importance.description: Caller-assigned importance, as saved; the server applies no range.

metadataJson.description: Optional metadata as a JSON string containing JSON, as saved; may be empty.

createdAtUtc.description: Instant, with offset, at which the note was first saved.

AgentMemoryRecord.description: Stored workspace memory note of an agent, returned by `GET /api/agents/{agentId}/memory`. Notes are kept in the agent catalog; they are not injected into agent runs and are separate from memory providers. Deleting the agent deletes its notes.

oneOf.description: The agent package (required, not empty): a ZIP archive as produced by the agent export, at most 32 MiB (33554432 bytes).

mode.description: Import mode (required), case-insensitive: `create` (add the packaged agent under its own identifier, with its history), `replace-exact-version` (replace the existing agent with that identifier and its history; requires `expectedAgentVersion`) or `clone` (add only the definition, under a new identifier).

externalKey.description: Key of the external identity to bind to the imported agent (required): after trimming and lowering, 1 to 100 characters of lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

externalNamespace.description: Namespace of that external identity, in the same format as `externalKey`; `package-import` when omitted.

expectedPackageSha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the package file, 64 hexadecimal digits in any case. When set, a package with a different hash is rejected (`agent-package.hash-mismatch`).

expectedAgentVersion.description: Current revision of the agent to replace, an instant with offset. Required for `replace-exact-version` and not used as a precondition by the other modes. Send the `expectedUpdatedAtUtc` value returned by `GET /api/agents/{agentId}`, or the `importedVersion` of the previous import receipt, unchanged; it must equal the stored revision exactly (`agent-package.version-conflict`, HTTP 412).

AgentPackageImportApiForm.description: Multipart form of an agent package import: the package file part and text fields that choose the import mode, the external identity to bind and optional preconditions.

AgentPackageImportMode.description: How an agent package import applies the packaged agent, as a JSON integer in the import receipt: 0 Create (added under the packaged identifier with its history), 1 ReplaceExactVersion (replaced the existing agent with that identifier and its history), 2 Clone (added only the definition under a new identifier). The import request itself names the mode with the text values `create`, `replace-exact-version` and `clone`.

agentId.description: Identifier of the resulting agent: the packaged identifier for `create` and `replace-exact-version`, a new identifier for `clone`.

mode.description: Mode that was applied, as a JSON integer: 0 Create, 1 ReplaceExactVersion, 2 Clone.

externalKey.description: Key of the external identity now bound to the agent, normalized to lowercase; use it with `externalNamespace` in `GET /api/agents/by-external-key/{externalNamespace}/{key}`.

packageSha256.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded package file as 64 uppercase hexadecimal digits.

packageSchemaVersion.description: Schema version declared by the package manifest; currently always 1.0.

importedVersion.description: Revision of the resulting agent as an ISO 8601 instant with seven fractional digits. Send it unchanged as `expectedAgentVersion` to replace this agent later with `replace-exact-version`.

configurationSha256.description: Configuration version of the resulting agent, 64 uppercase hexadecimal digits; it is also recorded on the external identity binding as its `configurationVersion`.

unresolvedPrerequisites.description: Package references that could not be matched in this workspace and were dropped, sorted: `provider:` followed by the packaged provider profile identifier, or `capability:` followed by the capability kind name and key (for example `capability:Tool:crm-lookup`). Empty when everything was resolved.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes about the import, for example that secret references were removed or that a clone copies no history. Their wording can change.

replayed.description: True when this receipt was returned for a repeated request with the same `Idempotency-Key`; nothing was imported again.

externalNamespace.description: Namespace of the external identity now bound to the agent: the `externalNamespace` sent with the import, normalized to lowercase, or `package-import` when none was sent.

AgentPackageImportReceipt.description: Receipt of an agent package import, returned by `POST /api/agents/import-package`: the resulting agent, the external identity bound to it, the imported package and what could not be resolved. A replayed request returns the receipt stored by the original import.

approvalId.description: Opaque identifier of the approval request, issued by the model runtime; copy it exactly into a decision.

toolName.description: Name of the tool the agent wants to call.

toolKind.description: Kind of the tool call: `mcp` (a tool of an MCP server), `function` (a function tool) or `tool` (another kind of tool call).

AgentPendingApprovalApiResponse.description: Tool call of an agent execution run that waits for an approval decision. Decide it with `POST /api/agents/execution-runs/{executionRunId}/pending-approvals`; the run's approval history, including decided approvals, is listed by `GET /api/agents/execution-runs/{executionRunId}/approvals`.

canUseTools.description: Master switch for tools: when false, runs of the agent receive no workspace, runtime provider, MCP or agent-to-agent tools.

canAskOtherAgents.description: Allows the agent-to-agent (A2A) remote agent tools.

canEscalateToHuman.description: Stored and shown; no runtime behavior depends on it.

canObserveOtherAgents.description: Allows the agent to be chosen as a process-run manager or as an HR review manager.

canScheduleWork.description: Allows the scheduler tools and workflow scheduling.

requiresApprovalForExternalCalls.description: True to require approval of each MCP and agent-to-agent tool call.

autoApproveExternalCallsByDefault.description: True to approve pending tool calls of the agent's chat runs automatically, as if the chat session's automatic approval were on. False by default.

allowedSecrets.description: Secrets the agent may use. In an agent save this member is ignored and replaced by the editor form's `allowedSecretReferences`; reads return the stored list.

AgentPermissionsPolicy.description: Runtime permissions of an agent: which kinds of tools and interactions its runs may use. These are agent capability controls, not HTTP permissions. When the whole object is omitted from an agent save, the defaults apply (tools, asking other agents and escalation allowed, approval required for external calls); an object with omitted members sets those members to false. Workflow LLM call components carry the same object; it is stored and returned with the component, but workflow execution does not apply it.

canRead.description: Offers the agent for reading processes in the Processes workspace chat.

canWrite.description: Offers the agent with write access in the Processes workspace chat; the server also stores `canRead` as true. In that chat, pending tool calls of such an agent are approved automatically for the process in scope.

allowAllDefinitions.description: True to apply the access to every process definition.

allowedDefinitionIds.description: Identifiers of the process definitions the access applies to when `allowAllDefinitions` is false. The server drops all-zero identifiers and duplicates and sorts the list; it does not check that the definitions exist.

AgentProcessAccessSettings.description: Process access of an agent, the `processAccess` member of the agent editor form, stored in the agent's `configurationJson` under `processes`. A save replaces that section, and an omitted or empty object removes it. It decides whether and at which level the agent is offered in the Processes workspace chat; it attaches no runtime tools and is not an HTTP permission.

canRead.description: Allows the Project Structure read tools for the permitted projects. The server stores true whenever any other flag is true or a project is listed.

canWrite.description: Allows every Project Structure write tool, including changes to task nodes, in the permitted projects. A write also needs a live lifetime binding of the project unless `allowAllProjects` is true.

canWriteNonTaskStructure.description: Allows structure writes that do not change canonical task nodes; tools that need full structure write, such as the structure import, stay unavailable unless `canWrite` is also true.

canWriteTasks.description: Adds the canonical task tools (task create, task update and task resource attach) for the permitted projects.

canCreateProjects.description: Adds the tool that creates standalone projects.

canCreateSubprojects.description: Adds the tool that creates a subproject under a parent project. Linking existing projects as subprojects and moving nodes into a new subproject also need `canWrite`.

allowAllProjects.description: True to permit every project, including projects created later, without lifetime bindings; the server then clears `allowedProjectIds` and `allowedProjectLifetimes`. It is ignored in governed process runs.

allowedProjectIds.description: Identifiers of the permitted projects when `allowAllProjects` is false. The server drops all-zero identifiers and duplicates and sorts the list. A project added here for the first time must exist (or be reserved for creation by this agent); otherwise the save is rejected. The server binds a newly added existing project to its current lifetime automatically.

allowedProjectLifetimes.description: Server-maintained bindings of permitted projects to the project lifetimes they apply to; writes need a live binding. Send back the list as read. On save the list is merged with the bindings already stored and limited to `allowedProjectIds`; a binding the agent did not have must name the project's current live lifetime, and omitting stored bindings of a still permitted project does not remove them.

AgentProjectStructureAccessSettings.description: Project Structure access of an agent, the `projectStructureAccess` member of the agent editor form. It is stored in the agent's `configurationJson` under `projectStructure`; a save replaces that section with these values, and an omitted object or one with every flag false and no project removes it. The flags decide which Project Structure runtime tools an agent run can receive; the run still needs the agent's `canUseTools` permission, a project-scoped run context and the approval policy. They are not HTTP permissions.

databaseProfileId.description: Identifier of the database profile that holds the project.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project; it must also appear in `allowedProjectIds`.

lifetimeId.description: Identifier of the project lifetime (incarnation) the access applies to. It is not exposed by the Projects API; take it from a previous agent read.

AgentProjectStructureLifetime.description: Binding of an agent's Project Structure access to one incarnation (lifetime) of a project in one database profile. A project that is deleted and recreated gets a new lifetime, so an old binding no longer admits writes to it. The server creates and removes these bindings; clients send them back unchanged. All three identifiers are required and must not be the all-zero GUID.

dispatchId.description: Identifier of the provider request within the run.

state.description: State of the request, as a JSON integer: 0 Started (sent; no response was recorded), 1 ResponseAdmitted (the provider's response was recorded), 2 CancelledUnreconciled (cancelled after sending; the provider may have run the approved calls).

AgentProviderDispatchOutcomeApiResponse.description: State of one model-provider request that carried approvals of tool calls the provider runs itself.

AgentProviderFailureCategory.description: Category of a model-provider failure, as a camel-case string: `quotaOrBilling` (the provider reported no remaining quota or credit, or blocked billing), `rateLimit` (the provider throttled the request), `requestCompatibility` (an OpenAI Chat Completions provider rejected reasoning effort combined with function tools), `providerConfiguration` (the provider profile failed its readiness validation, or a shared provider source rejected the connection's credential) or `providerError` (any other provider failure).

observationCount.description: Number of usage observations of the run.

knownObservationCount.description: Observations whose token usage is known (reported by the provider or taken from the segment metric); the token sums below cover only these.

inputTokens.description: Sum of input tokens over the known observations.

cachedInputTokens.description: Sum of cached input tokens over the known observations.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Sum of prompt-cache write tokens over the known observations; 0 when providers do not report them.

outputTokens.description: Sum of output tokens over the known observations.

reasoningTokens.description: Sum of reasoning tokens over the known observations.

totalTokens.description: Sum of total tokens over the known observations.

toolCallCount.description: Sum of tool calls over the known observations.

knownCostObservationCount.description: Observations with a provider-reported or calculated cost, including costs estimated from the segment metric.

knownCostUsd.description: Sum of the known costs in US dollars, rounded to 6 decimal places; a lower bound when `unknownCostObservationCount` is not 0.

AgentProviderUsageTotalsApiResponse.description: Totals over the model-provider usage observations recorded for an agent execution run.

AgentReasoningEffortLevel.description: Reasoning (thinking) effort requested from a model. In the agent and provider operations it is a JSON integer: 0 None (thinking disabled), 1 Low, 2 Medium, 3 High, 4 ExtraHigh, 5 Max, 6 Minimal; by effort the order is None, Minimal, Low, Medium, High, ExtraHigh, Max. LLM Chats definitions, editors, mutation requests and model options use camel-case text instead (`none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `extraHigh`, `max`, `minimal`; read ignoring case), while LLM Chats invocation attempts use the integer form. Which levels a model accepts is given by its thinking-effort capability; for models with an on/off thinking switch, None turns thinking off and Medium turns it on.

classification.description: Classification of the candidate, as a JSON string: `StrongFit`, `Suitable`, `NeedsTraining`, `NotSuitable` or `Inconclusive` (the integers 1 to 5 are also accepted).

confidence.description: Confidence in the classification as a number from 0 through 1 inclusive (`agent-recruiting.analysis-confidence-invalid` otherwise).

summary.description: Evidence-based summary of the analysis, 1 to 4000 characters, stored trimmed.

proposedNextStep.description: Proposed next step for the candidate, as a JSON string: `Advance`, `RequestHumanReview`, `AssignTraining`, `Reassess`, `Hold` or `Reject` (the integers 1 to 6 are also accepted).

strengths.description: Observed strengths: at most 20 entries, each non-blank and at most 500 characters, stored trimmed (`agent-recruiting.analysis-items-invalid` otherwise). Send an empty array when there are none; null is rejected.

gaps.description: Observed gaps, with the same limits as `strengths`.

AgentRecruitingAssessmentAnalysis.description: Structured analysis of an agent recruiting attempt for human reviewers: a classification, a confidence, a summary, a proposed next step and the observed strengths and gaps. The caller supplies it; it is validated and stored but affects neither completeness nor readiness.

AgentRecruitingAssessmentClassification.description: Classification of the candidate in an agent recruiting analysis, as a JSON string: `StrongFit`, `Suitable`, `NeedsTraining`, `NotSuitable` or `Inconclusive`. It is a label chosen by whoever recorded the analysis; the server stores it for reviewers and does not interpret it. Requests may also send the integers 1 to 5 in that order; other integers are rejected.

id.description: Identifier of the attempt, issued by the server. Human reviews refer to it as `attemptId`.

interviewId.description: Identifier of the interview the attempt belongs to.

sequence.description: Position of the attempt in its interview: 1 for the first, increasing by one.

target.description: The run whose result the attempt records.

challengeKey.description: Caller-defined key of the challenge the candidate was given, stored trimmed.

challengeVersion.description: Caller-defined version of that challenge, stored trimmed.

rubricVersion.description: Version of the rubric used to evaluate the attempt, stored trimmed.

inputHash.description: SHA-256 of the challenge input as `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or an empty string when none was supplied (the attempt is then incomplete). Stored as supplied; the server does not recompute it.

outputHash.description: SHA-256 of the candidate's output, in the same form as `inputHash`.

structuredOutputContractKey.description: Key of the structured-output contract the candidate's output had to satisfy, or an empty string when none applied.

structuredOutputSchemaHash.description: SHA-256 of that contract's schema, in the same form as `inputHash`, or an empty string.

structuredOutputValidationStatus.description: Validation status reported for the structured output, as supplied and trimmed (for example `succeeded`), or an empty string.

oneOf.description: Automated evaluation recorded with the attempt, or null when none was supplied.

completeness.description: Whether the attempt carries all evidence that readiness requires, as a JSON string: `Complete` or `Incomplete` (see `missingEvidence`). Derived when the attempt was appended.

missingEvidence.description: Names of the missing evidence, empty when complete: `terminal-execution-target` (the target run had not finished), `input-hash`, `output-hash`, `automated-evaluation`, `evaluator-agent-id`, `evaluator-provider-profile-id`, `evaluator-model`, `evaluation-timestamp` and `successful-structured-output-validation` (a contract key was given but the validation status is not `succeeded`).

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant at which the server recorded the attempt.

oneOf.description: Structured analysis recorded with the attempt, or null when none was supplied.

AgentRecruitingAttempt.description: One recorded attempt of an agent recruiting interview: the run whose result is assessed, the challenge and rubric used, integrity hashes, the automated evaluation and optional analysis, and the evidence completeness that the server derived when the attempt was appended. Attempts are append-only and never change after they are recorded.

sequence.description: Position of the attempt within its own interview, starting at 1.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant at which the attempt was recorded.

completeness.description: Whether the attempt carried all evidence that readiness requires, as a JSON string: `Complete` or `Incomplete`.

oneOf.description: Decision of the attempt's automated evaluation, as a JSON string: `Passed`, `Failed` or `NeedsHumanReview`; null when the attempt has no evaluation.

score.description: Score of the automated evaluation from 0 through 100; null when none was recorded.

oneOf.description: Decision of the latest human review of the attempt, as a JSON string: `Approved` or `Rejected`; null when the attempt has not been reviewed.

AgentRecruitingAttemptComparison.description: Summary of one attempt in a candidate's readiness history. The history covers every attempt of the candidate's interviews in scope, including attempts for earlier configurations.

AgentRecruitingAutomatedDecision.description: Outcome of the automated evaluation recorded with an agent recruiting attempt, as a JSON string: `Passed` (the evaluator accepted the attempt; readiness requires it), `Failed` (the evaluator rejected the attempt) or `NeedsHumanReview` (the evaluator left the decision to a human). The caller supplies it; the server does not evaluate attempts. Requests may also send the integers 0, 1 and 2.

decision.description: Outcome of the evaluation, as a JSON string: `Passed`, `Failed` or `NeedsHumanReview` (the integers 0, 1 and 2 are also accepted). Only `Passed` can make the candidate ready.

score.description: Score from 0 through 100 inclusive, or null when the evaluator produced none; other values are rejected with `agent-recruiting.score-invalid`. It does not affect readiness.

evaluatorAgentId.description: Identifier of the agent that performed the evaluation. When set it must exist in the current workspace (`agent-recruiting.evaluator-agent-not-found`); null leaves the attempt incomplete (`evaluator-agent-id`).

providerProfileId.description: Identifier of the workspace provider profile the evaluator used. When set it must exist in the current workspace (`agent-recruiting.evaluator-provider-not-found`); null leaves the attempt incomplete (`evaluator-provider-profile-id`).

model.description: Model the evaluator used, at most 200 characters, stored trimmed. Empty leaves the attempt incomplete (`evaluator-model`).

rubricVersion.description: Rubric version the evaluation applied, 1 to 100 characters. It must equal the attempt's `rubricVersion` exactly (`agent-recruiting.rubric-version-conflict`).

findings.description: Findings of the evaluator as free text, stored trimmed without blank entries or duplicates; null is stored as an empty list.

evaluatedAtUtc.description: Instant at which the evaluation was produced, with offset, stored as sent. The default value `0001-01-01T00:00:00+00:00` leaves the attempt incomplete (`evaluation-timestamp`).

AgentRecruitingAutomatedEvaluation.description: Automated evaluation of an agent recruiting attempt and the provenance of the evaluator that produced it. The caller records it with the attempt; the server checks its format and references but does not rerun it. Without an evaluator agent, provider profile, model or evaluation time the attempt is stored as incomplete.

currentConfigurationVersion.description: The candidate's configuration version computed for this read: 64 uppercase hexadecimal digits. Send it as `candidateConfigurationVersion` when creating an interview.

status.description: Readiness, as a JSON string: `Ready`, `NoInterviews`, `IncompleteEvidence`, `AwaitingHumanApproval` or `Rejected`, decided as described for the readiness operation.

activatesAgent.description: Always false: readiness never activates the agent.

requiresSeparateActivationAuthorization.description: Always true: activating the agent requires its own authorization outside agent recruiting.

qualifyingInterviewId.description: Interview of the qualifying attempt when ready; otherwise null.

qualifyingAttemptId.description: The qualifying attempt when ready; otherwise null.

qualifyingReviewId.description: The qualifying human approval when ready; otherwise null.

humanAuthorizationReference.description: Authorization reference of the qualifying approval when ready; otherwise an empty string.

humanAuthorizationEvidenceHash.description: Authorization evidence hash of the qualifying approval when ready; otherwise an empty string.

reasons.description: Human-readable explanations of the status. Their wording can change; branch on `status`.

attemptHistory.description: Every attempt of the candidate's interviews in scope, oldest first, including attempts for earlier configurations.

AgentRecruitingCandidateReadiness.description: Readiness of a candidate agent's current configuration, derived on each read from its agent recruiting evidence. It is evidence for a separate activation decision: reading it never activates or changes the agent.

AgentRecruitingEvidenceCompleteness.description: Whether an agent recruiting attempt carries all evidence that readiness requires, as a JSON string: `Complete` (nothing is missing) or `Incomplete` (the attempt's `missingEvidence` lists what is missing). The server derives it when the attempt is appended; it never changes afterwards.

kind.description: Kind of run that `id` identifies, as a JSON string: `agent-execution-run` (the candidate must be the run's agent), `workflow-run` (the candidate must be the agent of a workflow node that executed in the run) or `process-run` (the candidate must be a recorded participant of the run). The integers 0, 1 and 2 are also accepted.

id.description: Identifier of the run, matching `kind`: the `executionRunId` of an agent execution run from the `/api/agents` execution operations, a workflow run identifier from `/api/workflows` or the run identifier of a process run from the process run operations. Must not be the empty GUID.

AgentRecruitingExecutionTarget.description: The run whose result an agent recruiting attempt records. The run must exist in the current workspace and show participation of the interview's candidate agent, as described for `kind`.

AgentRecruitingHumanDecision.description: Decision of a human reviewer on one agent recruiting attempt, as a JSON string: `Approved` (the reviewer accepts the attempt; it counts for readiness only with an authorization reference and evidence hash) or `Rejected` (the reviewer rejects the attempt; as the latest review of the latest attempt for the current configuration it makes readiness `Rejected`). Requests may also send the integers 0 and 1.

id.description: Identifier of the review, issued by the server.

interviewId.description: Identifier of the interview that contains the reviewed attempt.

decision.description: Decision of the reviewer, as a JSON string: `Approved` or `Rejected`.

reviewerActorId.description: Subject of the bearer token that appended the review (the subject the token was issued for); not a CRM/HR party identifier.

reviewerDisplayName.description: Name of the reviewer from the token's name claim, or the name supplied with the review when the token has none; empty when neither was available.

authorizationReference.description: Caller-supplied reference to the authorization behind an approval, stored trimmed; empty when none was supplied.

authorizationEvidenceHash.description: SHA-256 of the authorization evidence as `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or an empty string. Stored as supplied (format check only).

notes.description: Notes of the reviewer, stored trimmed; empty when none were supplied.

qualifiesForReadiness.description: True only for an approval that carries both an authorization reference and an authorization evidence hash.

missingEvidence.description: What an approval lacks to qualify: `human-authorization-reference` and `human-authorization-evidence-hash`. Always empty for a rejection.

reviewedAtUtc.description: UTC instant at which the server recorded the review.

AgentRecruitingHumanReview.description: One human review of an agent recruiting attempt: the decision, the reviewer identity taken from the authenticated bearer token, the authorization evidence that makes an approval count, and notes. Reviews are append-only; the latest review of an attempt is the one that readiness uses.

id.description: Identifier of the interview, issued by the server; use it in the `/api/agent-recruiting/interviews` routes.

candidateAgentId.description: Identifier of the assessed candidate agent.

candidateConfigurationVersion.description: Configuration version of the candidate when the interview was created: 64 uppercase hexadecimal digits, a hash of the agent's configuration. Readiness counts the interview's attempts only while this equals the candidate's current version (compared case-insensitively).

candidateNameSnapshot.description: Name of the candidate agent when the interview was created.

candidateModelSnapshot.description: Model configured on the candidate agent when the interview was created; may be empty.

purpose.description: What the assessment must establish, as supplied at creation (trimmed).

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant at which the interview was created.

attempts.description: Attempts in append order (by `sequence`); empty for a new interview.

reviews.description: Human reviews in append order; empty for a new interview.

recruitmentApplicationId.description: Identifier of the CRM/HR recruitment application the interview supports, as supplied at creation; null when none. Its existence is not checked.

projectId.description: Identifier of a project the interview relates to, as supplied at creation; null when none. Its existence is not checked.

AgentRecruitingInterview.description: An agent recruiting interview: the assessment of one candidate agent, fenced to the configuration version that was current when it was created, with its append-only attempts and human reviews. Every agent recruiting write returns the whole updated interview. It is not a CRM/HR recruitment interview of a person.

AgentRecruitingProposedNextStep.description: Next step that an agent recruiting analysis proposes for the candidate, as a JSON string: `Advance`, `RequestHumanReview`, `AssignTraining`, `Reassess`, `Hold` or `Reject`. It is a proposal recorded for reviewers; the server does not act on it. Requests may also send the integers 1 to 6 in that order; other integers are rejected.

AgentRecruitingReadinessStatus.description: Readiness of a candidate agent's current configuration, as a JSON string: `Ready` (the latest attempt for the current configuration is complete, passed automated evaluation and has a qualifying human approval), `NoInterviews` (no interview exists for the candidate in scope), `IncompleteEvidence` (no complete attempt exists for the current configuration, or the latest one is incomplete), `AwaitingHumanApproval` (the latest attempt is complete but has no qualifying approval or did not pass automated evaluation) or `Rejected` (the latest review of the latest attempt is a rejection).

AgentRecruitingTargetKind.description: Kind of run whose result an agent recruiting attempt records, as a JSON string: `agent-execution-run` (an agent execution run; the candidate must be the run's agent), `workflow-run` (a workflow run; the candidate must be the agent of a workflow node that executed in the run) or `process-run` (a process run; the candidate must be recorded as a participant of the run). Requests may also send the integers 0, 1 and 2.

id.description: Identifier of the metric.

createdAtUtc.description: When the segment ended, in UTC.

outcome.description: Outcome of the segment, as a JSON integer: 0 Succeeded, 1 Failed, 2 Cancelled. A segment that stopped to wait for tool approvals also records 2 Cancelled.

providerName.description: Name of the provider profile used by the segment.

model.description: Model identifier used by the segment.

durationMs.description: Duration of the segment in milliseconds; at least 1.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens reported by the provider for the segment; 0 when none were reported.

cachedInputTokens.description: Part of `inputTokens` served from the provider's prompt cache; 0 when not reported.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Not recorded for agent execution runs: always 0.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens reported by the provider for the segment; 0 when none were reported.

toolCalls.description: Number of tool calls made in the segment.

costUsd.description: Estimated cost of the segment in US dollars, calculated from the provider profile's configured token prices; 0 when the model has no configured price.

AgentRunMetricApiResponse.description: Usage and duration of one segment of an agent execution run: the first turn and each continuation after an approval decision record one metric each.

isEnabled.description: Whether voice input is transcribed. False by default; while false, every transcription request is rejected.

driverKind.description: Voice driver, as a JSON integer: 0 OpenAi (the only value and the default).

providerProfileId.description: Identifier (GUID) of the provider profile that transcribes the audio, as listed by `GET /api/agents/providers`. Null by default, and an empty GUID counts as null. Transcription fails until the setting names an existing, enabled profile.

model.description: Transcription model name sent to the provider. Defaults to `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`; a blank value falls back to that default when the settings are applied.

language.description: Optional language hint sent with the audio, for example `en`. Empty by default, which sends no hint.

prompt.description: Optional text sent with the audio to guide the transcription, such as names or terms to expect. Empty by default, which sends none.

AgentSpeechToTextSettings.description: Speech-to-text (voice input) settings: whether spoken input is transcribed and which provider profile and model transcribe it.

oneOf.description: The model's answer parsed as JSON, present even when it failed schema validation; null when the answer was not one complete JSON value, was larger than 1 MiB or was a text refusal.

validationStatus.description: Validation status, as a string: `Valid`, `ProviderRefusal` (the model refused), `MalformedJson` (not one complete JSON value, or larger than 1 MiB) or `SchemaValidationFailed`. Any status other than `Valid` ends the run in state 6 Failed.

validationErrors.description: Reasons for a status other than `Valid`, at most 20; empty when valid.

AgentStructuredOutputApiResponse.description: Validation result of the JSON Schema output requested for an agent execution run.

code.description: Stable error code, for example `malformed-json`, `provider-refusal`, `output-too-large`, `type-mismatch` or `required-property-missing`; trimmed and cut to 128 characters.

message.description: Human-readable description; trimmed and cut to 1024 characters.

path.description: JSON path of the failing value in the answer, starting with `$`; trimmed and cut to 512 characters.

AgentStructuredOutputValidationErrorApiR.description: One reason why the model's answer did not satisfy the requested JSON Schema.

id.description: Team identifier, used by the `/api/agents/teams/{teamId}` operations.

name.description: Team name, trimmed and unique among the workspace's teams, ignoring case.

description.description: Free-text description; an empty string when none was given.

agentIds.description: Identifiers of the member agents, ordered by agent name when the members were last saved. Deleting an agent removes it from every team.

createdAtUtc.description: Instant, with offset, at which the team was first saved.

updatedAtUtc.description: Instant, with offset, of the team's last save or member replacement.

icon.description: Name of the team's icon from the supported icon set, for example `groups` (the default), `hub` or `code`. Saving an unsupported name stores `groups`.

AgentTeamDefinition.description: Stored agent team: a named group of agent definitions used to organize agents. Returned by the team reads and by the member replacement operations. A team does not grant capabilities or tools and does not change how its member agents run; an agent can belong to several teams. Teams shipped with the product keep fixed identifiers and are reset to their shipped content whenever the agent catalog is written.

id.description: Identifier of the team. Null or omitted on `POST /api/agents/teams` creates a team with a new identifier; a value replaces that team or creates it with this identifier. `PUT` ignores this member and uses the route identifier. Never send the all-zero identifier: the save reports success but the team is discarded.

name.description: Team name. It is trimmed and must be non-blank and unique among teams, ignoring case.

description.description: Free-text description, trimmed. Empty when omitted.

icon.description: Name of the team's icon, for example `groups`, `hub`, `code` or `security`. A blank or unsupported name is stored as `groups`, which is also the default.

agentIds.description: Identifiers of the member agents; the list replaces the current members. Every identifier must name an existing agent; empty identifiers and duplicates are dropped. An empty list or an omitted member stores a team without members.

AgentTeamEditorModel.description: Editable form of an agent team, returned by `GET /api/agents/teams/{teamId}/editor` and accepted by `POST /api/agents/teams` and `PUT /api/agents/teams/{teamId}`. A save replaces the whole team with these values; there is no concurrency token, so the last save wins.

agentIds.description: Identifiers of every agent that should be a member; agents not listed are removed from the team. Each must name an existing agent; empty identifiers and duplicates are dropped. Always send this member: an empty array, and also an omitted or null list, removes all members.

AgentTeamMembersApiRequest.description: Complete member list of an agent team, sent to `POST` or `PUT /api/agents/teams/{teamId}/members`. It replaces the current members; it does not append.

templateKey.description: Key identifying the new template, normalized to lower-case letters and digits separated by hyphens; it must contain a letter or digit and must not already belong to another agent or template. A blank value falls back to the source agent's name, which normally collides with the source's own key, so send an explicit key such as `support-triage-template`.

AgentTemplateConversionApiRequest.description: Template key of the template to create by `POST /api/agents/{agentId}/convert-to-template`.

isEnabled.description: Whether text can be turned into speech. False by default; while false, every speech request is rejected.

driverKind.description: Voice driver, as a JSON integer: 0 OpenAi (the only value and the default).

providerProfileId.description: Identifier (GUID) of the provider profile that produces the speech, as listed by `GET /api/agents/providers`. Null by default, and an empty GUID counts as null. Speech output fails until the setting names an existing, enabled profile.

model.description: Speech model name sent to the provider. Defaults to `gpt-4o-mini-tts`; a blank value falls back to that default when the settings are applied.

voiceId.description: Default voice name. Defaults to `marin`; the settings screen offers alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, fable, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer, verse, marin and cedar, but the value is not checked against that list. An agent that allows voice mode can prefer another voice.

responseFormat.description: Audio format requested from the provider: `mp3` (the default), `wav`, `opus`, `aac`, `flac` or `pcm`. When the settings are applied the value is lower-cased, and a blank or unknown value becomes `mp3`.

instructions.description: Optional speaking-style instructions sent to the provider, such as tone or pace. Empty by default, which sends none.

AgentTextToSpeechSettings.description: Text-to-speech (voice output) settings: whether replies can be spoken and which provider profile, model, voice and audio format produce the speech.

AgentThinkingEffortCapabilitySource.description: Where a thinking-effort capability comes from, as a JSON integer: 0 Defined (built-in product rules or a shared provider source's catalog), 1 Discovered (reported by the provider, for example during a health check), 2 Configured (set in the provider profile's configuration).

AgentThinkingEffortControlMode.description: How a model's thinking is controlled. Agent and provider operations use a JSON integer: 0 Unspecified (no control; used whenever the status is not Supported), 1 BooleanToggle (thinking on or off, offered as exactly Medium and None), 2 EffortLevels (a choice among effort levels). LLM Chats model options write it as camel-case text instead: `unspecified`, `booleanToggle`, `effortLevels`.

AgentThinkingEffortSupportStatus.description: Whether a model's thinking effort can be set. Agent and provider operations use a JSON integer: 0 Supported (one of the allowed efforts may be set), 1 Unsupported (the model has no configurable thinking; no effort may be set), 2 Unknown (support is not known; no effort may be set). LLM Chats model options write it as camel-case text instead: `supported`, `unsupported`, `unknown`.

sourceKind.description: Kind of the owner, for example `process-step`; at most 128 characters.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the owner; at most 512 characters.

ownerFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the owner's state recorded when the run was admitted.

AgentToolBackgroundSourceBinding.description: Background owner that started an agent execution run without an interactive chat, such as a process step.

value.description: The batch identifier; never the all-zero GUID.

AgentToolBatchId.description: Identifier of a batch of agent tool calls proposed together by the model, as an object whose `value` is a non-empty GUID.

value.description: The intent identifier; never the all-zero GUID.

AgentToolBusinessIntentId.description: Identifier of the business intent of one agent tool proposal, as an object whose `value` is a non-empty GUID.

AgentToolCancellationDisposition.description: How the cancellation of an agent execution run resolved one admitted tool call, as a JSON integer: 0 NotDispatched (never started), 1 NoExternalMutation (a read that changed nothing), 2 ReceiptCommitted (the owner's receipt shows the change was made), 3 CancelledUnreconciled (started, and its effect could not be confirmed).

intentId.description: Identifier of the admitted tool call within the run.

effectState.description: What is known about the call's effect, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (it may or may not have changed something), 1 None (the call changes nothing, for example a read), 2 NotCommitted (no change was made), 3 Committed (the change was made).

oneOf.description: How the cancellation resolved the call, as a JSON integer, or null when the call was not cancelled (for example because it completed before the cancellation): 0 NotDispatched (never started), 1 NoExternalMutation (a read that changed nothing), 2 ReceiptCommitted (the owner's receipt shows the change was made), 3 CancelledUnreconciled (started, and its effect could not be confirmed).

Why that disposition applies, as a JSON integer, or null when the call was not cancelled: 0 NeverDispatched, 1 ReceiptFound, 2 ReceiptNotObserved (the owner reported no receipt), 3 NoReceiptProtocol (the tool offers no receipt lookup), 4 CurrentAccessDenied (the receipt lookup was refused by current access), 5 ReadOnlyInvocation.
Identity of the committed change when `disposition` is 2 ReceiptCommitted; otherwise null.

AgentToolCancellationOutcomeApiResponse.description: Reconciled state of one admitted tool call of a cancelled agent execution run.

AgentToolCancellationReason.description: Why a cancellation disposition applies to a tool call, as a JSON integer: 0 NeverDispatched, 1 ReceiptFound, 2 ReceiptNotObserved (the owner reported no receipt), 3 NoReceiptProtocol (the tool offers no receipt lookup), 4 CurrentAccessDenied (the receipt lookup was refused by current access), 5 ReadOnlyInvocation.

AgentToolEffectState.description: What is known about the effect of one tool call, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (not confirmed or not recorded; the call may have changed something), 1 None (the call changes nothing, for example a read), 2 NotCommitted (no change was made), 3 Committed (the change was made).

AgentToolInvocationOutcome.description: Outcome of one tool call, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (not recorded), 1 Succeeded, 2 Failed, 3 Cancelled.

profileId.description: Identifier of the database profile; never the all-zero GUID.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the database profile's runtime settings at admission.

generation.description: Generation of the host's active database profile at admission.

AgentToolProfileBinding.description: Database profile that an agent tool session was admitted under.

AgentToolProviderDispatchState.description: State of a model-provider request that carried approvals of tool calls the provider runs itself, as a JSON integer: 0 Started (sent; no response was recorded), 1 ResponseAdmitted (the provider's response was recorded), 2 CancelledUnreconciled (cancelled after sending; the provider may have run the approved calls).

value.description: The fingerprint: 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

AgentToolSemanticDigest.description: SHA-256 fingerprint, as an object whose `value` holds 64 lower-case hexadecimal characters.

executionRunId.description: Identifier of the agent execution run; never the all-zero GUID.

chatSessionId.description: Identifier of the chat session of an interactive turn; omitted for a background source.

authorityId.description: Authority snapshot the interactive turn was admitted under; omitted for a background source.

backgroundSource.description: Background owner that started the run; omitted for an interactive turn.

AgentToolSessionReference.description: Agent execution run in which a tool call was proposed: either an interactive turn (with a chat session and an authority snapshot) or a background source such as a process step, never both.

canUseVoiceMode.description: Enables voice mode for this agent in the chat interface, including spoken replies.

preferredVoiceId.description: Text-to-speech voice identifier to use for this agent instead of the global voice; trimmed, and empty when voice mode is off or no preference is set. It is not validated when saved.
