PluginOAuthConnectionStatusItem.description: OAuth state of one plugin connection, returned by `GET /api/plugins/{pluginId}/oauth/status`. It never contains tokens.

PluginOAuthConnectionStatusKind.description: OAuth state of a plugin connection, as a JSON integer: 0 NotConnected (no token is stored, for example after a disconnect), 1 Connected (a token is stored), 2 ReconnectRequired (the token cannot be refreshed or lacks a required scope; authorize again), 3 Error (the provider or the token exchange reported an error).

status.description: OAuth state after the disconnect, as a JSON integer: always 0 (NotConnected) on success. The other values are 1 Connected, 2 ReconnectRequired, 3 Error.

connectionKey.description: Key of the OAuth connection kind declared by the plugin, for example `gmail`.

connectionId.description: Identifier (a GUID string) of an existing connection of this plugin to authorize. Omitted or null: the most recently updated connection with this key is reused, or a new connection is created before the authorization starts.

displayName.description: Display name for a connection created by this request; empty means the connection key.

returnPath.description: Path in this web application to return the browser to after the callback, for example `/plugins` (the default). It must start with a single `/`; any other value is replaced by `/plugins`.

scopes.description: Scopes to request instead of the plugin's default scopes; omitted, null or empty means the defaults. Requested scopes are not checked against the plugin's scopes.

redirectUri.description: Callback address registered with the identity provider, used as given. Omitted: the connection setting `redirectUri`, or else this host's `/api/plugins/oauth/callback` address.

connectionId.description: Identifier of the connection being authorized, possibly created by this request.

authorizationUrl.description: Address of the identity provider's authorization page, including the one-time `state` and, when PKCE is used, the code challenge. Open it in the user's browser; the pending authorization expires after 10 minutes and can be completed once.

redirectUri.description: Callback address used for this authorization.

scopes.description: Scopes requested from the identity provider, sorted and without duplicates.

PluginOAuthStartResponse.description: Result of `POST /api/plugins/{pluginId}/oauth/start`: the address where the user signs in.

packageId.description: Identifier of the package; use it to install it from the catalogue.

pluginId.description: Identifier of the plugin that the package contains.

displayName.description: Display name of the plugin.

description.description: Description of the plugin.

catalogSourceKind.description: Where the package was found, as a JSON integer: 0 Catalogue (a package file exists), 1 Installed (only an installed folder exists).

pluginSourceKind.description: Source kind declared by the manifest, as a JSON integer: 0 Bundled, 1 LocalPackage, 2 RemotePackage, 3 ShopCatalog.

trustLevel.description: Trust level declared by the manifest, as a JSON integer: 0 Application, 1 Bundled, 2 LocalPackage, 3 RemotePackage, 4 Untrusted.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities, as a JSON integer bit mask: 1 WorkflowExecutor, 2 SettingsRenderer, 4 SecretReference, 8 WorkspaceFiles, 16 Storage, 32 ProjectStructure, 64 HttpClient, 128 OAuth2, 256 ExecutionEvents, 512 HostCommand; 0 for none.

isInstalled.description: True when the plugin of this package is recorded as installed.

requiresRestart.description: True when installing the package requires a restart of the host before its code can run.

hasRuntimeAssemblies.description: True when the package contains .NET assemblies that the host loads at startup.

iconPath.description: Relative path of the icon file inside the package, as declared by its manifest.

sourceName.description: File name of the package in the catalogue folder, or `installed`.

PluginPackageCatalogItem.description: A plugin package known to the server: a `.zip` file in the catalogue folder or an installed package folder, listed by `GET /api/plugins/packages/catalog`. Bundled plugins are not listed.

PluginPackageCatalogSourceKind.description: Where a listed plugin package was found, as a JSON integer: 0 Catalogue (a package file in the server's catalogue folder), 1 Installed (only an installed package folder exists).

minAppVersion.description: Minimum application version declared by the package; informational, the server does not check it.

sha256.description: Package hash as declared by the manifest; not verified by the server.

signature.description: Package signature as declared by the manifest; not verified by the server.

catalogUri.description: Catalog address as declared by the manifest; null when none is declared.

PluginPackageDescriptor.description: Package metadata declared in a plugin manifest. The server records it as declared: it does not verify the hash or the signature and does not use the catalog address.

PluginPackageId.description: Identifier of a plugin package, for example `gmail.mail.bundled` or `candoitall.docker.package`. On the wire it is a JSON string of letters, digits, `.`, `-` and `_`; the server trims and lower-cases it. Request bodies may also send the object form `{"value":"candoitall.docker.package"}`; responses always use the string.

enable.description: True (default): the plugin is installed enabled. False: it is installed disabled.

actor.description: Ignored: the API records `api` as the actor.

PluginPackageInstallRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/plugins/packages/catalog/{packageId}/install`. The JSON object is required; send `{}` for the defaults.

displayName.description: Display name of the plugin.

sourceKind.description: How the package was installed, as a JSON integer: 0 Catalogue, 1 Upload.

restartRequired.description: True when the host must restart before the package's code (assemblies, workflow executors) can run.

restartStatus.description: Restart state of the host after the installation.

PluginPackageInstallResult.description: Result of installing a plugin package from the catalogue or from an upload.

PluginPackageInstallSourceKind.description: How a plugin package was installed, as a JSON integer: 0 Catalogue (from the server's catalogue folder), 1 Upload (from an uploaded file).

PluginRendererKey.description: Key of a settings renderer (a settings user interface component), for example `gmail.settings`. On the wire it is a JSON string of letters, digits, `.`, `-` and `_`, lower-cased by the server.

PluginRendererTrustLevel.description: Trust level of a settings renderer, as a JSON integer: 0 Bundled, 1 LocalPackage, 2 RemotePackage, 3 Untrusted. Only bundled renderers may back custom settings user interfaces.

actor.description: Ignored: the API records `api` as the requester.

PluginRuntimeRestartRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/plugins/runtime/restart`. The JSON object is required; send `{}`.

isRestartRequired.description: True when an installed plugin package needs a host restart before its code can run.

isRestartRequested.description: True when a restart was requested through `POST /api/plugins/runtime/restart`.

reason.description: Why the restart is required, as a sentence naming the package; empty when none is required.

requiredAtUtc.description: When the restart became required; null when none is required.

requestedBy.description: Actor that requested the restart (`api` for this API); empty until requested.

requestedAtUtc.description: When the restart was requested; null until requested.

processId.description: Operating system process identifier of the host process that wrote the state; with no pending state, the current process. A different value after a restart shows that the host was restarted.

PluginRuntimeRestartStatus.description: Plugin-related restart state of the host, kept in a marker file on the server. It is cleared when the host starts.

schema.description: Form of the plugin-level settings; a schema without fields when the plugin has none.

renderers.description: Settings renderers that the plugin provides; empty when it provides none.

PluginSettingsDescriptor.description: Plugin-level settings of a plugin: the settings form and the renderers that display it.

catalogItem.description: The plugin's catalog entry, as in `GET /api/plugins/catalog`.

grants.description: Effective grants: one entry per declared capability and host tool recipe (undecided entries are synthesized with state 0 Requested), followed by any other saved grants.

connections.description: Saved connections, ordered by connection key and then display name.

hostToolRecipes.description: Host tool recipes that the plugin can request; empty for most plugins.

connectionDescriptors.description: Connection kinds that the plugin declares.

oneOf.description: OAuth 2.0 configuration of the plugin; null when it uses no OAuth connection.

PluginSettingsDetail.description: Settings view of one plugin, returned by `GET /api/plugins/{pluginId}/settings`.

rendererKey.description: Key of the renderer, for example `gmail.settings`.

displayName.description: Display name of the renderer.

componentTypeName.description: Name of the user interface component type that implements the renderer.

trustLevel.description: Trust level of the renderer, as a JSON integer: 0 Bundled, 1 LocalPackage, 2 RemotePackage, 3 Untrusted.

PluginSettingsRendererDescriptor.description: A settings renderer, a user interface component that edits plugin or executor settings in the web application.

PluginSourceKind.description: Where a plugin comes from, as a JSON integer: 0 Bundled (compiled into the host), 1 LocalPackage (installed from a package file), 2 RemotePackage, 3 ShopCatalog. Values 2 and 3 are defined but not produced by the current host.

PluginTrustLevel.description: Trust level of a plugin, as a JSON integer: 0 Application, 1 Bundled, 2 LocalPackage, 3 RemotePackage, 4 Untrusted. Packages cannot claim 0 or 1, and only bundled plugins may provide custom settings renderers for workflow executors. 4 is also reported when the manifest of an installed plugin can no longer be read.

executorId.description: Identifier of the executor, for example `gmail.messages-by-label`; workflow nodes refer to it.

description.description: Description of the executor.

category.description: Category of the executor, as a JSON integer: 0 Storage, 1 ProjectStructure, 2 Http, 3 Image, 4 Spreadsheet, 5 Data, 6 Markdown, 7 Human, 8 Utility, 9 Command.

settingsRendererKey.description: Key of the settings renderer that the workflow editor uses for the node.

settingsSchema.description: Settings form of the executor's node settings.

inputShape.description: Shape of the value that the executor accepts as input.

resultShape.description: Shape of the value that the executor returns.

defaultPolicy.description: Default execution limits: timeout, retries and output capture.

defaultSettingsJson.description: Default node settings as JSON text: a string whose content is a JSON object such as `{"maxMessages":1}`, not a nested JSON object.

settingsPresentationMode.description: How the node settings are edited, as a JSON integer: 0 Schema (a form generated from `settingsSchema`), 1 CustomRenderer (the renderer named by `settingsRendererKey`).

simulation.description: Whether and how a run preview can simulate the executor without calling external services.

permissionPolicy.description: Capabilities that the executor requires and whether it needs approval.

sideEffects.description: External effects of the executor and how previews, dry runs and commits behave.

deterministicTestMode.description: Whether the executor can run in a deterministic test mode with simulated inputs.

PluginWorkflowExecutorDescriptor.description: A workflow executor that a plugin provides: a node type that workflows can use, with its settings form, value shapes, default limits and safety metadata.

displayName.description: Display name of the new profile. Null or blank means `PostgreSQL {databaseName}`.

host.description: PostgreSQL server host name or address. Null or blank means `127.0.0.1`.

port.description: PostgreSQL server TCP port. Null, zero or negative means 5432.

databaseName.description: Name of the application database; it is created when it does not exist and reused when it does. Required: null or blank is rejected with HTTP 400.

username.description: PostgreSQL user name. Required: null or blank is rejected with HTTP 400.

password.description: PostgreSQL password, stored with the profile. Null means an empty password. Use only local development credentials.

adminDatabaseName.description: Maintenance database used to create the application database. Null or blank means `postgres`.

trustServerCertificate.description: True accepts the server's TLS certificate without validation. Null means false.

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace directory of the profile on this host; a relative path is resolved against the host's content root. Null or blank means the host's default workspace root.

activate.description: False saves the profile without switching to it. Null or true switches the host to the new profile.

PostgreSqlDevDatabaseProfileRequest.description: Request of the development-only operation `POST /_dev/database/profiles/postgresql`: connection settings of a local PostgreSQL database for a new database profile, and whether to activate it. Every member may be null or omitted except `databaseName` and `username`; text values are trimmed.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type. For LLM Chat problems it ends with the problem `code` and is not dereferenceable.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type; the same for every problem with the same status.

status.description: HTTP status code of the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence. Its wording can change and must not be parsed.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this occurrence, when the server provides one.

ProblemDetails.description: Problem details (RFC 9457) returned as `application/problem+json`. The LLM Chat operations add `code`, a stable machine-readable reason to branch on, and, when an LLM Chat operation is concerned, `operationId` (that operation) and `retryable` (true when the failure is transient, such as an unavailable provider, so a later attempt can succeed). The file routes return only the standard members, with the reason in `detail`.

endpoints.description: Every process route as `METHOD /path` text with route parameters in braces, for example `POST /api/processes/runs/{runId}/dispatch`. The order is fixed; it carries no meaning.

boundarySummary.description: Human-readable note on how the generic process runtime hands step execution to product adapters. Informational text for operators; do not parse it.

ProcessApiContractResponse.description: Fixed description of the process HTTP API returned by `GET /api/processes/contract`: which routes exist, not their schemas.

parentRunId.description: Identifier of the waiting run, the run listed.

parentStepInstanceId.description: Identifier of the waiting step within that run.

parentStepKey.description: Key of the waiting step in the process definition.

parentStepStatus.description: Runtime status of the waiting step, as text: `Waiting`, `Blocked`, `Ready`, `Claimed` or `Running`.

childRunId.description: Identifier of the child run; read it with `GET /api/processes/runs/{runId}`.

childRunStatus.description: Runtime status of the child run, as text, for example `Created`, `Active` or `CancelRequested`. Child runs that have ended or are blocked are not listed.

childStepKey.description: Key of the child run's current step; null when it has no current step.

childStepStatus.description: Runtime status of the child run's current step; null when it has none.

summary.description: Generated one-line English description for display; do not parse it.

ProcessChildRunWaitApiView.description: A child run (subprocess) that a step of a live run is waiting for.

runId.description: Identifier of the run that owns the step.

stepInstanceId.description: Identifier of the step within the run; use it with the step rework operation.

stepKey.description: Key of the step in the process definition, or the step identifier as text when the step has no assignment.

stepStatus.description: Runtime status of the step, as text: `Running`, `Claimed`, `Waiting`, `Blocked` (after at least one attempt), `Ready` or `Pending`. When several steps qualify, the first status in this order is chosen.

roleKey.description: Key of the process role assigned to the step, or `unassigned`.

roleDisplayName.description: Display name of that role; the role key when no name is known.

executorDisplayName.description: Display name of the assigned agent or workflow, or `Unassigned executor`.

attemptNumber.description: Execution attempt of the step: 0 before its first dispatch, then counted from 1.

isWorking.description: True while the step is Claimed or Running under an open, unexpired claim.

isLeaseExpired.description: True when the step's active claim has passed its expiry time.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the run's runtime state last changed; it is not specific to this step.

claimedAtUtc.description: When the step's active claim was created; null without an active claim.

leaseExpiresAtUtc.description: When the active claim expires unless it is renewed; null without an active claim. A step result submitted after expiry is rejected.

summary.description: Generated one-line English description of the step's state for display. Times in it use the server's local time zone; do not parse it.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics of the latest result of this step that matches its current status; empty when there is none.

producedArtifacts.description: Artifacts produced by the applied results of this step, in result order.

ProcessCurrentStepApiView.description: The step of a live run that is executing or next in line, computed from the runtime state when the live projection is read.

requestedBy.description: Free-text label of the caller, used to label follow-up work that this dispatch queues. Omitted or blank means `process-api`. It is not an identity: the runtime records its own actor and authorizes nothing by this value.

ProcessDispatchApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/processes/runs/{runId}/dispatch`. Every member is optional, but the JSON object itself is required: send `{}` to use the defaults.

runId.description: Identifier of the dispatched process run (the route value).

stage.description: Coarse stage of the run after the dispatch, as text: `Completed`; `Failed`, which is also used for a cancelled run; `Blocked`; or `Running` for every other status, including a run that is still active, waits for a workflow or child run, or is being cancelled. Dispatch never returns `Planned`.

status.description: Runtime status of the run after the dispatch, as text: `Created` (not started), `Active` (steps can run), `Blocked` (no runnable path is left; needs attention), `CancelRequested` (cancellation of a top-level run is in progress), or one of the terminal statuses `Completed`, `Failed` and `Cancelled`. `Waiting`, `Escalated` and `WaitingForUser` are defined but not set by the current runtime.

diagnostics.description: Human-readable sentences about what the dispatch did or why it stopped, for example a failed step, a hand-over to a workflow or child run, or a retried concurrent change. They are not stable codes; do not parse them. Text that looks like credentials, URL query strings and local file paths is removed; at most 32 entries of at most 2,048 characters. Empty when there is nothing to report.

ProcessDispatchApiResponse.description: Result of `POST /api/processes/runs/{runId}/dispatch`: the state of the run when the dispatch stopped. It is not a durable receipt; read the run to confirm what happened.

events.description: Events of the run in the window, ascending by `globalSequence`; at most `take` entries, and when more events exist these are the oldest ones.

oneOf.description: Derived from the last returned event: `observedAtUtc` is that event's `occurredAtUtc`, both sequence members are its `globalSequence`, and the backlog is 0. Null when no event is returned.

ProcessHistoryApiResponse.description: Response of `GET /api/processes/runs/{runId}/history`: the run's projected events in the requested window.

value.description: The admission identifier, a non-empty GUID.

ProcessLaunchAdmissionId.description: Identifier of a prepared process launch (its admission).

definitionKey.description: Key of the process definition to launch, for example `blazor-app-delivery`; matched case-insensitively after trimming, and it takes precedence over `processDefinitionId`. When neither member selects a definition, the server falls back to the definition of the requested or first configured live-run profile, so always send one. An unknown key fails the request.

processDefinitionId.description: Identifier of the process definition (`definitionId` of an earlier launch response), used only when `definitionKey` is omitted or blank. An identifier that matches no definition is not rejected: the fallback described for `definitionKey` applies. The all-zero GUID fails the request.

liveRunProfileKey.description: Key of a live-run profile, which chooses the roles, executor kinds and workflow bindings of the definition's steps, for example `generic-blazor-wasm-pwa-app`; matched case-insensitively. It must belong to the selected definition. Omitted means the first profile configured for that definition, if any; the applied key is returned in `launchPlan.liveRunProfileKey`.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project the run belongs to; omit it for a run without a project. The project must exist. The run is bound to the project's current lifetime, the value becomes the `ProjectId` launch variable, and `route` points to the project's page. The all-zero GUID fails the request.

projectNodeId.description: String identifier of the Project Structure node the run is started for (`nodes[].id` of a structure read; not a GUID in general). With `projectId`, the server reads the node and sets project and node variables such as `ProjectName`, `ProjectNodeTitle` and `ProjectNodeStatus`, replacing caller values with the same keys; an unknown node fails the request. Without `projectId` it is only stored as the `ProjectNodeId` variable.

requestedBy.description: Free-text label of the requester, recorded on the run's events after reduction to letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.` (at most 128 characters). Omitted or blank means `process-api`. It is part of the retry comparison but is not an identity: authority comes from the bearer token or the local caller.

variables.description: Launch variables as a JSON object of string values, for example `{"Goal":"Add a settings page"}`. Keys are case-sensitive; blank keys are dropped and keys and values are trimmed. A value can reference another variable as `{{Key}}`, `${Key}` or `{Key}`; an unresolved or cyclic reference can block the launch with a readiness error. The server sets or replaces reserved keys, among them `ProjectId`, `ProjectNodeId`, `ProcessDefinitionKey`, `ProcessDefinitionName` and the run and artifact-root variables. Omitted or null means no caller variables.

runReadiness.description: True (default): readiness errors, for example a step without a suitable agent, block the launch. False: readiness is still evaluated and reported, but ordinary executor errors do not block, and steps without an executor are launched unassigned. Compile errors, step assignment errors and findings that must always block still block.

execute.description: Used by the launch operation only. True: queue the accepted run for background dispatch right away. False (default): accept and activate the run without queuing it. A launch retried after the run was accepted must send the original value. The check operation ignores it.

callerIntentId.description: Idempotency key that you generate once per intended launch (a new GUID) and send unchanged with the check, the launch and every retry. The same intent with identical input returns the same preparation and, once launched, the same run; different input under the same intent is rejected with HTTP 409. Omitted means that every call is a new intent. The all-zero GUID fails the request.

preparedAdmissionId.description: Identifier of an existing preparation (`observation.admissionId`) to reuse; when present it is used instead of `callerIntentId` to find the preparation. The input must be identical to the saved one. An unknown identifier fails the request with HTTP 400.

ProcessLaunchApiRequest.description: Launch request of `POST /api/processes/launch/check` and `POST /api/processes/launch`. Every member is optional, but the JSON object is required; send at least `definitionKey` and a `callerIntentId`. A retry under the same intent must repeat every member except `execute` exactly.

definitionId.description: Identifier of the launched process definition, derived from its key; it stays the same across versions of the definition.

launchPlanId.description: Identifier of the immutable launch plan of this preparation; equals `launchPlan.planId`. A repeated check or launch with the same intent returns the same plan.

runId.description: Identifier of the accepted run, for the `/api/processes/runs/{runId}` operations. Null for a check that has not been launched, for a blocked result, and when the commit was rejected.

stage.description: Outcome stage, as text: `Planned` (the check succeeded, or a launch was accepted but activation and scheduling are still pending), `Blocked` (readiness blocked the launch; nothing was saved), `Running` (the run is active, waiting or being cancelled; also after a launch with `execute` false), `Completed`, or `Failed` (the commit was rejected, the run could not be activated, or the run failed or was cancelled).

route.description: Relative path of the run's page in the web application, for example `/processes/live?runId={runId}` or `/projects/{projectId}/processes/live?runId={runId}`; empty when there is no run. It is not an API route.

launchPlan.description: The reviewed plan: definition, steps with their executors, and readiness findings.

warnings.description: Messages of readiness findings that are not informational (for a blocked result, the reasons), rejection diagnostics of a failed commit, and a note when the continuation is pending or needs reconciliation. Text that looks like credentials, URL query strings and local file paths is removed; at most 32 entries of at most 2,048 characters.

oneOf.description: Saved admission state of the preparation, including the `admissionId` needed for `GET /api/processes/launch/{admissionId}`. Null when readiness blocked the launch and nothing was saved.

ProcessLaunchApiResponse.description: Result of a launch check or launch: the reviewed plan, the accepted run if there is one, and the saved admission to observe.

ProcessLaunchContinuationState.description: Continuation state of a prepared process launch, as a JSON integer: 0 Prepared, 1 Accepted, 2 Continuing, 3 Started, 4 ReconciliationRequired, 5 Failed.

ProcessLaunchLinkDeliveryState.description: Delivery state of the link from a launched run back to its source, as a JSON integer: 0 NotRequested, 1 Pending, 2 Delivered, 3 Removed, 4 Conflict.

admissionId.description: Launch admission identifier, as an object whose `value` is a GUID.

oneOf.description: Process run the launch created, as an object whose `value` is a GUID; null until a run was accepted.

continuationState.description: Continuation state, as a JSON integer: 0 Prepared, 1 Accepted, 2 Continuing, 3 Started, 4 ReconciliationRequired, 5 Failed.

linkDeliveryState.description: Delivery state of the link back to the source, as a JSON integer: 0 NotRequested, 1 Pending, 2 Delivered, 3 Removed, 4 Conflict.

publicFailure.description: Failure message that is safe to show; null unless the launch failed.

oneOf.description: Runtime status of the accepted run, as a JSON integer: 0 Created, 1 Active, 2 Waiting, 3 Blocked, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 CancelRequested, 7 Cancelled, 8 Escalated, 9 WaitingForUser; null when it was not read.

ProcessLaunchObservation.description: Observed state of a prepared process launch.

admissionId.description: Identifier of the saved preparation. Keep it to observe the launch and to reuse the preparation as `preparedAdmissionId`.

acceptedRunId.description: Identifier of the run once a launch accepted the preparation; null while it is only prepared.

continuationState.description: How far the launch got, as text: `Prepared` (saved by a check; no run), `Accepted` (the run is committed; activation and scheduling are pending), `Continuing` (a worker is activating and scheduling the run), `Started` (activation and scheduling finished), `Failed` (activation or scheduling failed; read the run), or `ReconciliationRequired` (the saved launch authority was rejected, for example because its token expired; the launch is not continued automatically).

linkDeliveryState.description: Delivery of the Project Structure link for launches started from a structure node, as text: `NotRequested`, `Pending`, `Delivered`, `Removed` or `Conflict`. Launches through this API never request a link, so it is `NotRequested` for them.

runtimeStatus.description: Runtime status of the accepted run when it was read, as text, for example `Active`, `Blocked`, `Completed`, `Failed` or `Cancelled`. Null when no run was accepted or its state could not be read; usually null in check and launch responses.

publicFailure.description: Fixed message shown when the saved launch authority needs reconciliation; null otherwise. It never contains exception details.

ProcessLaunchObservationApiView.description: Saved state of a launch preparation (launch admission), returned by the launch check, the launch, and `GET /api/processes/launch/{admissionId}`.

planId.description: Identifier of the immutable plan; equals `launchPlanId`. Every new preparation compiles a new plan with new step identifiers.

definitionId.description: Identifier of the process definition, derived from its key.

definitionVersionId.description: Identifier of the exact definition version; it changes when the definition's content changes.

definitionKey.description: Key of the launched definition, in the definition's own spelling.

liveRunProfileKey.description: Key of the live-run profile that was applied, also when the server chose it; null when no profile was applied.

planHash.description: Content hash of the compiled plan: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; empty when the plan could not be compiled. Equal hashes mean identical plan content.

steps.description: Every step of the plan in plan order, including steps that are not executable.

readinessFindings.description: Readiness results, from informational notes to errors that block the launch.

ProcessLaunchPlanApiView.description: Reviewed launch plan of a preparation: which definition version is launched, with which steps and executors, and whether it is ready.

severity.description: `Info`, `Warning` or `Error`. Errors can block the launch (see `runReadiness` of the request); informational findings never do.

code.description: Stable finding code, for example `process.launch.readiness_ok`, `process.launch.agent_missing`, `process.launch.workflow_not_runnable` or `agent.readiness.tools-disabled`; at most 128 characters of letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.` and `:`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Text that looks like credentials, URL query strings and local file paths is removed; at most 2,048 characters.

stepKey.description: Key of the step the finding concerns; null for findings about the whole plan.

roleKey.description: Key of the role the finding concerns; null when it concerns no specific role.

ProcessLaunchReadinessFindingApiView.description: One readiness result of a launch plan.

stepInstanceId.description: Identifier of this step in this plan; it becomes the step's identifier in the accepted run (for example for step rework). A new plan has new step identifiers.

stepKey.description: Key of the step in the process definition, for example `resolve-blazor-contract`.

title.description: Display title of the step; the step key when the definition gives no title.

roleKey.description: Key of the process role responsible for the step, for example `blazor-engineer`.

executorKind.description: Kind of the assigned executor: `agent` or `workflow`; empty when no executor could be assigned.

executorId.description: Identifier of the assigned agent or workflow as a GUID string; empty when no executor is assigned.

executorDisplayName.description: Name of the assigned agent or workflow; empty when no executor is assigned.

isBlocked.description: True when a readiness error concerns this step.

blockedReason.description: Message of that readiness error; null when the step is not blocked.

oneOf.description: Present when the step runs only for one outcome of an earlier branching step; such a step waits blocked until that outcome is chosen. Null otherwise.
Workflow that executes the step; null for steps that are not workflow steps.

ProcessLaunchStepApiView.description: One step of a launch plan with the executor assigned to it.

runs.description: Runs whose last event lies within the requested window, ordered by last event time, newest first; at most `take` entries.

oneOf.description: Freshness of the most recently projected run in the list; null when the list is empty.

ProcessLiveApiResponse.description: Response of `GET /api/processes/live`: process runs with recent activity, from the live projection.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of the runtime event.

globalSequence.description: Position of the event in the durable runtime event log shared by all runs; it grows with every stored event.

rootRunId.description: Identifier of the top-level run of the subprocess tree; equals `runId` for a top-level run.

runId.description: Identifier of the run the event belongs to.

eventType.description: Runtime event type name. Run events: `ProcessRunCreated`, `ProcessRunActivated`, `ProcessRunCancelRequested`, `ProcessRunCancelled`, `ProcessRunCompleted`, `ProcessRunFailed`, `ProcessRunBlocked`, `ProcessRunReactivated`. Step events: `StepReady`, `StepWaiting`, `StepClaimed`, `StepRunning`, `StepCompleted`, `StepFailed`, `StepBlocked`, `StepCancelled`, `StepSkipped`, `StepReworkRequested`. Dispatch claim events: `DispatchClaimCreated`, `DispatchLeaseRenewed`, `DispatchClaimExpired`, `DispatchClaimReleased`, `DispatchClaimReclaimed`, `DispatchClaimCompleted`. Process manager events: `ManagerIncidentRaised`, `ManagerRecoveryApproved`, `ManagerRecoveryDenied`, `ManagerBranchDecisionRecorded`, `ManagerBranchDecisionRejected`, `ManagerLoopBudgetEscalated`, `ManagerSubprocessMessageQueued`.

sensitivity.description: `Normal` or `Restricted`. For a restricted event the summary is a generic text and `restrictedDiagnosticReference` is set; the type, identifiers and time stay visible.

summary.description: The event type name for a normal event, or `Restricted runtime event`. For an attention event (`ProcessRunBlocked`, `StepBlocked`, `ProcessRunFailed`, `StepFailed`, `ManagerIncidentRaised`, `ManagerLoopBudgetEscalated`, `ManagerRecoveryDenied` or `ManagerBranchDecisionRejected`), the run's first current diagnostic is appended as `: {category} - {safeSummary}`.

restrictedDiagnosticReference.description: For a restricted event, `runtime-event:` followed by the event identifier, for correlation with operator records; no API operation resolves it. Null for a normal event.

diagnostics.description: For an attention event (see `summary`): the run's current diagnostics at the time of the read, not necessarily those recorded with this event. Empty for other events.

ProcessLiveEventApiView.description: One projected runtime event of a process run, as listed in the recent events of the live and detail projections.

rootRunId.description: Identifier of the top-level run of the run's subprocess tree; equals `runId` for a top-level run.

runId.description: Identifier of this run, for the `/api/processes/runs/{runId}` operations.

status.description: Projected status, as text, derived from the latest projected events: `Active` (running or waiting), `NeedsAttention` (the run or a step is blocked, rework was requested, or the process manager raised an incident, escalated a loop budget, denied a recovery or rejected a branch decision), `Completed`, `Failed` or `Cancelled`. `Unknown` is defined but not produced.

isActive.description: True for an `Active` run. For a `NeedsAttention` run, true only while one of its steps holds an unexpired claim, that is, while work is actually in progress. False for ended runs.

firstEventAtUtc.description: Instant of the first projected runtime event of this run.

lastEventAtUtc.description: Instant of the most recently projected runtime event of this run; the time window of the request applies to it.

oneOf.description: How current this run's projection is.

recentEvents.description: Up to 20 most recent events of this run, oldest first.

oneOf.description: The step that is executing or next in line; null when the run is neither active nor in need of attention, or when no step qualifies.

waitingOnChildRuns.description: Child runs that steps of this run are waiting for and that have not ended or become blocked. Empty when there are none, or when the run is neither active nor in need of attention.

diagnostics.description: Current diagnostics of the run: those of the latest results of steps that are now Blocked or Failed. Empty when there are none, or when the run is neither active nor in need of attention.

ProcessLiveRunApiView.description: Live projection of one process run in `GET /api/processes/live`.

observedAtUtc.description: When the projector processed the event that last updated the projection.

sourceGlobalSequence.description: `globalSequence` of the runtime event that last updated the projection.

latestKnownGlobalSequence.description: Highest `globalSequence` known to the projector when it processed that event; it can be lower than the newest event in the store.

lastProcessedGlobalSequence.description: `globalSequence` of the last event the projector had processed; currently always equal to `sourceGlobalSequence`.

backlogEventCount.description: Number of known events not yet projected at that time (the difference of the two sequence numbers); 0 means that the projection was up to date when it was written.

ProcessProjectionFreshnessApiView.description: How current a projection is. It is recorded when the projection is updated and is not recalculated when it is read.

rootRunId.description: Identifier of the top-level run of the run's subprocess tree; equals `runId` for a top-level run.

runId.description: Identifier of the run (the route value).

status.description: Projected status, as text, derived from the latest projected events: `Active`, `NeedsAttention` (the run or a step is blocked, rework was requested, or the process manager intervened), `Completed`, `Failed` or `Cancelled`. `Unknown` is defined but not produced.

firstEventAtUtc.description: Instant of the first projected runtime event of the run.

lastEventAtUtc.description: Instant of the most recently projected runtime event of the run.

oneOf.description: How current the projection is.

recentEvents.description: Up to 20 most recent events of the run, oldest first.

diagnostics.description: Current diagnostics: those of the latest results of steps that are now Blocked or Failed. Empty when there are none.

resultLineage.description: Every applied step result of the run, in the order in which the results were applied, each with its diagnostics, produced artifacts and recovery decision. Empty before the first result.

ProcessRunDetailApiView.description: Projected detail of one process run, returned by `GET /api/processes/runs/{runId}`.

disposition.description: How the runs ended, as text: `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Cancelled` or `Blocked`.

matchingRunCount.description: Number of matching records with this disposition.

ProcessRunDispositionAnalyticsApiView.description: Number of matching run records with one disposition.

steps.description: The requested page of steps: the run's own steps first, then those of its child runs; within a run in plan order. At most 2,048 steps are stored per record.

participantIds.description: Up to 200 participants: executor identifiers of step assignments and identifiers of agents that executed steps.

participantCount.description: Number of stored participants (at most 512; warning `ParticipantIdsTruncated` when more existed).

workflowIds.description: Up to 200 identifiers of workflows bound to steps.

workflowCount.description: Number of stored workflow identifiers (at most 2,048).

subprocessRunIds.description: Up to 200 identifiers of child runs.

subprocessRunCount.description: Number of stored child run identifiers (at most 2,048).

executionRunIds.description: Up to 200 identifiers of agent execution runs that executed steps.

executionRunCount.description: Number of stored agent execution run identifiers (at most 4,096).

artifactIds.description: Up to 200 identifiers of artifact instances produced or connected in the run.

artifactCount.description: Number of stored artifact identifiers (at most 4,096).

totalRuntimeEventCount.description: Number of runtime events of the run and its child runs.

managerRuntimeEventCount.description: Number of those events that are process manager events (incidents, recovery and branch decisions, loop budget escalations, subprocess messages).

runtimeEventMinuteBuckets.description: The requested page of per-minute event statistics, oldest minute first; only minutes with events are listed, and at most the latest 10,080 minutes are stored.

runtimeEventCategories.description: Event counts per category; only categories that occurred are listed.

ProcessRunHardFactsApiView.description: Hard facts of a run record: one page of steps, identifier lists, and runtime event statistics. They cover the run and every child run it launched and are assembled from stored runtime data, not generated text.

value.description: The run identifier, a non-empty GUID.

overview.description: Overview of the run; at most 2,048 characters.

outcome.description: Outcome of the run; at most 2,048 characters.

workCompleted.description: Work that was done; at most 12 items of at most 512 characters.

problems.description: Problems that occurred; at most 12 items of at most 512 characters.

decisions.description: Decisions that were made; at most 12 items of at most 512 characters.

followUps.description: Recommended follow-up work; at most 12 items of at most 512 characters.

provenance.description: Which agent, execution and model produced the narrative.

ProcessRunNarrativeApiView.description: Narrative of an ended run, generated by a process manager agent from the record's hard facts after they were assembled. It is a model-written interpretation: the hard facts are the evidence. Text is trimmed, line breaks are replaced by spaces, and long text is cut.

overview.description: Overview of the run, cut to 512 characters.

outcome.description: Outcome of the run, cut to 512 characters.

provenance.description: Which agent, execution and model produced the narrative.

ProcessRunNarrativePreviewApiView.description: Shortened narrative of a run record in its summary.

managerAgentId.description: Identifier of the process manager agent that wrote the narrative, as a GUID string.

narrativeExecutionRunId.description: Identifier of the agent execution run that produced the narrative.

generationPolicyId.description: Identifier of the generation policy, for example `process-run-narrative/v1`.

modelId.description: Model that generated the narrative, or `unknown`.

fromUtc.description: Effective inclusive start of the window.

toUtc.description: Effective exclusive end of the window.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the record format, currently `1.0`.

matchingRunCount.description: Number of records that match the window and filters.

factsAvailableRunCount.description: Number of those records whose facts are assembled; the sums cover only these.

evidenceCompleteRunCount.description: Number of records with facts whose completeness is `Complete`.

evidencePartialRunCount.description: Number of records with facts whose completeness is `Partial`.

factsUnavailableRunCount.description: Number of matching records whose facts are not assembled yet or failed (`matchingRunCount` minus `factsAvailableRunCount`).

dataThroughUtc.description: Latest end time among the matching records; null when nothing matched.

sourceGlobalSequenceWatermark.description: Highest `sourceGlobalSequence` among the matching records; null when nothing matched. Compare it between reads to see whether new records arrived.

durationMilliseconds.description: Sum of run durations in milliseconds; a run without a duration counts as 0.

estimatedCost.description: Sum of estimated costs in US dollars; 0 can mean unpriced (see the record metrics).

actualCost.description: Sum of priced costs in US dollars; 0 can mean unpriced (see the record metrics).

dispositions.description: Number of matching records per disposition; only dispositions that occur are listed. Covers every matching record, with or without facts.

ProcessRunRecordAnalyticsApiView.description: Aggregates of the durable run records whose run ended within a window, returned by `GET /api/processes/runs/analytics`. Usage, cost and activity sums cover only records with available facts, and a parent record's totals already include its child runs, which are also counted as separate records.

summary.description: Status, evidence and totals of the record.

oneOf.description: The requested page of hard facts; null until `summary.factsStatus` is Completed.
The generated narrative; null until `summary.narrativeStatus` is Completed.

ProcessRunRecordApiView.description: Durable record of one ended process run, returned by `GET /api/processes/runs/{runId}/summary`.

available.description: Sources that were complete, from: `RuntimeState`, `InstancePlan`, `StepAssignments`, `ExecutionObservations`, `UsageTelemetry`, `Pricing`, `RuntimeEvents`, `ArtifactLineage`, `Subprocesses`. Empty until the facts are assembled.

missing.description: Sources that were missing or incomplete, with the same names. Every source is listed here until the facts are assembled.

ProcessRunRecordEvidenceApiView.description: Evidence sources behind the facts of a run record. Totals that depend on a missing source can be too low; for example costs without `Pricing`.

summary.description: Status, evidence and totals of the record, as in the summary operation.

nodes.description: The steps of this page; empty while the facts are not assembled.

edges.description: Dependencies between steps of this page, ordered by target and then source step; at most 4,096.

subprocessRunIds.description: Up to 200 identifiers of the run's child runs.

ProcessRunRecordGraphApiView.description: One page of the step dependency graph of a run record, returned by `GET /api/processes/runs/{runId}/graph`.

targetStepInstanceId.description: Identifier of the step that depends on the prerequisite step.

kind.description: Kind of the edge, as text; currently always `Dependency`.

ProcessRunRecordGraphEdgeApiView.description: A dependency between two steps of a run record's graph.

owningRunId.description: Identifier of the run that owns the step: the record's run or one of its child runs.

stepInstanceId.description: Identifier of the step within its run; edges refer to it.

stepDefinitionId.description: Identifier of the step in the process definition.

stepKey.description: Key of the step in the process definition; at most 256 characters.

outcome.description: Status of the step when the facts were assembled, as text: `Pending`, `Running`, `Waiting`, `Blocked`, `Completed`, `Failed`, `Cancelled`, `Skipped` or `Unknown`.

attemptCount.description: Number of execution attempts of the step.

participantId.description: Executor of the step assignment, or else the agent of the latest execution; null when neither is known.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow bound to the step; null for steps without a workflow.

startedAtUtc.description: Earliest start of an execution or claim of the step; null when it never started.

endedAtUtc.description: Latest completion of an execution of the step; null when none completed.

durationMilliseconds.description: `endedAtUtc` minus `startedAtUtc` in milliseconds; null when either is missing.

totalTokenCount.description: Total tokens attributed to the step, as reported by the providers.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated cost of the step in US dollars; 0 can mean unpriced.

actualCost.description: Priced cost of the step in US dollars; 0 can mean unpriced.

toolCallCount.description: Tool calls attributed to the step.

artifactCount.description: Number of artifacts attributed to the step.

ProcessRunRecordGraphNodeApiView.description: One step of a run record's dependency graph, with its key facts.

runId.description: Identifier of the process run the record describes.

rootRunId.description: Identifier of the top-level run of the run's subprocess tree; equals `runId` for a top-level run.

parentRunId.description: Identifier of the parent run of a child run; null for a top-level run and until the facts are assembled.

planId.description: Identifier of the run's immutable launch plan (`launchPlanId` of the launch response); can be null until the facts are assembled.

definitionId.description: Identifier of the launched process definition; null until the facts are assembled or when the plan could not be read.

definitionVersionId.description: Identifier of the exact definition version that was launched; null in the same cases as `definitionId`.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project the run was launched for; null for a run without a project, until the facts are assembled, or when the stored value was invalid (warning `InvalidProjectId`).

ProcessRunRecordIdentityApiView.description: Identities of a durable run record. Except for the two run identifiers, the members are filled in when the facts are assembled.

records.description: Records on this page, ordered by end time (newest first) and then run identifier (descending). Empty when nothing matched.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page: send it as `cursor` with the same filters. Null when no further record matched at the time of the query.

identity.description: Run, plan, definition and project identities of the record.

disposition.description: How the run ended, as text: `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Cancelled` or `Blocked` (`Escalated` is defined but not currently produced).

completeness.description: Evidence completeness, as text: `SeedOnly` (facts not assembled yet), `Partial` (facts assembled, but evidence is missing or a warning was raised) or `Complete`.

factsStatus.description: Progress of the hard-facts assembly, as text: `Pending`, `Assembling`, `Completed` or `Failed`.

factsAttemptCount.description: Number of times the background worker has started assembling the facts.

factsNextAttemptAtUtc.description: When the worker retries after a failed attempt; null when no retry is scheduled, for example while assembling, after success, or when the attempts are used up (5 by default).

narrativeStatus.description: Progress of the narrative generation, as text: `Pending`, `Generating`, `Completed` or `Failed`. The narrative is generated only after the facts are Completed.

narrativeAttemptCount.description: Number of times the background worker has started generating the narrative.

narrativeNextAttemptAtUtc.description: When the worker retries the narrative; null when no retry is scheduled.

metrics.description: Timing, step, usage and cost totals of the run and its child runs.

sourceGlobalSequence.description: `globalSequence` of the runtime event that ended the run and created this version of the record. A larger value for the same run means a newer version, for example after a reactivated run ended again.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the record format, currently `1.0`.

recordUpdatedAtUtc.description: When the record last changed: created, picked up by the worker, completed or failed.

ProcessRunRecordListItemApiView.description: Compact durable record of one ended process run in a list page. Read `GET /api/processes/runs/{runId}/summary` for evidence, warnings, participants and the narrative.

startedAtUtc.description: Start of the run: its first runtime event, or else its first step activity; null until the facts are assembled or when neither is known.

endedAtUtc.description: When the run ended: the time of the event that created the record.

durationMilliseconds.description: `endedAtUtc` minus `startedAtUtc` in whole milliseconds; null without a start, or when the end precedes the start (warning `InvalidRunTiming`).

totalStepCount.description: Number of steps of the run and its child runs, executable or not.

executableStepCount.description: Number of those steps that are executable.

completedStepCount.description: Number of steps that were Completed when the facts were assembled.

failedStepCount.description: Number of steps that were Failed when the facts were assembled.

cancelledStepCount.description: Number of steps that were Cancelled when the facts were assembled.

repetitionCount.description: Extra step attempts: the sum over all steps of attempts beyond the first.

executionCount.description: Number of distinct agent execution runs that executed steps.

reworkCount.description: Number of step rework requests (`StepReworkRequested` events).

incidentCount.description: Number of process manager incidents (`ManagerIncidentRaised` events).

escalationCount.description: Number of loop budget escalations (`ManagerLoopBudgetEscalated` events).

inputTokenCount.description: Model input tokens reported by providers, summed over all usage observations.

cachedInputTokenCount.description: Part of the input tokens that providers reported as served from cache.

outputTokenCount.description: Model output tokens reported by providers.

totalTokenCount.description: Total tokens as reported by the providers, not recalculated; whether it includes cached or reasoning tokens depends on the provider.

estimatedCost.description: Cost in US dollars, rounded to 6 decimal places, of usage that was estimated (for example from metrics) rather than observed. 0 can mean unpriced rather than free; check the `Pricing` evidence and the `MissingPricing` warning.

actualCost.description: Cost in US dollars, rounded to 6 decimal places, of priced usage: the cost reported by the provider, calculated, or taken from the price table. 0 can mean unpriced rather than free; check the `Pricing` evidence and the `MissingPricing` warning.

toolCallCount.description: Tool calls reported with the usage observations.

artifactCount.description: Number of distinct artifacts produced or connected in the run.

subprocessCount.description: Number of child runs, at any depth, that were found for the run.

ProcessRunRecordMetricsApiView.description: Timing, step, usage and cost totals of a run record. They cover the run and every child run it launched; until the facts are assembled, all counts and costs are 0 and only `endedAtUtc` is known.

identity.description: Run, plan, definition and project identities of the record.

disposition.description: How the run ended, as text: `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Cancelled` or `Blocked` (`Escalated` is defined but not currently produced).

lifecycleState.description: Always `Current` here: only the current version of a record is returned. A version replaced after a reactivation (`Superseded`) is not returned.

completeness.description: Evidence completeness, as text: `SeedOnly` (facts not assembled yet), `Partial` (facts assembled, but evidence is missing or a warning was raised) or `Complete`.

evidence.description: Evidence sources that were available and missing when the facts were assembled.

completenessWarnings.description: Codes of the problems found while assembling the facts, at most 64: missing evidence (`MissingInstancePlan`, `MissingStepAssignments`, `MissingExecutionObservations`, `MissingUsageTelemetry`, `MissingPricing`, `MissingArtifactLineage`, `MissingRuntimeEvents`, `MissingSubprocessEvidence`, `MissingSubprocessParentMetadata`), child runs that had not ended or could not be found (`SubprocessNonTerminal`, `SubprocessDepthLimitReached`, `SubprocessDiscoveryFailed`), truncated lists (codes ending in `Truncated`), inconsistent data (`MissingStepTiming`, `InvalidRunTiming`, `UnallocatedUsage`, `MissingStepKey`, `InvalidProjectId`) and `PrimaryRunBlocked`. Empty when there were none or the facts are not assembled yet.

factsStatus.description: Progress of the hard-facts assembly, as text: `Pending`, `Assembling`, `Completed` or `Failed`.

factsAttemptCount.description: Number of times the background worker has started assembling the facts.

factsNextAttemptAtUtc.description: When the worker retries after a failed attempt; null when no retry is scheduled, for example while assembling, after success, or when the attempts are used up (5 by default).

factsLastErrorClass.description: Short type name of the error of the last failed facts attempt, without its message; null when the last attempt did not fail.

narrativeStatus.description: Progress of the narrative generation, as text: `Pending`, `Generating`, `Completed` or `Failed`. The narrative is generated only after the facts are Completed.

narrativeAttemptCount.description: Number of times the background worker has started generating the narrative.

narrativeNextAttemptAtUtc.description: When the worker retries the narrative; null when no retry is scheduled.

narrativeLastErrorClass.description: Short type name of the error of the last failed or deferred narrative attempt, without its message; null when the last attempt did not fail.

metrics.description: Timing, step, usage and cost totals of the run and its child runs.

participantIds.description: Up to 32 participants of the run and its child runs: executor identifiers of step assignments and identifiers of agents that executed steps (agent identifiers are GUID strings). Empty until the facts are assembled; the facts list up to 200.

oneOf.description: Overview and outcome of the narrative, each cut to 512 characters, with provenance; null until the narrative is Completed.

sourceGlobalSequence.description: `globalSequence` of the runtime event that ended the run and created this version of the record.

sourceRootSequence.description: Position of that event within the event sequence of its top-level run.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the record format, currently `1.0`.

recordUpdatedAtUtc.description: When the record last changed: created, picked up by the worker, completed or failed.

ProcessRunRecordSummaryApiView.description: Status, evidence and totals of a durable run record, as returned by the summary and graph operations.

ProcessRunRuntimeEventCategory.description: Category of the runtime events of a process run in its durable record. The HTTP API writes it as one of the text tokens `RunLifecycle` (run created, activated, cancellation requested, cancelled, completed, failed, blocked or reactivated), `Step` (step state changes and rework requests), `Dispatch` (step claims and their leases), `Manager` (process manager incidents, recovery and branch decisions, loop budget escalations and subprocess messages) or `Other`.

category.description: Event category, as one of the text tokens `RunLifecycle` (run created, activated, completed and similar), `Step`, `Dispatch` (step claims and leases), `Manager` (process manager events) or `Other`.

eventCount.description: Number of events of this category.

firstOccurredAtUtc.description: When the first event of this category occurred.

lastOccurredAtUtc.description: When the last event of this category occurred.

ProcessRunRuntimeEventCategoryAggregateA.description: Runtime event count of one event category of a run.

minuteUtc.description: Start of the minute, in UTC.

eventCount.description: Number of runtime events in that minute.

managerEventCount.description: Number of those events that are process manager events.

durationMilliseconds.description: Milliseconds between the first and the last event within that minute; 0 when the minute has one event.

ProcessRunRuntimeEventMinuteBucketApiVie.description: Runtime event statistics of one UTC minute of a run.

totalCount.description: Number of stored per-minute buckets across all pages.

offset.description: Number of buckets skipped before this page (the applied `runtimeEventMinuteOffset`).

hasMore.description: True when more buckets follow this page; request the next page with `runtimeEventMinuteOffset` increased by `take`.

ProcessRunRuntimeEventMinuteBucketPageAp.description: Paging of the per-minute runtime event statistics of a run record.

owningRunId.description: Identifier of the run that owns the step: the record's run or one of its child runs.

stepInstanceId.description: Identifier of the step within its run.

stepDefinitionId.description: Identifier of the step in the process definition.

stepKey.description: Key of the step in the process definition; at most 256 characters.

outcome.description: Status of the step when the facts were assembled, as text: `Pending` (planned, pending or ready), `Running` (claimed or running), `Waiting`, `Blocked`, `Completed`, `Failed`, `Cancelled` or `Skipped`; `Unknown` for an unrecognized status.

attemptCount.description: Number of execution attempts of the step.

participantId.description: Executor of the step assignment, or else the agent of the latest execution; null when neither is known.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow bound to the step; null for steps without a workflow.

dependencyStepIds.description: Identifiers of the steps this step depends on (`stepInstanceId` values); at most 256.

executionRunIds.description: Up to 64 identifiers of agent execution runs that executed the step.

startedAtUtc.description: Earliest start of an execution or claim of the step; null when the step never started.

endedAtUtc.description: Latest completion of an execution of the step; null when none completed.

durationMilliseconds.description: `endedAtUtc` minus `startedAtUtc` in milliseconds; null when either is missing or when the end precedes the start (warning `MissingStepTiming`).

inputTokenCount.description: Model input tokens attributed to the step.

cachedInputTokenCount.description: Part of the input tokens served from cache.

outputTokenCount.description: Model output tokens attributed to the step.

reasoningTokenCount.description: Reasoning tokens attributed to the step.

totalTokenCount.description: Total tokens attributed to the step, as reported by the providers.

estimatedCost.description: Estimated cost of the step in US dollars (see the record metrics); 0 can mean unpriced.

actualCost.description: Priced cost of the step in US dollars (see the record metrics); 0 can mean unpriced.

toolCallCount.description: Tool calls attributed to the step.

artifactCount.description: Number of artifacts attributed to the step.

ProcessRunStepFactApiView.description: Hard facts of one step of a run record.

totalCount.description: Number of stored steps across all pages.

offset.description: Number of steps skipped before this page (the applied `stepOffset`).

hasMore.description: True when more steps follow this page; request the next page with `stepOffset` increased by `take`.

ProcessRunStepPageApiView.description: Paging of the steps of a run record (`facts.stepPage`, `nodePage` of the graph).

slotId.description: Identifier of the artifact slot of the plan that the artifact fills.

artifactId.description: Identifier of the produced artifact instance.

contentHash.description: Hash of the artifact content: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

ProcessRuntimeArtifactLineageApiView.description: An artifact produced by a step result.

sourceStepKey.description: Key of the earlier step whose reported outcome decides the branch.

requiredOutcomeKey.description: Outcome key that the source step must report for this step to run, for example `repair-required`.

ProcessRuntimeBranchGateApiView.description: Branch condition of a process step: the step runs only when an earlier step reports a specific outcome.

requestedBy.description: Free-text label of the caller. Omitted or blank means `process-api`. It is not an identity: the runtime records its own actor and authorizes nothing by this value.

reason.description: Why the run is cancelled. Omitted or blank means a generic default text. It is handed to the components that stop active executions but is not stored with the run.

ProcessRuntimeCancelApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/processes/runs/{runId}/cancel`. Every member is optional, but the JSON object itself is required: send `{}` to use the defaults.

runId.description: Identifier of the process run (the route value).

kind.description: The operator action that was processed: always `CancelRun` for this operation.

outcome.description: `Applied` (the run is now Cancelled) or `Rejected` (the run had already ended, concurrent changes kept the cancellation from being saved, or child runs could not be cancelled yet; see `diagnostics`).

status.description: Runtime status of the run after the request, as text, with the values described for the dispatch response: `Cancelled` after success, `CancelRequested` while child runs still block the cancellation, or the unchanged status after other rejections.

diagnostics.description: Human-readable explanations, for example how many active agent executions were told to stop or which child runs are still pending. Not stable codes; text that looks like credentials, URL query strings and local file paths is removed; at most 32 entries.

ProcessRuntimeCancelApiResponse.description: Result of `POST /api/processes/runs/{runId}/cancel`. `outcome` says whether the run was cancelled; the HTTP status is 200 in every case once the run exists.

runId.description: Identifier of the run whose step produced the result.

stepInstanceId.description: Identifier of that step within the run.

stepKey.description: Key of the step in the process definition, or the step identifier as text.

strategyId.description: Identifier of the execution strategy (driver) that produced the result.

resultHash.description: Hash of the step result: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

code.description: Stable diagnostic code, for example `process.adapter.required_tool_receipt_missing`. A blocked or failed result without diagnostics is reported with `process.runtime.blocked_without_diagnostics`.

category.description: Category derived from the code when it is read: `Runtime` (`process.runtime.` codes), `Adapter` (`process.adapter.` codes), `Capability`, `Artifact`, `Provider` or `Strategy` (by keywords in the code), `Unknown` for an empty code, and `MissingDiagnostics` for the substitute diagnostic of a result without diagnostics.

safeSummary.description: Human-readable explanation that was checked when the result was accepted: at most 2,048 characters, without text that looks like credentials, URL query strings or local file paths.

sensitivity.description: `Normal` or `Restricted`. A restricted diagnostic may point to restricted evidence through `restrictedDiagnosticReference`; its safe summary is shown either way.

retrySafety.description: Whether repeating the step is considered safe: `SafeToRetry`, `UnsafeToRetry` or `Unknown`.

idempotency.description: Whether the step's effect is idempotent: `Idempotent`, `NonIdempotent` or `Unknown`.

restrictedDiagnosticReference.description: Opaque reference to restricted evidence, of the form `restricted://kind/value`, or null. No API operation resolves it.

oneOf.description: Structured guidance for known gate diagnostics (`process.adapter.` codes and a few runtime codes); null for other codes.

ProcessRuntimeDiagnosticApiView.description: A diagnostic reported with a step result, as shown by the live, detail and history projections.

gateId.description: Identifier of the gate that reported the diagnostic, derived from its code.

branchOutcomeKey.description: Branch outcome key named in the diagnostic's summary; empty when none is named.

routeTargetBranchOutcomeKey.description: For a completion issue routed to another branch, the target branch outcome key; empty otherwise.

failedCriteriaIds.description: Acceptance criteria identifiers named in the summary, such as `AC-012`; upper-case, distinct and sorted.

receiptRuleIds.description: Receipt rule identifiers (snake_case names) found in the summary; distinct and sorted.

nextAction.description: Fixed English guidance for the gate, for example to inspect the diagnostic and retry only after the gate is satisfied.

ProcessRuntimeOperatorDiagnosticDetailsA.description: Operator guidance derived from a gate diagnostic: which gate failed, which branch or criteria were involved, and what to do next.

decisionKind.description: Recovery decision, as text: `SafeRetry` (the step can be retried automatically), `ManagerRequired` (a process manager or operator must decide), `TerminalBlocked` (no automatic recovery) or `None`.

sourceDiagnosticCode.description: Code of the diagnostic the decision is based on.

policy.description: Recovery policy that was applied, for example `process.manager-review-required` or `process.terminal-failure`.

safeReason.description: English explanation of the decision for operators.

ProcessRuntimeRecoveryDecisionApiView.description: The runtime's recovery classification of a blocked or failed step result.

runId.description: Identifier of the run that owns the step.

stepInstanceId.description: Identifier of the step within the run.

stepKey.description: Key of the step in the process definition, or the step identifier as text.

strategyId.description: Identifier of the execution strategy (driver) that produced the result.

idempotencyKey.description: Key of the result submission: a second result with the same step, strategy and key is ignored as a duplicate.

outcome.description: Outcome reported by the strategy, as text: `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Waiting`, `NeedsManager` or `Canceled`.

appliedStepStatus.description: Step status that the runtime applied for the result, as text: `Completed` for Succeeded, `Failed` for Failed, `Blocked` for Waiting or NeedsManager, `Cancelled` for Canceled, and `Ready` when a blocked result was classified as safe to retry.

resultHash.description: Hash of the result: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

oneOf.description: How the runtime classified a blocked or failed result; null for other results.

ProcessRuntimeResultLineageApiView.description: One applied step result of a run, with what it produced and how the runtime reacted to it.

requestedBy.description: Free-text label of the caller, used to label the dispatch that is queued after the rework. Omitted or blank means `process-api`. It is not an identity: the runtime records its own actor and authorizes nothing by this value.

reason.description: The rework instruction: the concrete correction the step's executor must make, citing current evidence. It replaces the step's previous operator rework instruction and is given to the agent or workflow that executes the step next. Only surrounding whitespace is removed; there is no length limit and no redaction, so never include credentials or other secrets. Omitted or blank means a generic default text.

ProcessRuntimeReworkApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/processes/runs/{runId}/steps/{stepInstanceId}/rework`. The JSON object is required; its members are optional, but a rework without a specific `reason` gives the step's executor no guidance.

runId.description: Identifier of the process run (the route value).

stepInstanceId.description: Identifier of the step within the run (the route value).

kind.description: The operator action that was processed: always `RequestRework` for this operation.

outcome.description: `Applied` (the step was reset to Ready and queued), `Duplicate` (the step was already Ready in an active run; its instruction was still updated and the run queued) or `Rejected` (nothing changed; see `diagnostics`).

status.description: Runtime status of the run after the request, as text, with the values described for the dispatch response; after a successful rework it is `Active`.

diagnostics.description: Human-readable explanations, in particular the reason for a rejection. Not stable codes; text that looks like credentials, URL query strings and local file paths is removed; at most 32 entries.

ProcessRuntimeReworkApiResponse.description: Result of `POST /api/processes/runs/{runId}/steps/{stepInstanceId}/rework`. `outcome` says whether the step was reset; the HTTP status is 200 in every case once the run exists.

ProcessRuntimeStatus.description: Runtime status of a process run, as a JSON integer: 0 Created, 1 Active, 2 Waiting, 3 Blocked, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 CancelRequested, 7 Cancelled, 8 Escalated, 9 WaitingForUser.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of the runtime event.

globalSequence.description: Position of the event in the durable runtime event log shared by all runs; it grows with every stored event.

rootRunId.description: Identifier of the top-level run of the subprocess tree; equals `runId` for a top-level run.

runId.description: Identifier of the run the event belongs to.

eventType.description: Runtime event type name. Run events: `ProcessRunCreated`, `ProcessRunActivated`, `ProcessRunCancelRequested`, `ProcessRunCancelled`, `ProcessRunCompleted`, `ProcessRunFailed`, `ProcessRunBlocked`, `ProcessRunReactivated`. Step events: `StepReady`, `StepWaiting`, `StepClaimed`, `StepRunning`, `StepCompleted`, `StepFailed`, `StepBlocked`, `StepCancelled`, `StepSkipped`, `StepReworkRequested`. Dispatch claim events: `DispatchClaimCreated`, `DispatchLeaseRenewed`, `DispatchClaimExpired`, `DispatchClaimReleased`, `DispatchClaimReclaimed`, `DispatchClaimCompleted`. Process manager events: `ManagerIncidentRaised`, `ManagerRecoveryApproved`, `ManagerRecoveryDenied`, `ManagerBranchDecisionRecorded`, `ManagerBranchDecisionRejected`, `ManagerLoopBudgetEscalated`, `ManagerSubprocessMessageQueued`.

sensitivity.description: `Normal` or `Restricted`. For a restricted event the summary is a generic text and `restrictedDiagnosticReference` is set; the type, identifiers and time stay visible.

summary.description: The event type name for a normal event, or `Restricted runtime event`. For an attention event (`ProcessRunBlocked`, `StepBlocked`, `ProcessRunFailed`, `StepFailed`, `ManagerIncidentRaised`, `ManagerLoopBudgetEscalated`, `ManagerRecoveryDenied` or `ManagerBranchDecisionRejected`), the run's first current diagnostic is appended as `: {category} - {safeSummary}`.

restrictedDiagnosticReference.description: For a restricted event, `runtime-event:` followed by the event identifier, for correlation with operator records; no API operation resolves it. Null for a normal event.

diagnostics.description: For an attention event (see `summary`): the run's current diagnostics at the time of the read, not necessarily those recorded with this event. Empty for other events.

ProcessTimelineEventApiView.description: One projected runtime event of a process run in the history timeline.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow definition, as used by `/api/workflows`.

workflowVersionId.description: Exact workflow version that runs the step; null means the workflow's latest active version at execution time.

outputMapping.description: How the workflow result is used, as text. The only value is `ProcessStepOutcome`: the workflow's output JSON is validated as the step's outcome.

ProcessWorkflowBindingApiView.description: Workflow that executes a process step.

id.description: Identifier of the project.

ProjectAccessListItem.description: One project in the lightweight project list of `GET /api/projects/access-list`.

assignmentId.description: Identifier of the underlying project participation or task work assignment.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project.

projectName.description: Name of the project; empty when the project no longer exists or was recreated with the same identifier after the allocation was made.

partyDisplayName.description: Display name of the allocated party.

role.description: Role of the party in the project, as a JSON integer: 0 Customer, 1 CustomerContact, 2 DeliveryUnit, 3 TeamMember, 4 Manager, 5 Partner, 6 Vendor, 7 Stakeholder, 8 MeetingParticipant, 9 WorkItemAssignee (a task work assignment), 10 Reviewer, 11 AiAgent, 12 BillingContact, 13 TechnicalContact.

allocationPercent.description: Share of the party's capacity allocated, in percent.

startsOn.description: First day of the allocation as a UTC date (`yyyy-MM-dd`); null when open.

endsOn.description: Last day of the allocation as a UTC date (`yyyy-MM-dd`); null when open-ended.

notes.description: Free-text notes of the participation or assignment; empty when not set.

isActive.description: True when the current UTC date is within the allocation's dates; missing dates are open.

isFuture.description: True when the allocation starts after the current UTC date.

ProjectAllocationItemModel.description: A project allocation of a party as returned in the workforce workspace: a project participation or a task work assignment that carries an allocation percentage. Only allocations bound to the current lifetime of their project count in the capacity summary.

code.description: Stable code of the outcome, always `projects.delete-cleanup-pending`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation for operators and logs. Its wording can change.

recovery.description: The participant cleanups that did not finish, with the identifiers to use for `POST /api/projects/{projectId}/deletion-cleanups/{participantId}/{recoveryId}/retry`.

ProjectDeletionCleanupPendingApiResponse.description: Error body of a project deletion or cleanup retry that deleted the project but could not finish every participant cleanup (HTTP 409). Unlike the general `errors` envelope it carries the recovery details to retry.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project the cleanup was for.

operation.description: Kind of cleanup, as a JSON integer: 1 ProjectDeletion, 2 ProjectNodeCleanup.

warnings.description: Objects that the cleanup kept, with remediation; an empty array when nothing was kept.

ProjectDeletionCompletionNotice.description: A finished participant cleanup of a project and the objects it kept.

ProjectDeletionCompletionOperation.description: Kind of finished cleanup, as a JSON integer: 1 ProjectDeletion (cleanup after a project was deleted), 2 ProjectNodeCleanup (cleanup after nodes of a project were deleted in Project Structure).

value.description: Text identifier of the participant, currently `workbench` (Project Structure nodes and managed media) or `agent-project-structure-access` (agents' access to the project). Never null in responses.
