ProjectDeletionParticipantId.description: Identifier of a project-deletion participant, the module part that cleans up its own data after a project is deleted. It is serialized as an object with one member, for example `{ "value": "workbench" }`; send the `value` text as `participantId` in the cleanup retry route.

projectId.description: Identifier of the deleted project; use it in the retry route.

participantId.description: Participant that owns the cleanup; send its `value` in the retry route.

recoveryId.description: Recovery identifier of the cleanup; use it in the retry route.

status.description: State of the cleanup, as a JSON integer: 1 Pending, 2 Processing, 3 Failed, 4 Finalizing.

canRetryNow.description: False while another attempt is running and holds the cleanup; true otherwise.

retryAvailableAtUtc.description: When the hold of a processing attempt on the cleanup ends, in UTC; it can lie in the past. Null when no attempt holds the cleanup.

retryGuidance.description: English guidance of the participant, for display.

ProjectDeletionPendingCleanup.description: A participant cleanup of a deleted project that has not finished yet.

projectId.description: Identifier of the deleted project.

failures.description: The participant cleanups that did not finish; retry each of them.

retryGuidance.description: English guidance: retry each exact participant and recovery identifier and do not start a new project deletion.

ProjectDeletionRecovery.description: What remains to be done after a project deletion whose participant cleanups did not all finish. The project itself is deleted.

operation.description: Kind of unfinished step, as a JSON integer: 1 ParticipantCleanup.

participantId.description: Participant whose cleanup did not finish; send its `value` as `participantId` in the retry route.

recoveryId.description: Recovery identifier to send in the retry route.

ProjectDeletionRecoveryFailure.description: One participant cleanup of a deleted project that did not finish.

ProjectDeletionRecoveryOperation.description: Kind of project-deletion step that did not finish, as a JSON integer: 1 ParticipantCleanup (a deletion participant did not finish its cleanup).

ProjectDeletionRecoveryStatus.description: State of an unfinished participant cleanup of a deleted project, as a JSON integer: 1 Pending (recorded, not processed yet), 2 Processing (an attempt is running or still holds the cleanup), 3 Failed (the last attempt failed), 4 Finalizing (the participant reports its work as done).

projectId.description: Identifier of the deleted project.

warnings.description: Objects that were kept, with remediation; an empty array when nothing was kept.

ProjectDeletionResult.description: Result of a project deletion, or of a cleanup retry, in which every participant cleanup finished.

provider.description: Kind of storage provider that holds the object, as a JSON integer: 0 FileSystem, 1 Ipfs, 2 Ftp.

storageId.description: Identifier of the configured storage that holds the object; null when not recorded.

locatorKind.description: How `locator` is to be read, as a JSON integer: 0 RelativePath, 1 ContentAddress, 2 RemotePath, 3 AbsoluteUrl.

locator.description: Provider-specific reference to the object, for example a path relative to the storage root or an IPFS content address.

reason.description: Explanation of why the object was kept, for display.

ProjectDeletionRetainedObjectDescriptor.description: A stored object that a project deletion kept, with the reason.

kind.description: Kind of kept object, as a JSON integer: 1 ManagedStorageRetainedByProvider, 2 ManagedStorageRetainedWithoutOwnershipProof.

recoveryId.description: Recovery identifier of the participant cleanup that reported the object.

message.description: English explanation, for display; its wording can change.

remediation.description: What an operator can do about the object, in English, for display.

ProjectDeletionWarning.description: An object that a deletion participant kept while cleaning up after a project deletion, with guidance for operators.

ProjectDeletionWarningKind.description: Kind of object that a project deletion kept, as a JSON integer: 1 ManagedStorageRetainedByProvider (managed media kept by an immutable storage provider such as IPFS; no cleanup retry is needed), 2 ManagedStorageRetainedWithoutOwnershipProof (legacy managed media kept because the project's ownership of it could not be proven; migrate or remove it manually after checking ownership).

id.description: Identifier of the project; null for a new project, including the blank template that the read returns for an unknown identifier. A save with an identifier that does not exist is rejected (`projects.not-found`).

expectedLifetimeId.description: Identifier of the project lifetime that the read returned. Send it back unchanged: a save is rejected (`projects.lifetime-changed`) when the project was deleted and recreated with the same identifier since the read. Null skips the check; ignored when creating a project.

name.description: Name of the project; required on save and trimmed.

description.description: Description of the project; trimmed.

status.description: Lifecycle status, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 OnHold, 3 Completed, 4 Archived. Omitted means Draft.

currentPhase.description: Name of the current phase as free text; trimmed. It is not linked to the `phases` list.

targetDateUtc.description: Target completion date and time in UTC. A sent value with an offset is converted to UTC and a value without an offset is taken as UTC. Null means none.

phases.description: The project's phases in order. On save the list replaces the stored phases: phases missing from it are deleted.

options.description: The project's technology options. On save the list replaces the stored options: options missing from it are deleted. A read always includes an entry for each of the categories Language through Testing.

ProjectEditorModel.description: The editable fields of a project, returned by `GET /api/projects/{projectId}` and sent to `POST /api/projects`. Without `id` it describes a new project. Changes to subprojects, tasks and project participants use other operations.

createdAtUtc.description: When the link was created, in UTC.

ProjectHierarchyLinkSummary.description: A parent-child link between two projects in the project hierarchy.

projectId.description: Identifier of the requested project.

parentProjects.description: Summaries of the direct parent projects, most recently updated first.

childProjects.description: Summaries of the direct subprojects, most recently updated first.

ProjectHierarchySnapshot.description: The direct parents and direct subprojects of one project, as returned by the project hierarchy reads.

ProjectManagementGuidanceCategory.description: Category of project-management guidance, as a JSON integer: 0 Mission, 1 Planning, 2 Estimation, 3 Approval, 4 Reporting, 5 Risk, 6 Collaboration.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entry, for example `planning-split-work`.

category.description: Category, as a JSON integer: 0 Mission, 1 Planning, 2 Estimation, 3 Approval, 4 Reporting, 5 Risk, 6 Collaboration.

summary.description: One-sentence summary.

isMissionAnchor.description: True for the entry that states the mission behind all project work; listed first.

categories.description: Categories to keep, as JSON integers (0 Mission, 1 Planning, 2 Estimation, 3 Approval, 4 Reporting, 5 Risk, 6 Collaboration); an entry matches when it has any of them. Null or empty keeps every category.

query.description: Text to search for in titles, summaries, guidance and tags, ignoring case (substring match); null or blank matches everything.

take.description: Maximum number of entries; clamped to 1 through 50. Defaults to 10.

ProjectManagementGuidanceQueryRequest.description: Filters for the project-management guidance query. Every member is optional.

entries.description: Matching entries: mission anchors first, then by category and title; empty when nothing matched.

ProjectManagementGuidanceResponse.description: Result of a project-management guidance query.

ProjectObjectLinkKind.description: Meaning of a directed link between two project structure nodes, as a JSON integer. 0 Contains (parent-child containment maintained by the owner; set it through a parent node key or a reparent operation), 1 DependsOn (a task or scheduling prerequisite: the source depends on the target), 2 Uses (the source consumes, references or needs the target), 3 Validates (validation evidence or a validation run validates the target), 4 Tests (a test plan or test evidence tests the target), 5 Blocks (the source blocks the target without being a direct schedule prerequisite), 6 DerivedFrom (the source is a revision or derivation of the target), 7 BelongsTo (a parent relationship maintained by the owner; set it through a parent node key or a reparent operation).

fileName.description: File name to store, for example `diagram.png`; required, a blank name is rejected with HTTP 400 `FileNameRequired`.

contentType.description: Media type of the content, for example `image/png`.

base64Data.description: The file content, base64-encoded; required. Blank content is rejected with HTTP 400 `MediaPayloadRequired` and invalid base64 with HTTP 400 `InvalidBase64Payload`.

ProjectObjectMediaPayload.description: Inline file content sent with a request, for example for an asset, an asset revision, a node with a picture or an imported document. Node creation, asset creation and asset revisions reject decoded content over 25 MiB with HTTP 413 `MediaPayloadTooLarge`.

ProjectObjectType.description: Kind of object a project structure node represents. Project Structure responses write it as its name, for example `"WorkItem"`; the request bodies that Project Structure reads itself (structure read, checklist query, node creation, update and type change, asset creation) accept the name in any casing or the integer; other request bodies and other API families use the JSON integer. Values: 0 ProjectRoot (a project node: the project's own root, a subproject or a parent project; created only by the owner), 1 Phase, 2 Milestone, 3 ProjectBlock (a typed block such as feature, delivery or backlog), 4 Meeting, 5 Recording, 6 Transcript, 7 Participant, 8 WorkItem (tasks, issues, feedback, payments, revisions and send items; subtype `task` is a canonical task), 9 Repository (folder, local or remote repository), 10 File, 11 ImageAsset, 12 VideoAsset, 13 Link (web link), 14 Connector, 15 Script (runtime script), 16 Environment (language runtime), 17 Infrastructure, 18 PromptFlow, 19 PromptSession, 20 PromptStep, 21 ProcessDefinition, 22 ProcessRun, 23 WorkflowDefinition, 24 WorkflowRun, 25 ValidationRun (these five are created only by the owner), 26 TestPlan, 27 TestEvidence, 28 Note, 29 Decision, 30 SecretReference.

ProjectOptionCategory.description: Category of a project technology option, as a JSON integer: 0 Language, 1 Database, 2 Ui, 3 ExternalApi, 4 Storage, 5 Deployment, 6 Testing, 7 Other.

id.description: Identifier of the option; null for an option to add and for the empty category entries of a read. On save, stored options missing from the request are deleted.

category.description: Category of the option, as a JSON integer: 0 Language, 1 Database, 2 Ui, 3 ExternalApi, 4 Storage, 5 Deployment, 6 Testing, 7 Other.

optionName.description: The chosen option, for example `PostgreSQL`; trimmed. An entry with an empty name and empty notes is skipped on save.

notes.description: Notes about the choice; trimmed.

ProjectOptionEditorModel.description: A technology option of a project, such as its programming language or database, in the project read and save.

ProjectPartyAssignmentRole.description: Role of a party in a project, as a JSON integer: 0 Customer, 1 CustomerContact, 2 DeliveryUnit, 3 TeamMember, 4 Manager, 5 Partner, 6 Vendor, 7 Stakeholder, 8 MeetingParticipant, 9 WorkItemAssignee (assigned to work on a task of the project), 10 Reviewer, 11 AiAgent, 12 BillingContact, 13 TechnicalContact.

ProjectPartyPortfolioCategory.description: Group of a project participant in project summaries, as a JSON integer: 0 Customer, 1 DeliveryUnit, 2 Owner (participating managers, team members and reviewers), 3 Stakeholder (every other participation role), 4 Partner, 5 AiAgent.

id.description: Identifier of the phase; null for a phase to add. On save, an entry whose identifier matches a stored phase of the project updates it, and stored phases missing from the request are deleted.

goal.description: What the phase should achieve, as free text; trimmed.

status.description: Status of the phase, as a JSON integer: 0 Planned, 1 Active, 2 Blocked, 3 Completed. Omitted means Planned.

startDateUtc.description: Start of the phase as a UTC date and time. A sent value with an offset is converted to UTC and a value without an offset is taken as UTC. Null means not set.

endDateUtc.description: End of the phase as a UTC date and time, converted like `startDateUtc`; not checked against the start. Null means not set.

ProjectPhaseEditorModel.description: A phase of a project in the project read and save. Phases are stored in array order.

ProjectPhaseStatus.description: Status of a project phase, as a JSON integer: 0 Planned, 1 Active, 2 Blocked, 3 Completed.

missingScheduleTaskCount.description: Tasks without a complete planned interval.

invalidScheduleTaskCount.description: Tasks with both planned instants whose interval is not valid, for example an end before the start.

missingProgressTaskCount.description: Tasks without tracked progress (cancelled tasks excluded).

invalidProgressTaskCount.description: Tasks with a progress value that cannot be used.

invalidMetadataTaskCount.description: Tasks whose metadata cannot be read.

mixedResourceTaskCount.description: Tasks bound to resources of several groups.

dependencyCycleAffectedTaskCount.description: Tasks that take part in a dependency cycle.

ProjectPlanDataCompleteness.description: Counts of tasks whose plan data is missing or unusable, to judge how reliable the summary is.

currencyCode.description: Currency of the amount, for example `EUR`.

amount.description: Sum of the tasks' expected cost amounts in this currency.

pricedTaskCount.description: Number of tasks with an expected cost in this currency.

ProjectPlanExpectedCostTotal.description: Sum of the expected cost of all tasks priced in one currency; currencies are never converted.

date.description: Date (UTC, `yyyy-MM-dd`) the cost is attributed to: the task's planned end, or the later of its planned start and the reference instant when the end is not later.

group.description: Resource group, as a JSON integer: 0 Person, 1 Agent, 2 Workflow, 3 Process, 4 Unassigned, 5 Mixed, 6 External.

amount.description: Remaining expected cost attributed to this date.

ProjectPlanExpectedCostTrendPoint.description: Remaining expected cost attributed to one date for one resource group and currency, for a cost-over-time chart.

group.description: Resource group, as a JSON integer: 0 Person, 1 Agent, 2 Workflow, 3 Process, 4 Unassigned, 5 Mixed, 6 External.

amount.description: Sum of the remaining expected cost.

pricedTaskCount.description: Number of unfinished tasks that contribute a remaining cost.

ProjectPlanExpectedResourceCostTotal.description: Remaining expected cost of the unfinished tasks of one resource group in one currency. A task's remaining cost is its expected cost multiplied by its remaining progress share (the full amount when progress is unknown).

ProjectPlanResourceGroup.description: Kind of resource a task is bound to in a plan summary, as a JSON integer: 0 Person, 1 Agent, 2 Workflow, 3 Process, 4 Unassigned (no resource), 5 Mixed (several kinds), 6 External (another kind of binding).

group.description: Resource group, as a JSON integer: 0 Person, 1 Agent, 2 Workflow, 3 Process, 4 Unassigned, 5 Mixed, 6 External.

bindingCount.description: Number of task resource bindings of this group.

bindingSharePercent.description: Share of all task resource bindings that belong to this group, as a percentage.

coveredTaskCount.description: Number of tasks with at least one binding of this group.

taskCoveragePercent.description: Share of all tasks covered by this group, as a percentage.

exclusiveTaskCount.description: Number of tasks bound only to this group.

ProjectPlanResourceGroupSummary.description: How tasks are bound to one kind of resource in the plan.

earliestStartUtc.description: Earliest planned start of a scheduled task; null when none is scheduled.

latestEndUtc.description: Latest planned end of a scheduled task; null when none is scheduled.

deliveryLeadTimeHours.description: Hours from the earliest planned start to the latest planned end; null when either is missing.

scheduledTaskDurationHours.description: Sum of the planned interval lengths of the scheduled tasks, in hours.

ProjectPlanScheduleSummary.description: Planned time span of a project's tasks.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project.

projectName.description: Name of the project at the time of the query.

asOfUtc.description: Reference instant (UTC, with offset) the summary was computed for.

totalTaskCount.description: Number of canonical tasks in the project.

taskStates.description: Number and share of tasks in each plan state.

schedule.description: Planned time span of the tasks.

totalExpectedEffortHours.description: Sum of the tasks' expected effort, in hours; tasks without effort count as 0.

taskWeightedProgressPercent.description: Average progress of the tasks with tracked progress (cancelled tasks excluded), rounded to two decimals; null when no task has tracked progress.

effortWeightedProgressPercent.description: Progress weighted by expected effort, over tasks with both tracked progress and expected effort, rounded to two decimals; null when there is no such task.

expectedCostTotals.description: Total expected cost per currency over all tasks; currencies are never converted.

futureExpectedCostTotals.description: Remaining expected cost of unfinished tasks per resource group and currency.

futureExpectedCostTrend.description: Remaining expected cost per date, resource group and currency.

unscheduledFutureExpectedCostTaskCount.description: Number of unfinished tasks with remaining cost but no planned start, so they are missing from the trend.

resourceGroups.description: Task resource coverage per resource group.

runningTasks.description: Running tasks, at most the query's `taskPreviewLimit`.

blockedTasks.description: Blocked tasks, at most the query's `taskPreviewLimit`.

waitingTasks.description: Waiting tasks, at most the query's `taskPreviewLimit`.

completeness.description: Counts of tasks with missing or unusable plan data.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes about data problems that affect the summary; empty when there are none.

ProjectPlanSummary.description: Plan summary of one project computed from its canonical tasks (WorkItem nodes with subtype `task`): task states, schedule, effort, progress, expected and remaining cost, resource coverage, previews of running, blocked and waiting tasks, and data completeness. A computed snapshot as of `asOfUtc`; nothing is stored.

asOfUtc.description: Reference instant (with offset) for classifying tasks as running, ready or planned and for the future-cost trend; null or omitted means now. Converted to UTC.

taskPreviewLimit.description: Maximum number of tasks listed in each of `runningTasks`, `blockedTasks` and `waitingTasks`, from 0 through 100 (HTTP 400 `PlanSummaryQueryInvalid` otherwise). Defaults to 20.

hoursPerManDay.description: Hours per man-day used for `totalExpectedEffortManDays` and for estimates entered in man-days, from 1 through 24 (HTTP 400 `PlanSummaryQueryInvalid` otherwise). Defaults to 8.

ProjectPlanSummaryQuery.description: Plan summary query for one project. Every member is optional; `{}` summarizes the plan as of now with up to 20 tasks in each task preview and 8 hours per man-day.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the canonical task, as in `nodes[].id`.

state.description: Plan state, as a JSON integer: 0 Unscheduled, 1 Planned, 2 Ready, 3 Running, 4 Waiting, 5 Blocked, 6 Completed, 7 Cancelled.

sourceStatus.description: The task's free-text status as stored.

startUtc.description: Planned start as an instant with offset; null when not scheduled.

endUtc.description: Planned end as an instant with offset; null when not scheduled.

progressPercent.description: Progress from 0 through 100; null when the task has no usable progress.

expectedEffortHours.description: Expected effort in hours; null when not estimated.

expectedCostAmount.description: Expected cost amount; null when not priced.

expectedCostCurrencyCode.description: Currency of the expected cost; empty when not priced.

blockingTaskCount.description: Number of unfinished tasks that block this task.

blockingTaskNodeIds.description: Identifiers of the unfinished tasks that block this task.

resourceGroups.description: Resource groups the task is bound to, as JSON integers (0 Person, 1 Agent, 2 Workflow, 3 Process, 4 Unassigned, 5 Mixed, 6 External); `[4]` (Unassigned) when none.

ProjectPlanTaskPreview.description: One task listed in a plan summary preview (running, blocked or waiting tasks).

ProjectPlanTaskState.description: Plan state of a canonical task in a plan summary, as a JSON integer. A recorded execution state takes precedence over the status text. 0 Unscheduled (no complete planned interval), 1 Planned (starts after the reference instant), 2 Ready (planned start reached, not started), 3 Running (started, or in progress by status, progress or planned interval), 4 Waiting (status waiting, on hold, paused or stopped), 5 Blocked (an unfinished DependsOn or Blocks prerequisite, or status blocked), 6 Completed, 7 Cancelled.

state.description: Plan state, as a JSON integer: 0 Unscheduled, 1 Planned, 2 Ready, 3 Running, 4 Waiting, 5 Blocked, 6 Completed, 7 Cancelled.

taskCount.description: Number of tasks in this state.

taskRatioPercent.description: Share of all tasks in this state, as a percentage.

ProjectPlanTaskStateSummary.description: Number and share of the plan's tasks in one plan state.

category.description: Group of the participant, as a JSON integer: 0 Customer, 1 DeliveryUnit, 2 Owner, 3 Stakeholder, 4 Partner, 5 AiAgent.

label.description: English label of the participation role, for example `Customer contact`, for display.

displayName.description: Display name of the participating party.

isPrimary.description: True when the participation is marked as primary.

ProjectPortfolioPartyItem.description: A party that participates in a project as a whole, as listed in a project summary.

intentId.description: Business intent of the process step that created the asset.

nativeObjectId.description: Identifier of the created project object record.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the created node, as in `nodes[].id`.

storageIntentId.description: Storage placement intent that stored the asset's file.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the committed asset request, used to recognize a repeated intent.

committedAtUtc.description: Instant (UTC, with offset) when the asset was committed.

ProjectProcessAssetReceipt.description: Receipt of an asset that a process step created in a project structure: the step's business intent, the created node and the storage placement of its file. Only process runs executing inside the application receive it; the Project Structure HTTP API does not return it.

wasReplay.description: True when the call returned an earlier commit of the same intent instead of a new one.

targetDeleted.description: True when the node created for the receipt no longer exists.

storageObservationWarning.description: Warning about the stored file's placement when it could not be confirmed; null when there is none.

ProjectProcessAssetReceiptObservation.description: Receipt of a process step's asset as observed by the call that returned it. Only process runs executing inside the application receive it; the Project Structure HTTP API omits it.

currentParentProjectId.description: Identifier of the parent project the subproject is linked to now; the link must exist.

newParentProjectId.description: Identifier of the existing project that becomes the new parent; must differ from `currentParentProjectId`.

ProjectReconnectSubprojectApiRequest.description: Request of `POST /api/projects/{childProjectId}/reconnect-subproject`: the parent to leave and the parent to join.

ProjectResourceRateUnit.description: Time unit that a cost or billing rate of a person or resource refers to, as a JSON integer: 0 Hour, 1 ManDay.

ProjectStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a project, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 OnHold, 3 Completed, 4 Archived. The status is a label chosen when the project is saved: it filters and labels projects but does not lock a project against changes or delete anything.

id.description: Identifier of the log entry.

operationName.description: Name of the operation, for example `structure.read`, `tasks.create` or `leases.acquire`. Agent tools use the same names for the same operations.

projectId.description: Project named by the call's route or body; null for calls without one, including lease calls (see `scopeKey`).

nodeKey.description: Node identifier named by the call's route; null when it had none.

oneOf.description: Lease scope the call is attributed to, as a JSON integer: 0 Project, 1 ProjectNode, 2 RepoBranch. Lease calls record the requested scope and project mutations record their project; null for reads.

scopeKey.description: Lease scope key the call is attributed to, as sent; null for reads.

agentId.description: Caller identity: for HTTP calls, the bearer token subject or `local-api-operator` when API authorization is disabled; for agent tool calls, the agent's identifier.

agentName.description: Display name of the caller, for example `Local API operator`.

machineName.description: Machine name recorded for the caller; for HTTP calls, the name of the server machine.

repositoryRoot.description: Repository root recorded for the caller: empty for HTTP calls; for agent tool calls, a directory path on the server.

branchName.description: Branch name recorded for the caller; empty for HTTP calls.

durationMs.description: Duration of the call's work in milliseconds.

warningCount.description: Number of warnings the call returned; 0 for a failed call.

errorCode.description: Error code of a failed call, as returned in `error.errorCode`; null for a success.

errorMessage.description: Error message of a failed call; null for a success. For `UnhandledError` it records the internal failure message rather than the generic message returned to the caller.

requestSummaryJson.description: The call's request body as a JSON string that contains JSON; `{}` for calls without a body or whose body could not be read. The current-lease lookup records its query values instead.

responseSummaryJson.description: The call's response as a JSON string that contains JSON; a plan summary is recorded in shortened form. For a failed call, the error details, or `{}` when there were none.

warningsJson.description: The call's warnings as a JSON string that contains an array of strings.

occurredAtUtc.description: Time the call finished and was recorded, in UTC.

ProjectStructureAnalyticsEntry.description: One recorded call of a Project Structure operation, successful or failed, made over this HTTP API or by an in-process agent tool. Entries contain the complete request and response as JSON text and can therefore hold anything those contained, such as notes, metadata, inline file content and lease tokens.

projectId.description: Keep only entries of this project; null keeps every project.

operationName.description: Keep only entries of this operation, compared exactly, for example `structure.read`, `tasks.create` or `leases.acquire`; null or blank keeps every operation.

agentId.description: Keep only calls by this caller identity, compared exactly (see `agentId` of the entries); null or blank keeps every caller.

succeeded.description: True for successful calls only, false for failed calls only, null for both.

take.description: Maximum number of entries, newest first; clamped to 1 through 200. Defaults to 50.

ProjectStructureAnalyticsQueryRequest.description: Filters for the Project Structure operation log. Every member is optional; the filters combine, and `{}` returns the 50 most recent entries of all projects.

entries.description: Matching entries; empty when none matched.

ProjectStructureAnalyticsResponse.description: Entries of the Project Structure operation log, newest first.

title.description: Title of the request; required, not blank.

subtitle.description: Secondary display text; may be empty.

notes.description: Free-text details for the approver; may be empty.

requestedOperation.description: Description of the operation that needs approval; required, not blank. It is stored in the generated metadata.

parentNodeKey.description: Identifier of the parent node, as returned in `nodes[].id`; null or blank places the request under the project root.

estimatedMinutes.description: Optional estimate, in minutes, of how long the requested operation takes; stored in the generated metadata without validation.

metadataJson.description: Optional metadata as a JSON string that contains a JSON object. When sent, it is stored instead of the generated `approvalRequest` metadata (requested operation, estimated minutes, requesting identity and time), so those values are then not recorded.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureApprovalRequestCreateInp.description: Approval request to record in a project structure: a Decision node with subtype `approval-request` that describes an operation waiting for someone's approval. Creating it blocks or starts nothing by itself.

asset.description: Metadata of the asset whose content was read.

contentLength.description: Size of the file content in bytes (before base64 encoding).

base64Data.description: The complete file content, base64-encoded (standard alphabet, with padding).

base64DataOmitted.description: True when `base64Data` was left out on purpose. Always false in this API, which returns the complete content.

contentSummary.description: Short description of the content used when `base64Data` is left out; always empty in this API.

ProjectStructureAssetContentDescriptor.description: Content of a stored asset: its metadata and the complete file content as base64 text.

objectType.description: Object type as its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`) or its integer from 0 through 30.

title.description: Title of the new asset node.

subtitle.description: Secondary display text; may be empty.

notes.description: Free-text notes; may be empty.

oneOf.description: Inline file content. When sent, `sourceWorkspacePath` and `sourceUrl` are ignored.

parentNodeKey.description: Identifier of the parent node, as returned in `nodes[].id`; required (use `project:{projectId}` for the project root). A missing value is rejected with HTTP 400 `AssetParentRequired`.

objectSubtype.description: Lower-case subtype, for example `pdf`, `markdown` or `mermaid` for a File; known synonyms are normalized.

metadataJson.description: Optional metadata as a JSON string that contains a JSON object.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

sourceWorkspacePath.description: Used when `media` is absent: path, relative to the server's managed workspace, of an existing file to copy into the asset, without `.` or `..` segments. A path outside the workspace is rejected with HTTP 400 `SourceWorkspacePathInvalid`, a path under another project's managed folder with HTTP 403 `SourceWorkspaceScopeDenied`, and a missing file with HTTP 404 `SourceWorkspaceFileNotFound`. An http or https URL here is downloaded like `sourceUrl`.

sourceFileName.description: File name to store for a workspace or URL source; when omitted, the name is taken from the source.

sourceContentType.description: Media type to store for a workspace or URL source, for example `application/pdf`; when omitted, it is derived from the file name.

sourceUrl.description: Used when `media` and `sourceWorkspacePath` are absent: absolute http or https URL of a public host to download the content from, without embedded credentials. At most 5 redirects, 60 seconds and 25 MiB are allowed.

ProjectStructureAssetCreateInput.description: Asset creation request: a new File, ImageAsset or VideoAsset node under an explicit parent, with its content taken from exactly one source, in this order of precedence: `media` (inline base64), `sourceWorkspacePath` (a file in the server's managed workspace) or `sourceUrl` (a download from a public web address). The content is stored as a managed file of the project.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project that contains the asset.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the asset node, as in `nodes[].id`.

objectType.description: Asset type: File, ImageAsset or VideoAsset.

objectSubtype.description: Lower-case subtype, for example `pdf`; empty when none.

subtitle.description: Secondary display text; may be empty.

route.description: Application route that shows the asset in the web UI; informational.

mediaRelativePath.description: Location of the stored file within the application's managed storage; empty for content held only by a storage provider reference. Not a path on the client's machine.

mediaContentType.description: Content type recorded for the file, for example `image/png`.

mediaOriginalFileName.description: Original file name recorded for the file.

metadataJson.description: Asset metadata as a JSON string that contains a JSON object; `"{}"` when there is none.

isReadonly.description: Always true: stored asset content is never changed in place; create a revision instead.

revisionParentNodeId.description: Identifier of the asset this one revises (its parent node, linked with DerivedFrom); null when it is not a revision.

oneOf.description: Receipt that ties the asset to the process step that created it. Only process runs executing inside the application set it; the Project Structure HTTP API omits this member.

ProjectStructureAssetDescriptor.description: Metadata of a stored asset node (File, ImageAsset or VideoAsset): what it is, where its file is stored and which asset it revises. It does not contain the file content and does not prove that the content is still readable; read the content with `GET /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/assets/{nodeId}/content`.

title.description: Title of the new revision node.

subtitle.description: Secondary display text; may be empty.

notes.description: Free-text notes; may be empty.

media.description: Inline content of the revision; always send it. A null value is not rejected up front: the revision node is created without content and the request then fails with HTTP 400 `AssetRequired`, leaving that node in the structure.

objectSubtype.description: Lower-case subtype of the revision; null or blank keeps the original's subtype.

metadataJson.description: Metadata of the revision as a JSON string that contains a JSON object; null or blank copies the original's metadata.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureAssetRevisionRequest.description: Asset revision request: new content for an existing asset, stored as a new asset node of the same type under the original and linked to it with DerivedFrom. The original asset and its content stay unchanged.

sourceNodeId.description: Identifier of the link's source node.

targetNodeId.description: Identifier of the link's target node.

linkKind.description: Kind of the deleted link, as a JSON integer: 0 Contains, 1 DependsOn, 2 Uses, 3 Validates, 4 Tests, 5 Blocks, 6 DerivedFrom, 7 BelongsTo.

isSystemManaged.description: True when the application had created the link rather than a user.

ProjectStructureBoundaryLinkRemoval.description: A link deleted by a transfer because it connected a moved node with a node that stayed in the source project.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node, as in `nodes[].id` of the structure read.

parentNodeId.description: Identifier of the node's parent; null for a top-level node.

objectType.description: Kind of project object the node represents.

objectSubtype.description: Lower-case subtype of the node; empty when none.

status.description: Free-text status of the node.

progressMode.description: How progress is expressed: `complete`, `started`, `progress`, `na`, or empty when not tracked.

progressPercent.description: Progress from 0 through 100, or -1 when not tracked.

markerLabel.description: Label of the node's primary marker; empty when none.

priority.description: Priority set on the node itself: 0 means none; smaller positive values are more urgent.

effectivePriority.description: Priority used for ordering, from 0 (none) through 6, including the most urgent priority of unfinished descendants.

route.description: Application route that shows the node in the web UI; informational.

prerequisites.description: Prerequisites of the node that are not finished yet; empty when it can start.

ProjectStructureChecklistItem.description: One open item of a project checklist: an unfinished node with its status, progress, priority and unfinished prerequisites.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the prerequisite node, as in `nodes[].id` of the structure read.

status.description: Free-text status of the prerequisite node.

effectivePriority.description: Effective priority of the prerequisite node, from 0 (none) through 6.

reason.description: Why it is a prerequisite: `parent` (an unfinished ancestor below the project root), `depends-on` (the item has a DependsOn link to it) or `blocked-by` (it has a Blocks link to the item).

ProjectStructureChecklistPrerequisite.description: One unfinished prerequisite of a checklist item.

maxPriority.description: Keep only items whose effective priority is from 1 through this value (1 is the most urgent); items without a priority (0) are dropped. Null applies no priority filter.

items.description: Object type as its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`) or its integer from 0 through 30.

objectTypes.description: Object types to keep, each as its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`) or its integer from 0 through 30; null or an empty array keeps every type. Null items are rejected.

includePaused.description: True to also return paused or stopped nodes: nodes whose status contains paused, on hold, onhold, stopped or cancel, or whose marker label contains pause, hold, stop or wait. Defaults to false.

take.description: Maximum number of items, applied after ordering; a cut result adds a warning. A value below 1 is treated as 1. Null returns every item.

ProjectStructureChecklistRequest.description: Checklist query: filters for the list of open work in a project. Every member is optional; the empty object `{}` returns every unfinished node except project nodes (the project root, subprojects and parent projects) and paused or stopped nodes, most urgent first.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project.

projectName.description: Name of the project at the time of the query.

items.description: Open items after filtering; empty when nothing is open.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes, for example that the list was cut to `take` items.

ProjectStructureChecklistResponse.description: Checklist of a project: its unfinished nodes ordered by effective priority (nodes without a priority last) and then by title.

ProjectStructureCommandKind.description: Command resolved for a project structure node, as a JSON integer: 0 Open, 1 Wizard, 2 Branch, 3 Test, 4 Skip, 5 MarkUsed. Test returns the project's Test Lab. Open and Wizard return the node's page and, for prompt nodes, first create the node's Prompt Gallery prompt when it has none. Branch, Skip and MarkUsed return the node's page without other effects.

linkId.description: Identifier of the original link record.

sourceNodeId.description: Identifier of the original link's source node.

targetNodeId.description: Identifier of the original link's target node.

linkKind.description: Meaning of the link, as a JSON integer: 0 Contains, 1 DependsOn, 2 Uses, 3 Validates, 4 Tests, 5 Blocks, 6 DerivedFrom, 7 BelongsTo.

ProjectStructureCopyOmittedLink.description: Caller-created link that a subtree copy did not copy because one end lies outside the copied set. The original link is unchanged.

ProjectStructureDeletionCommitState.description: How far a deletion that needs follow-up got, as a JSON integer. Its only value is 1 WorkbenchCommitted: the nodes are already removed from the project structure and only the cleanup of related records and files is outstanding.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project the deletion belongs to.

rootNodeId.description: Identifier of the deleted subtree's root node.

durableMutationId.description: Identifier of the deletion's durable cleanup, a GUID assigned by the owner.

warnings.description: Managed files the deletion kept, with reasons; never empty in a listed notice.

ProjectStructureDeletionCompletionNotice.description: A completed node deletion that kept managed files, listed by `GET /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/deletion-completion-notices`. Notices stay listed; reading them does not acknowledge or remove them.

ProjectStructureDeletionReconciliationSt.description: Status of the durable cleanup that follows a node deletion, as a JSON integer. 0 Pending (recorded, not started), 1 WorkbenchCommitted (the structure change is committed and the cleanup is outstanding), 2 Completed, 3 Processing (an attempt is running), 4 Failed (the last attempt failed; retry it).

projectId.description: Identifier of the project the deletion belongs to.

rootNodeId.description: Identifier of the deleted subtree's root node; the node no longer appears in reads.

durableMutationId.description: Identifier of the durable cleanup, a GUID assigned by the owner. Send it as `durableMutationId` to retry the cleanup.

durableMutationStatus.description: Cleanup status, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 WorkbenchCommitted, 2 Completed, 3 Processing, 4 Failed.

commitState.description: Deletion progress, as a JSON integer; always 1 WorkbenchCommitted (the nodes are already removed).

canRetryNow.description: True when a retry can start now; false while another attempt is running and its processing lease has not expired.

retryAvailableAtUtc.description: Instant (UTC, with offset) from which a retry can start while an attempt is running; null when a retry can start at any time.

retryGuidance.description: Human-readable instruction for retrying this cleanup.

managedStorageDisposition.description: Managed-file choice recorded for this deletion, as its name: `RetainManagedFiles` or `DeleteOwnedManagedFiles`. A retry must send the same value.

ProjectStructureDeletionRecovery.description: A node deletion whose structure change is committed but whose cleanup of related records and managed files is not complete. Listed by `GET /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/deletion-cleanups` and returned in the `details` of HTTP 409 `ProjectStructureDeletionPartialCommit`. Finish it by sending `POST /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/nodes/{rootNodeId}/delete` with this `durableMutationId` and the same `managedStorageDisposition`; never start a new deletion of the same root instead.

deletedNodeCount.description: Number of nodes removed, including the descendants of each deleted node.

deletionWarnings.description: Managed files that were kept, with reasons; empty when none.

warnings.description: The same warnings as plain text, each message followed by its remediation; empty when none.

ProjectStructureDeletionResult.description: Result of a committed node deletion: how many nodes were removed and which managed files were kept.

kind.description: Why the file was kept, as a JSON integer: 1 ManagedStorageRetainedByProvider, 2 ManagedStorageRetainedWithoutOwnershipProof.

retainedObject.description: Description of the stored object that was kept.

message.description: Human-readable description of what was kept and why.

remediation.description: Human-readable suggestion for dealing with the kept file.

ProjectStructureDeletionWarning.description: A managed file that a committed node deletion did not delete, with the reason and what to do about it.

ProjectStructureDeletionWarningKind.description: Why a deletion kept a managed file, as a JSON integer. 1 ManagedStorageRetainedByProvider (the storage provider kept the object), 2 ManagedStorageRetainedWithoutOwnershipProof (the file was kept because the project's ownership of it could not be proven).

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node, as in `nodes[].id` of the structure read.

parentNodeId.description: Identifier of the node's parent; null for a top-level node.

objectType.description: Kind of project object the node represents.

objectSubtype.description: Lower-case subtype of the node; empty when none.

status.description: Free-text status of the node.

progressMode.description: How progress is expressed: `complete`, `started`, `progress`, `na`, or empty when not tracked.

progressPercent.description: Progress from 0 through 100, or -1 when not tracked.

markerLabel.description: Label of the node's primary marker; empty when none.

priority.description: Priority set on the node itself: 0 means none; smaller positive values are more urgent.

effectivePriority.description: Priority used for ordering, from 0 (none) through 6.

isFinished.description: True when the node counts as finished: progress mode `complete` or progress 100, or a status containing done, complete, approved, ready, final or archived.

isPausedOrStopped.description: True when the status contains paused, on hold, onhold, stopped or cancel, or the marker label contains pause, hold, stop or wait.

canExecute.description: True when the node is neither finished nor paused or stopped and every prerequisite, including its ancestors below the project root, is finished.

durationSeconds.description: Known duration in seconds: the stored duration, or else the length of the planned interval (at least 1); null when neither exists.

effectiveDurationSeconds.description: Duration used for planning: `durationSeconds`, or the response's `defaultDurationSeconds` when it is null.

startUtc.description: Planned start as an instant with offset; null when not scheduled.

endUtc.description: Planned end as an instant with offset; null when not scheduled.

route.description: Application route that shows the node in the web UI; informational.

prerequisites.description: Nodes the analyzed node waits for, finished or not.

dependents.description: Nodes that wait for the analyzed node.

ProjectStructureDependencyItem.description: Dependency analysis of one node: its state, whether it can start now, its duration and its prerequisites and dependents.

nodeIds.description: Node identifiers to return, as in `nodes[].id`, matched exactly; blank entries are ignored. Null or omitted returns every node; an empty array (or one with only blank entries) returns no items.

includeFinished.description: True (the default) to include finished nodes; false drops nodes with progress mode `complete` or progress 100, or whose status contains done, complete, approved, ready, final or archived.

defaultDurationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds assumed for nodes without a stored duration or planned interval; null, zero or negative means 3600 (one hour).

take.description: Maximum number of items, applied after ordering by title; a cut result adds a warning. A value below 1 is treated as 1. Null returns every item.

ProjectStructureDependencyQueryRequest.description: Dependency query: which nodes to analyze and how to fill missing durations. Every member is optional; the empty object `{}` analyzes every node of the project, finished ones included.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the related node, as in `nodes[].id` of the structure read.

status.description: Free-text status of the related node.

effectivePriority.description: Effective priority of the related node, from 0 (none) through 6.

isFinished.description: True when the related node counts as finished.

reason.description: How the nodes are related. Prerequisites: `parent` (an ancestor below the project root), `depends-on` (the analyzed node has a DependsOn link to it) or `blocked-by` (it has a Blocks link to the analyzed node). Dependents: `required-for` (it has a DependsOn link to the analyzed node) or `blocks` (the analyzed node has a Blocks link to it).

ProjectStructureDependencyRelationSummar.description: One node related to an analyzed node as its prerequisite or its dependent.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project.

projectName.description: Name of the project at the time of the query.

defaultDurationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds assumed for nodes without a known duration.

items.description: Analyzed nodes; empty when nothing matched.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes, for example that the result was cut to `take` nodes.

ProjectStructureDependencyResponse.description: Dependency analysis of a project: the selected nodes ordered by title, each with its prerequisites, dependents and durations.

errorCode.description: Stable machine-readable reason, for example `StaleTask`, `ProjectLifetimeRefreshRequired` or `NodeNotFound`. Branch on this value, not on the message.

message.description: Human-readable explanation intended for operators and logs. Its wording can change and must not be parsed.

details.description: Optional operation-specific details, such as the rejected field and the supported representation or the maximum body size. Null or absent when the failure has no details.

ProjectStructureErrorDetail.description: Project Structure rejection or failure: a stable error code, a human-readable message and optional structured details.

ProjectStructureErrorResponse.description: Error envelope of the Project Structure operations: a single `error` object describing why the operation rejected or failed the request. This family does not return ProblemDetails or the `errors` array used by the other API families. The status alone does not prove that nothing was written: a 409 or 500 can follow a partially applied change, so read the affected project state again before retrying.

affectedTaskIds.description: Tasks whose stored values the mutation changed. Each item is an object whose `value` member holds the task's string node identifier, for example `{ "value": "custom:3f2504e04f8911d39a0c0305e82c3301" }`.

addedDependencyCount.description: Number of task dependencies the mutation added.

removedDependencyCount.description: Number of task dependencies the mutation removed.

ProjectStructureGanttMutationResult.description: Committed result of a Gantt task or schedule mutation: which tasks the owner changed and how many dependencies it added or removed. It carries no task state; read the project structure again to obtain the stored values, including those the owner normalized or recalculated.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project to import into; required.

parentNodeKey.description: Identifier of an existing node that receives the container, as returned in `nodes[].id`; null or blank uses the project root.

sourceKind.description: Format of the source, as a JSON integer: 0 Mermaid, 1 DocxOutline, 2 XmindMap, 3 JsonOutline.

title.description: Title of the container block that holds the import; required, not blank.

sourceText.description: Source text for Mermaid and JSON outlines; when blank, `sourceAsset` is decoded as UTF-8 text instead. Ignored for DOCX and XMind sources.

oneOf.description: Source file as inline base64, required for DOCX and XMind sources and optional for the others. When sent, it is also stored as a File node in the container.

containerBlockSubtype.description: ProjectBlock subtype for the container and for items with children. Defaults to `delivery` when omitted.

leafWorkItemSubtype.description: WorkItem subtype for leaf items. Defaults to `task` when omitted, which makes every leaf a canonical task.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on the target project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the import uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureImportRequest.description: Outline import request: the target project, where to put the imported nodes and the source outline. The import creates a container ProjectBlock, stores the source file in it when one is sent, and creates one node per outline item under the container: items with children become ProjectBlock nodes and leaves become WorkItem nodes.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project the outline was imported into.

containerNodeId.description: Identifier of the container block that holds the imported nodes.

sourceNodeId.description: Identifier of the File node that stores the source file; null when none was sent.

createdNodeIds.description: Identifiers of every created node: the container, the source file node when present, then the imported items.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes about how the source was interpreted: how a Mermaid source was read, skipped lines and links, or an XMind layout that could not be read (then nothing was imported besides the container and source file).

ProjectStructureImportResult.description: Result of a committed outline import.

ProjectStructureImportSourceKind.description: Format of an imported outline, as a JSON integer. 0 Mermaid: `mindmap` text, where indentation gives the hierarchy, or `flowchart` or `graph` text, where every `A --> B` line adds items A and B side by side and a DependsOn link from A to B (other lines are skipped with a warning). 1 DocxOutline: a Word .docx file whose Heading 1, Heading 2 and deeper heading paragraphs give the hierarchy; other non-empty paragraphs also become items. 2 XmindMap: an XMind file (its content.json or content.xml topics). 3 JsonOutline: a JSON object or array of objects, each with `title` (or `name`), optional `notes` and optional `children`.

scopeKind.description: Kind of scope to lease, as a JSON integer, a numeric string or a case-insensitive name: 0 Project, 1 ProjectNode, 2 RepoBranch.

scopeKey.description: Key of the leased scope. Project: the id of an existing project in its hyphenated form, for example `3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301`; any other GUID spelling is accepted but creates a lease that mutations do not recognize. ProjectNode: a node identifier as returned in `nodes[].id` by the structure read. RepoBranch: a free-form repository and branch key. The key is trimmed and lower-cased (RepoBranch keys also get forward slashes instead of backslashes) and is stored with at most 300 characters. A blank key is rejected with HTTP 400 `ScopeKeyRequired`, a Project key that is not a GUID with HTTP 400 `InvalidProjectScope`, an unknown project with HTTP 404 `ProjectNotFound`.

reason.description: Free text shown to other callers in the lease snapshot, for example why the scope is locked. Trimmed; a blank reason is stored as `Project structure mutation`.

durationMinutes.description: Requested lifetime in minutes, counted from now; values are clamped to 1 through 120. Defaults to 15 when omitted.

ProjectStructureLeaseAcquireRequest.description: Lease acquisition request: the scope to lease, a reason shown to other callers and the requested duration. The lease belongs to the calling identity. When that identity already holds the active lease on the scope, the lease is extended and keeps its token; when another identity holds it, the request is rejected with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`.

scopeKind.description: Kind of the leased scope, as used when the lease was acquired: a JSON integer, a numeric string or a case-insensitive name, 0 Project, 1 ProjectNode or 2 RepoBranch.

scopeKey.description: Key of the leased scope, normalized like the acquisition key (trimmed and lower-cased).

leaseToken.description: Token returned in `leaseToken` when the lease was acquired, compared exactly after trimming. A blank token is rejected with HTTP 400 `LeaseTokenRequired`.

ProjectStructureLeaseReleaseRequest.description: Lease release request: ends a lease that the calling identity holds, identified by its scope and token.

scopeKind.description: Kind of the leased scope, as used when the lease was acquired: a JSON integer, a numeric string or a case-insensitive name, 0 Project, 1 ProjectNode or 2 RepoBranch.

scopeKey.description: Key of the leased scope, normalized like the acquisition key (trimmed and lower-cased), so send the key used to acquire the lease or the `scopeKey` returned in its snapshot.

leaseToken.description: Token returned in `leaseToken` when the lease was acquired, compared exactly after trimming. A blank token is rejected with HTTP 400 `LeaseTokenRequired`.

durationMinutes.description: New lifetime in minutes, counted from now (not added to the remaining time); clamped to 1 through 120. Defaults to 15.

ProjectStructureLeaseRenewRequest.description: Lease renewal request: extends an active lease that the calling identity holds, identified by its scope and token.

ProjectStructureLeaseScopeKind.description: Kind of scope a Project Structure lease coordinates; it decides how the scope key is read. Request bodies accept a JSON integer, a numeric string or a case-insensitive name; responses write the JSON integer. 0 Project (the key is a project id; the only kind that Project Structure mutations check), 1 ProjectNode (the key is a node identifier that exists in exactly one project), 2 RepoBranch (a free-form repository and branch key that is not tied to a project). ProjectNode and RepoBranch leases only coordinate callers that look for them; no Project Structure operation requires or checks them.

scopeKind.description: Kind of the leased scope, as a JSON integer (0 Project, 1 ProjectNode, 2 RepoBranch).

scopeKey.description: Normalized (trimmed, lower-cased) key of the leased scope.

leaseToken.description: Opaque lease token (currently 32 hexadecimal characters). Send it as `leaseToken` to renew or release the lease and, for a Project lease, with the mutations of that project. Every snapshot includes it, including the one returned by the current-lease read to any caller.

agentId.description: Identity that holds the lease: the bearer token's subject, `local-api-operator` for unauthenticated API calls, or the agent id of an in-process agent.

agentName.description: Display name of the holder, for example the token's name claim.

machineName.description: Machine name recorded for the holder. For HTTP callers it is the name of the server that handled the request, not the client's machine.

repositoryRoot.description: Repository root recorded by the holder; empty for HTTP callers, which cannot supply one.

branchName.description: Branch name recorded by the holder; empty for HTTP callers.

reason.description: Reason given when the lease was acquired or last re-acquired.

acquiredAtUtc.description: Instant (UTC, with offset) when the lease was first acquired.

renewedAtUtc.description: Instant (UTC, with offset) of the last acquisition, renewal or release of the lease.

expiresAtUtc.description: Instant (UTC, with offset) when the lease stops being active. A released lease has this set to the release time.

isActive.description: True when the lease is neither released nor expired at the time of the response; false for a released or expired lease.

ProjectStructureLeaseSnapshot.description: State of one Project Structure lease: its scope, token, holder and validity window. Returned by the lease acquire, renew, release and current-lease operations. A lease coordinates writers; it is not an authorization and not a project write admission. The holder is the caller identity: the bearer token's subject, or the shared identity `local-api-operator` when API authorization is disabled, together with the server's machine name. Another identity cannot renew, release or use the lease even when it knows the token.

changed.description: For a removal, true when a matching link was removed and false when none existed. For a creation it is always true, also when the same link already existed.

link.description: The link that was requested, echoed back with `isUserAuthored` true.

ProjectStructureLinkChangeResult.description: Result of a committed link creation or removal.

sourceNodeId.description: Identifier of the node the link starts from, as returned in `nodes[].id`; required. For DependsOn it is the node that depends on the target.

targetNodeId.description: Identifier of the node the link points to, as returned in `nodes[].id`; required and different from the source.

kind.description: Meaning of the link, as a JSON integer: 0 Contains, 1 DependsOn (default), 2 Uses, 3 Validates, 4 Tests, 5 Blocks, 6 DerivedFrom, 7 BelongsTo. Contains and BelongsTo are hierarchy links and cannot be created here; change the parent instead. A Uses link from a canonical task is rejected: attach task resources with the task resource operation.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureLinkInput.description: Directed link between two nodes of one project, to create or remove. The dependency operations always use kind DependsOn and ignore `kind`.

kind.description: The link kind, as a JSON integer: 0 Contains, 1 DependsOn, 2 Uses, 3 Validates, 4 Tests, 5 Blocks, 6 DerivedFrom, 7 BelongsTo.

label.description: Name of the link kind, for example `DependsOn`.

guidance.description: When to use the link kind and its direction, for example that the source of a DependsOn link depends on its target.

ProjectStructureLinkKindCatalogItem.description: One link kind in the node catalog, with guidance on when to use it.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the node the link starts from, as in `nodes[].id`.

targetId.description: Identifier of the node the link points to, as in `nodes[].id`.

kind.description: Meaning of the link, as a JSON integer: 0 Contains, 1 DependsOn, 2 Uses, 3 Validates, 4 Tests, 5 Blocks, 6 DerivedFrom, 7 BelongsTo. For DependsOn the source depends on the target.

isUserAuthored.description: True when a caller created the link; false for links the owner maintains, such as the containment links between a parent and its children.

ProjectStructureLinkSummary.description: One directed link between two nodes of a project structure, returned by the structure read when `includeLinks` is true.

ProjectStructureManagedStorageDispositio.description: What a node deletion does with the managed files that belong to the deleted nodes. Written as its name, for example `"RetainManagedFiles"`; request bodies also accept the name in any casing or the integer. Unspecified (0) is not accepted for a deletion; RetainManagedFiles (1) keeps the files in managed storage; DeleteOwnedManagedFiles (2) deletes the managed files the deleted nodes own. Files that cannot be deleted are retained and reported as warnings.

nodeIds.description: Identifiers of the nodes to change, as returned in `nodes[].id`; blank entries and unknown identifiers are ignored.

markerIcon.description: Icon token that identifies the marker, stored lower-case; a blank icon removes all markers of the nodes.

markerTone.description: Tone (color) token, stored lower-case; blank means `accent`.

markerLabel.description: Display label; blank means the icon token.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureMarkerBatchInput.description: Marker for several nodes of one project: every current marker of each node is replaced by this one marker, or removed when `markerIcon` is blank.

mode.description: How to treat the existing markers, as a JSON integer: 0 Replace (default), 1 Add, 2 Toggle, 3 Remove, 4 Clear.

markerIcon.description: Icon token that identifies the marker, stored lower-case. A blank icon makes Replace remove all markers and makes Add, Toggle and Remove change nothing.

markerTone.description: Tone (color) token, stored lower-case; blank means `accent`.

markerLabel.description: Display label; blank means the icon token.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureMarkerInput.description: Marker change for the node named in the route. The node's primary marker, returned in structure reads, is the one added last.

ProjectStructureMarkerMutationMode.description: How a marker change treats the node's existing markers, as a JSON integer. Markers are identified by their icon, ignoring case. 0 Replace (the node keeps only the given marker; a blank icon removes all markers), 1 Add (adds the marker or replaces the one with the same icon), 2 Toggle (removes the marker with this icon if present, otherwise adds it), 3 Remove (removes the marker with this icon), 4 Clear (removes all markers; icon, tone and label are ignored).

canRunNormally.description: True when the node's runtime plan can be executed directly on the server.

canRunAsAdministrator.description: True when the runtime plan can be started with elevation on the server.

canOpenInFileExplorer.description: True when an existing file or folder of the node, inside the configured workspace root, can be shown in the server's system file browser.

canOpenInNewTab.description: True when the node is IPFS-backed and opens in a separate browser tab.

runtimeDisplayName.description: Display name of the node's runtime plan; empty when there is none.

runtimeDisplayCommand.description: Always empty in this API: runtime commands are not disclosed over HTTP.

runtimeWorkingDirectory.description: Always empty in this API: working directories are not disclosed over HTTP.

openInNewTabRoute.description: Route opened in a new tab when `canOpenInNewTab` is true; otherwise empty.

storageProvider.description: Name of the storage provider holding the node's stored object; empty when the node has no stored object.

storageLocatorKind.description: Name of the kind of `storageLocator`; empty when there is no stored object.

storageLocator.description: Provider-specific locator of the stored object (its syntax depends on the provider and locator kind); empty when there is no stored object. Do not treat it as a path on the client's machine.

actions.description: Actions the structure editor offers for the node.

guidance.description: Display notes about the actions, including why a runtime action is unavailable on this host.

ProjectStructureNodeActionCapabilities.description: What the server can do with a node on its own machine: run its runtime plan (script, environment and Docker nodes), open its file location, open it in a new browser tab or browse its files, plus the storage it is bound to. It describes the host's capabilities, not the caller's permissions, and the HTTP API does not start these actions.

actionId.description: Stable action identifier, for example `runtime:open`, `runtime:terminal`, `runtime:admin`, `runtime:stop`, `open-local`, `open-new-tab` or `browse-files`.

surface.description: Where the structure editor offers the action, as display text.

description.description: What the action does, as display text.

ProjectStructureNodeActionDescriptor.description: One action the application offers for a node in its structure editor, for example running a script node or showing a file in its folder. Descriptive only: the HTTP API does not execute these actions.

key.description: Key of the input field, as in `inputFields[].key`.

value.description: Pre-filled value.

ProjectStructureNodeCatalogDefaultValue.description: Value the structure editor pre-fills for one input field of a node kind.

key.description: Key of the input value, for example `outputRoot`; the catalog guidance explains which metadata member to set for each kind.

placeholder.description: Placeholder or example text shown in the empty field.

isRequired.description: True when the editor requires a value for the field.

options.description: Values offered for a `select` field; empty for other fields and for select fields whose values the catalog does not list.

ProjectStructureNodeCatalogField.description: One additional input field the structure editor shows for a node kind, such as an output folder for a delivery block or an image size for a generated image.

actionId.description: Stable identifier of the catalog entry, for example `add-block-delivery`.

objectType.description: Object type of the node this entry creates.

objectSubtype.description: Subtype of the node this entry creates; empty when the entry has none.

groupKey.description: Group the editor shows the entry in, for example `assets`, `blocks`, `work` or `runtime`.

label.description: Display name of the node kind.

description.description: What the node kind is used for, as display text.

defaultTitle.description: Title the editor proposes for a new node of this kind.

titleLabel.description: Editor label for the node's title field.

subtitleLabel.description: Editor label for the node's subtitle field.

notesLabel.description: Editor label for the node's notes field.

requiresFile.description: True when a node of this kind needs uploaded file content.

acceptedFileTypes.description: Comma-separated file extensions and media types accepted for the file, for example `.zip,.rar,.7z,application/zip`; empty when the kind has no file.

inputFields.description: Additional input fields the editor shows for this kind; empty when none.

defaultInputValues.description: Values the editor pre-fills for some input fields; empty when none.

aliases.description: Alternative names and phrases for finding this entry. Not every alias is accepted as `objectType`; send the entry's `objectType` and `objectSubtype` instead.

ProjectStructureNodeCatalogItem.description: One node kind the structure editor can add, described by its object type and subtype, labels and input fields. Create most kinds with `POST /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/nodes`, sending this entry's `objectType` and `objectSubtype`. Exceptions: canonical tasks (WorkItem with subtype `task`) are created with `POST /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/tasks`, and File nodes and `mermaid` subtypes with `POST /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/assets`.

objectType.description: The object type.

label.description: Display name of the object type.

isUserCreatable.description: False for types only the owner creates, such as the project root and process or workflow definitions and runs.

creatableSubtypes.description: Lower-case subtypes callers can create for this type, for example `task` or `issue` for WorkItem; empty when the type has no predefined subtypes.

ProjectStructureNodeCatalogObjectType.description: One project object type in the node catalog, with the subtypes callers can create.

value.description: Value to use.

ProjectStructureNodeCatalogOption.description: One allowed value of a `select` input field in the node catalog.

items.description: Node kinds that can be added to a structure, each with its object type and subtype.

objectTypes.description: Every object type with its label and the subtypes callers can create.

linkKinds.description: Every link kind with its label and usage guidance.

guidance.description: Plain-text advice for building nodes, for example which object type and subtype to use for a task or a folder and which metadata members to set.

ProjectStructureNodeCatalogResponse.description: Catalog of the node kinds, object types and link kinds that the structure editor offers, with guidance for choosing them. It is the same for every project. Use it to pick `objectType`, `objectSubtype` and link `kind` values for creation requests.

commandKind.description: Command, as a JSON integer: 0 Open and 1 Wizard (the node's page; for prompt nodes their Prompt Gallery prompt, created when missing), 2 Branch, 4 Skip and 5 MarkUsed (the same result as Open, without creating a prompt), 3 Test (the project's Test Lab).

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureNodeCommandInput.description: Command to resolve for the node named in the route.

copiedNodeId.description: Identifier of the new node created as its copy.

ProjectStructureNodeCopyMapping.description: Correspondence between one copied source node and its new copy.

objectType.description: Object type of the new node: its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`), a node-kind alias that also sets the subtype (for example `FeatureBlock` or `Folder`) or its integer from 0 through 30.

subtitle.description: Secondary display text.

notes.description: Free-text notes.

parentNodeKey.description: Identifier of the parent node, as returned in `nodes[].id`; null or blank places the node under the project root. An unknown parent is rejected with HTTP 404 `ParentNodeNotFound`.

x.description: Preferred horizontal canvas position; used as a hint only when `y` is also sent. The node is placed near its parent automatically.

y.description: Preferred vertical canvas position; used as a hint only when `x` is also sent.

startUtc.description: Planned start as an instant with offset; null or omitted leaves the node unscheduled.

endUtc.description: Planned end as an instant with offset. When omitted and `startUtc` is sent, the end is the start plus `durationSeconds` (one hour when that is omitted or not positive).

objectSubtype.description: Lower-case subtype, for example `feature` for a ProjectBlock; known synonyms are normalized. A typed alias in `objectType` supplies it when omitted. See `objectTypes[].creatableSubtypes` in the node catalog.

oneOf.description: Optional file content stored with the node, for example the picture of an ImageAsset. File nodes are created with the asset operation instead.

metadataJson.description: Optional metadata as a JSON string that contains a JSON object, with the section for the node's type (see the node catalog guidance). It takes precedence over `metadata` when not blank. Script, Environment and Infrastructure metadata is validated.

metadata.description: Optional metadata as a JSON object instead of a string; used only when `metadataJson` is null or blank.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

durationSeconds.description: Planned duration in seconds; a value of 0 or less stores no duration. When omitted it is computed from the planned start and end.

ProjectStructureNodeCreateOpenApiRequest.description: Node creation request: the kind of node, its display fields and an optional parent, schedule, file, metadata and canvas position. Canonical tasks (WorkItem with subtype `task`) are created with the task operation, and File nodes and `mermaid` subtypes with the asset operation. Every string member may be omitted; omitted strings are stored as empty.

nodeIds.description: Identifiers of the nodes to delete, as returned in `nodes[].id`; blank entries are ignored and at least one identifier is required.

managedStorageDisposition.description: What to do with the managed files of the deleted nodes, as its name (any casing) or integer: `RetainManagedFiles` (1) or `DeleteOwnedManagedFiles` (2). Required; `Unspecified` (0) or an omitted value is rejected with HTTP 400 `ProjectStructureManagedStorageDispositionRequired`.
