leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

oneOf.description: Project write admission returned as `expectedProjectAdmission` by the structure read, sent back unchanged. Required: when it is omitted, null or names another project, the request is rejected with HTTP 409 `ProjectLifetimeRefreshRequired` and nothing is deleted.

ProjectStructureNodeDeleteBatchInput.description: Deletion of several nodes of one project, each with all its descendants. Listed nodes inside another listed node's subtree are deleted with it. Listed nodes that are already deleted but whose cleanup is pending get that cleanup resumed.

Required; `Unspecified` (0) or an omitted value is rejected with HTTP 400 `ProjectStructureManagedStorageDispositionRequired`. A cleanup retry must send the value recorded for that deletion.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

durableMutationId.description: Omit it for a new deletion. To finish an earlier deletion whose cleanup is pending, send its `durableMutationId` from `GET /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/deletion-cleanups` or from the `details` of HTTP 409 `ProjectStructureDeletionPartialCommit`.

oneOf.description: Project write admission returned as `expectedProjectAdmission` by the structure read, sent back unchanged. Required for a new deletion (no `durableMutationId`): when it is omitted, null or names another project, the request is rejected with HTTP 409 `ProjectLifetimeRefreshRequired` and nothing is deleted. Not needed for a cleanup retry.

ProjectStructureNodeDeleteInput.description: Deletion of the node named in the route with all its descendants, or a retry of the cleanup of an earlier deletion of that node when `durableMutationId` is sent.

title.description: New title; blank or omitted keeps the current title.

subtitle.description: New subtitle; omitted or null clears it.

notes.description: New notes; omitted or null clears them.

objectType.description: Object type to give the node: its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`), a node-kind alias that also sets the subtype (for example `FeatureBlock` or `Folder`) or its integer from 0 through 30; null or omitted keeps the current type.

objectSubtype.description: New lower-case subtype; null or omitted keeps the current subtype, or clears it when the object type changes.

startUtc.description: Planned start as an instant with offset; omitted or null clears it when the type stays the same.

endUtc.description: Planned end as an instant with offset. When omitted and `startUtc` is sent, the end is the start plus `durationSeconds` (one hour when that is omitted or not positive).

metadataJson.description: New metadata as a JSON string that contains a JSON object; it replaces the stored metadata and takes precedence over `metadata`. Blank keeps the stored metadata.

metadata.description: New metadata as a JSON object instead of a string; used only when `metadataJson` is null or blank.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. durationSeconds.description: Planned duration in seconds; a value of 0 or less stores no duration. When omitted it is computed from the planned start and end.

ProjectStructureNodeEditOpenApiRequest.description: Node update request for a generic node. It replaces the node's subtitle, notes and schedule with the sent values, so send the current values of members you do not want to change: an omitted or null `subtitle` or `notes` clears it, and omitted schedule members clear the planned interval unless the request also reclassifies the node. metadataJson.description: New metadata as a JSON string that contains a JSON object, for example `"{\"projectBlock\":{\"outputRoot\":\"\"}}"`. status.description: New free-text status; null, omitted or blank keeps the current status. A new status also resets the progress mode and percentage from the status text.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node to move, as returned in `nodes[].id`. An unknown identifier is ignored and the response is still `{ "ok": true }`.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. ProjectStructureNodeMoveInput.description: New canvas position for one node in the structure editor. Only the layout changes.

parentNodeKey.description: Identifier of the new parent node; null or blank makes the node a child of the project root (`project:{projectId}`). The parent cannot be the node itself or one of its descendants.

rootNodeId.description: Identifier of the node whose descendants are repositioned, as returned in `nodes[].id`; the node itself keeps its position.

sourceNodeIds.description: Identifiers of the roots of the subtrees to copy, as returned in `nodes[].id`; at least one, none blank. Duplicates are ignored.

destinationParentNodeId.description: Identifier of the editable node that receives the copies; required. Project nodes kept in sync with other projects cannot receive copies.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureNodesCopyInput.description: Copy of one or more subtrees under a destination parent in the same project. Each source node is copied with all its descendants and the caller-created links between copied nodes; caller-created links that cross the boundary of the copied set are left out and reported. Subtrees that contain a canonical task are rejected.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project that contains the source and the copies.

destinationParentNodeId.description: Identifier of the node that received the copies.

sourceRootNodeIds.description: Identifiers of the copied subtree roots, in the order of the new roots.

copiedRootNodeIds.description: Identifiers of the new root nodes created under the destination.

nodeMappings.description: One entry per copied node, ordered by source identifier.

omittedBoundaryLinks.description: Links between a copied node and a node outside the copied set; they were not copied. Empty when there were none.

copiedNodeCount.description: Number of nodes created by the copy, equal to the number of `nodeMappings`.

ProjectStructureNodesCopyResult.description: Result of a committed subtree copy: the new root nodes, the identifier of every copied node and the links that were not copied because they crossed the copied set.

name.description: Name of the new subproject; required, not blank.

nodeIds.description: Identifiers of the nodes to move, as returned in `nodes[].id`; at least one. Blank and duplicate entries are removed. Identifiers that are not editable nodes of the source project (unknown, project or synced nodes) are ignored with a warning.

description.description: Description of the new subproject; blank generates one that names the source project.

objective.description: Objective of the new subproject; blank generates one.

currentPhase.description: Current phase of the new subproject; blank means Execution.

status.description: Status of the new subproject, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 OnHold, 3 Completed, 4 Archived. Defaults to Active.

includeDescendants.description: True (the default) to move each selected node with all its descendants; false moves only the selected nodes.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on the source project. When omitted, the operation uses the lease the caller's identity already holds on it, or else takes a five-minute lease on it for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active lease on the source project, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureNodesToSubprojectInput.description: Extraction of selected nodes into a new subproject of the route's project: the owner creates the project and moves the nodes into its structure.

sourceProjectId.description: Identifier of the project the nodes came from.

requestedNodeIds.description: The node identifiers that were requested, after removing blanks and duplicates.

movedNodeIds.description: Identifiers of every node that moved, sorted ordinally; node identifiers do not change when nodes move.

movedRootCount.description: Number of moved nodes whose parent did not move; they are now children of the new subproject's root.

movedLinkCount.description: Number of links between moved nodes; they moved with the nodes.

removedBoundaryLinks.description: Links that were deleted because one end moved and the other stayed.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes, for example about ignored identifiers or removed boundary links.

movedNodeCount.description: Number of nodes that moved, equal to the number of `movedNodeIds`.

ProjectStructureNodesToSubprojectResult.description: Result of a committed extraction of nodes into a new subproject.

id.description: String node identifier, unique within the project; use it in node routes and requests. Nodes created through this API have the form `custom:` followed by 32 hexadecimal characters, for example `custom:3f2504e04f8911d39a0c0305e82c3301`. Nodes kept in sync with other records use other prefixes followed by that record's identifier, for example `project:{projectId}` for the project root, `project-child:{projectId}` for a subproject or `phase:{phaseId}`. Treat it as opaque and compare it exactly; it is not a GUID.

parentId.description: Identifier of the parent node in the hierarchy; null for a top-level node such as the project root.

objectType.description: Kind of project object the node represents.

objectSubtype.description: Lower-case subtype that refines the object type, for example `task` for a WorkItem or `pdf` for a File; empty when none. A WorkItem with subtype `task` is a canonical task, changed only through the task operations.

subtitle.description: Secondary display text; may be empty.

status.description: Free-text status, for example Draft, Active or Done. Progress and the finished state are derived from words in it (see `progressMode`).

notes.description: Free-text notes; in a structure read, null unless `includeNotes` was true.

route.description: Application route that shows the node or its artifact in the web UI; informational.

artifactKind.description: Kind of record the node represents, for example `project` for project nodes or the object type name for ordinary nodes; informational.

artifactId.description: Identifier of the external record the node is bound to, for example the project id of a project node; null when the node has no external record.

mediaRelativePath.description: Location of the node's stored file within the application's managed storage; empty when the node has no file. In a structure read, null unless `includeAssets` was true. Not a path on the client's machine.

mediaContentType.description: Content type of the stored file, for example `application/pdf`; empty when there is none. In a structure read, null unless `includeAssets` was true.

mediaOriginalFileName.description: Original file name of the stored file; empty when there is none. In a structure read, null unless `includeAssets` was true.

badges.description: Display labels derived from the node, for example Synced (kept in sync with another record), Scheduled (has a planned start), a subtype label, Uploaded (has an uploaded file), Subproject, Parent or Shared parent. For display only; do not parse them.

progressMode.description: How progress is expressed: `complete`, `started`, `progress` or `na` (not applicable); empty when progress is not tracked, as for project hierarchy nodes. A status change resets the mode and percentage from the status text.

progressPercent.description: Progress from 0 through 100, or -1 when it is not tracked. Unless set explicitly, it follows the status: for example 28 for draft, planned, pending or queued, 62 for active, running or blocked, 78 for review or testing, and 100 for done, complete, approved, ready or final.

markerIcon.description: Icon token of the node's primary marker; empty when the node has no marker.

markerTone.description: Tone (color) token of the node's primary marker; empty when there is none.

markerLabel.description: Label of the node's primary marker; empty when there is none. A node can carry several markers; only the primary one is returned.

priority.description: Priority set on the node itself: 0 means none; smaller positive values are more urgent.

effectivePriority.description: Priority used for ordering and filtering, from 0 (none) through 6: the node's own priority or, unless the node is finished, paused or stopped, the most urgent nonzero priority among it and its descendants. Node creation and change responses return the node's own priority here.

startUtc.description: Planned start as an instant with offset; null when the node is not scheduled.

endUtc.description: Planned end as an instant with offset; null when the node is not scheduled.

metadataJson.description: Node metadata as a JSON string that contains a JSON object; parse it before use. In a structure read, null unless `includeMetadata` was true. Its sections are named after the object type, for example `workItem` for tasks (with `expectedEffortHours`, `expectedEffortUnit`, `executionState` and `directAssignmentRevision`) or `projectBlock`. Enum values inside it are camel-case strings such as `"hours"` or `"notStarted"`, unlike the integers used in request bodies.

projectRole.description: Role of the node in the project hierarchy, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 ActiveProject, 2 Subproject, 3 ParentProject, 4 AdditionalParentProject.

relatedProjectId.description: Project id that a project hierarchy node stands for (project root, subproject or parent project); null for other nodes.

parentProjectCount.description: For a subproject node, the number of project nodes in this structure that contain it; 0 for other nodes.

x.description: Horizontal canvas position in the structure editor; in a structure read, null unless `includeLayout` was true.

y.description: Vertical canvas position in the structure editor; in a structure read, null unless `includeLayout` was true.

durationSeconds.description: Stored planned duration in seconds; null when none is stored.

oneOf.description: What the server can do with the node on its own machine; null when nothing applies.
Receipt that ties the node to the process step that created it as an asset. Only process runs executing inside the application set it; the Project Structure HTTP API omits this member.

ProjectStructureNodeSummary.description: One node of a project structure: its identity, place in the hierarchy, display fields, status, progress, markers, priority, schedule and optional sections. Returned in `nodes` by the structure read and as the result of node, approval-request and asset creation and of node changes. In a structure read, `notes`, `metadataJson`, `x`/`y` and the stored-file members are null unless the matching include flag is set; node creation and change responses always fill them.

objectType.description: Object type as its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`) or its integer from 0 through 30.

objectSubtype.description: New lower-case subtype, for example `feature` for a ProjectBlock; known synonyms are normalized. Null or omitted keeps the current subtype when the type stays the same and clears it when the type changes.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureNodeTypeInput.description: Type change for one generic node: the new object type and subtype. The node keeps its title, subtitle, notes, metadata and schedule. Only some changes are supported: a subtype change within the same family of node kinds, promoting a Note to a kind that accepts promotion, and switching between runnable runtime kinds (script, runtime environment, Docker); others are rejected with HTTP 400 `NodeReclassificationUnavailable`. Changing a node to or from a canonical task (WorkItem with subtype `task`) is rejected with HTTP 409. Sending the node's current type and subtype clears its planned start, end and duration, so send only real changes.

ok.description: Always true. Failures return the Project Structure error envelope instead.

ProjectStructureOkResponse.description: Acknowledgement returned by Project Structure operations that have no other result, always `{ "ok": true }`. It only confirms that the operation completed; read the affected project or structure again to see the stored result.

nodeIds.description: Identifiers of the nodes to change, as returned in `nodes[].id`; blank entries and unknown identifiers are ignored.

priority.description: New priority: 0 removes the priority, 1 is the most urgent and 6 the least; values outside 0 through 6 are clamped.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

priority.description: New priority: 0 removes the priority, 1 is the most urgent and 6 the least; values outside 0 through 6 are clamped.

ProjectStructurePriorityInput.description: Priority for the node named in the route.

processDefinitionId.description: Identifier of the process definition, a GUID; required, the empty GUID is rejected with HTTP 400 `ProcessDefinitionRequired`. Its existence is not checked when the link is created.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. ProjectStructureProcessDefinitionLinkInp.description: Link from a node to a process definition, so that the node's process start uses that definition.

processDefinitionId.description: Process definition to launch, a GUID; null uses the definition the node represents (a `process-definition:` node) or the one linked from the node with `POST /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/nodes/{nodeId}/process-definition`.

runHrMatch.description: True (the default) to let readiness findings, such as missing staffing matches, block the launch; blocking assignment and mandatory findings block it either way.

execute.description: True to also queue the created run for execution by the process runtime; false (the default) creates the run without dispatching its steps.

includeLaunchPlan.description: True to return the prepared launch plan in `launchPlan`; defaults to false.

requestedBy.description: Display name of who requested the launch, recorded with the run. Defaults to `project-structure-api`.

leaseToken.description: Not used by this operation; process starts do not take a project lease.

ProjectStructureProcessNodeStartInput.description: Process start request for a project structure node: which process definition to launch for the node and how. Every member is optional.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node the start was requested for, as in `nodes[].id`.

processDefinitionId.description: Identifier of the process definition that was launched.

launchPlanId.description: Identifier of the prepared launch plan.

runId.description: Identifier of the created process run; null when no run was created, for example when blocked.

stage.description: Launch stage as text: `Planned`, `Blocked` (readiness findings stopped the launch), `Running`, `Completed` or `Failed`.

route.description: Application route of the live process view; informational.

launchPlan.description: The prepared launch plan as a JSON object, only when `includeLaunchPlan` was true; otherwise null.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes from the launch, for example that the run could not be linked back to the node.

oneOf.description: Durable launch observation used by process launches inside the application; null for launches through this HTTP API.

ProjectStructureProcessNodeStartResult.description: Result of a process launch for a project structure node. The launch is accepted, not finished: follow the run with `GET /api/processes/runs/{runId}`.

nodeIds.description: Identifiers of the nodes to change, as returned in `nodes[].id`; blank entries and unknown identifiers are ignored.

progressMode.description: Progress mode: `complete`, `started`, `progress` or `na`, ignoring case; any other value is stored as `progress`.

progressPercent.description: Progress percentage; values outside 0 through 100 are clamped.

When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

progressPercent.description: Progress percentage; values outside 0 through 100 are clamped.

ProjectStructureProgressInput.description: Explicit progress for the node named in the route, independent of its status.

ProjectStructureProjectRole.description: Role of a node in the project hierarchy shown in a structure, as a JSON integer. 0 None (an ordinary node), 1 ActiveProject (the root node of the project being read, `project:{projectId}`), 2 Subproject (a child project, `project-child:{projectId}`), 3 ParentProject (a parent project linked to the root node, `project-related-parent:{projectId}`), 4 AdditionalParentProject (a parent-project node that is not linked to the root node).

name.description: Project name; required, not blank, trimmed.

description.description: Project description; null is stored as empty. Trimmed.

objective.description: Project objective; null is stored as empty. Trimmed.

currentPhase.description: Name of the project's current phase; null is stored as empty. Trimmed.

status.description: Project status, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 OnHold, 3 Completed, 4 Archived. Defaults to Draft when omitted.

targetDateUtc.description: Optional target date as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC; null clears it.

leaseToken.description: For an update only: optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the update uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`. Ignored when creating a project.

ProjectStructureProjectSaveRequest.description: Project values for creating a root project or replacing an existing project's values. An update replaces every member with the sent value, so send the current values of members you keep: an omitted `status` becomes Draft and an omitted `targetDateUtc` is cleared. An update also removes the project's phases and option selections, which this request cannot carry.

nodeIds.description: Node identifiers to return, as returned in `nodes[].id`, matched exactly; blank entries are ignored and unknown identifiers match nothing. When both `nodeIds` and `subtreeRootIds` are null or empty, every node is a candidate.

subtreeRootIds.description: Node identifiers whose subtrees to return: each listed node and all its descendants by `parentId`. Combined with `nodeIds` as a union.

items.description: Object type as its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`) or its integer from 0 through 30.

objectTypes.description: Object types to keep, each as its name in any casing (for example `WorkItem`) or its integer from 0 through 30; null or an empty array keeps every type. Null items are rejected.

projectRoles.description: Project hierarchy roles to keep, as JSON integers: 0 None, 1 ActiveProject, 2 Subproject, 3 ParentProject, 4 AdditionalParentProject. For example `[1, 2]` keeps the project root and its subproject nodes; null or empty keeps every role.

statuses.description: Status texts to keep, compared whole and ignoring case (no partial match); null or empty keeps every status.

onlyUnfinished.description: True to drop finished nodes: nodes with progress mode `complete` or progress 100, or whose status contains done, complete, approved, ready, final or archived. Defaults to false.

maxPriority.description: Keep only nodes whose effective priority is from 1 through this value (1 is the most urgent); nodes without a priority (0) are dropped. Null applies no priority filter.

includeLinks.description: True to return the links whose source and target are both in the result; false (the default) returns an empty `links` array.

includeLayout.description: True to fill the canvas coordinates `x` and `y`; otherwise they are null.

includeMetadata.description: True to fill `metadataJson`; otherwise it is null. Task edits need it, because a task's current estimate, execution state and assignment revision are read from it.

includeNotes.description: True to fill `notes`; otherwise it is null.

includeAssets.description: True to fill the stored-file members `mediaRelativePath`, `mediaContentType` and `mediaOriginalFileName` (empty strings when a node has no file); otherwise they are null.

take.description: Maximum number of nodes, applied after filtering and ordering; a cut result adds a warning. A value below 1 is treated as 1. Null returns every matching node.

source.description: Read source, as a JSON integer: 0 ContextDefault (the default) and 2 CanonicalCurrent read the current structure; 1 InvocationSnapshot is rejected over HTTP.

ProjectStructureReadRequest.description: Structure read request: which nodes of the project to return and which optional sections to fill. Every member is optional; the empty object `{}` returns all nodes without notes, metadata, layout and file fields and without links. `nodeIds` and `subtreeRootIds` are combined (union); every other filter must also match. Nodes are ordered by title, ignoring case.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project that was read.

projectName.description: Name of the project at the time of the read.

nodes.description: Selected nodes, ordered by title ignoring case; empty when nothing matched.

links.description: Links whose source and target are both in `nodes`; empty unless `includeLinks` was true.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes about the result, for example that it was cut to `take` nodes; empty when there are none.

oneOf.description: Project write admission for the project lifetime that was read. Send it back unchanged as `expectedProjectAdmission` with task creation, task updates, task resource attachment and node deletions that remove or retain managed files; those writes are rejected with HTTP 409 when the admission is missing, names another project or no longer matches the project's current lifetime. Obtain a fresh one by reading again; never construct it. Always present in a successful structure read.

ProjectStructureReadResponse.description: Result of a structure read: the selected nodes of the project, the links between them when requested, warnings, and the project write admission to send back with admission-checked writes.

ProjectStructureReadSource.description: Source of a structure read, as a JSON integer. 0 ContextDefault (the default; over HTTP it reads the current structure), 1 InvocationSnapshot (a bounded snapshot attached to an in-process agent invocation; not available over HTTP and rejected with HTTP 400 `ProjectStructureReadSourceUnavailable`), 2 CanonicalCurrent (the authoritative current structure). Any other value is rejected with HTTP 400 `ProjectStructureReadSourceInvalid`. A snapshot is never silently replaced by current data.

nodeIds.description: Identifiers of the nodes to change, as returned in `nodes[].id`; blank entries and unknown identifiers are ignored.

status.description: New free-text status, trimmed, for example Active or Done. It also resets each node's progress mode and percentage from the status text. A blank status changes nothing.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureStatusBatchInput.description: Status change for several nodes of one project. Nodes kept in sync with other records (badge Synced) are skipped.

status.description: New free-text status, trimmed, for example Active or Done. It also resets the node's progress mode and percentage from the status text. A blank status changes nothing.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureStatusInput.description: Status change for the node named in the route.

childProjectId.description: Identifier of the project that becomes the subproject; required.

currentParentProjectId.description: Parent project to move the child away from; null or omitted adds the route's parent as an additional parent and keeps the child's existing parents.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on the child project (not the parent), from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the lease the caller's identity already holds on the child project, or else takes a five-minute lease on it for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active lease on the child project, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureSubprojectChangeRequest.description: Hierarchy change that makes a project a subproject of the route's parent project, either as an additional parent or by moving it from one of its current parents.

targetProjectId.description: Identifier of the project that received the nodes.

movedNodeIds.description: Identifiers of every node that moved, sorted ordinally; node identifiers do not change when nodes move.

movedRootCount.description: Number of moved nodes whose parent did not move; they are now children of the target project's root.

movedLinkCount.description: Number of links between moved nodes; they moved with the nodes.

removedBoundaryLinks.description: Links that were deleted because one end moved and the other stayed.

movedNodeCount.description: Number of nodes that moved, equal to the number of `movedNodeIds`.

ProjectStructureSubprojectTransferResult.description: Result of a committed transfer of project structure nodes into another project. All lists are empty when there was nothing to move.

rootNodeId.description: Identifier of the node whose descendants were repositioned.

descendantCount.description: Number of descendants of the node; 0 means nothing was moved.

repositionedNodeCount.description: Number of nodes whose canvas position was updated.

ProjectStructureSubtreeRecompositionResu.description: Result of an automatic re-layout of a node's descendants on the structure canvas.

targetProjectId.description: Identifier of the project that receives the descendants; required and different from the source.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on the source project. When omitted, the operation uses the lease the caller's identity already holds on it, or else takes a five-minute lease on it for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active lease on the source project, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

targetLeaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on the target project, handled like `leaseToken`.

ProjectStructureSubtreeTransferInput.description: Transfer of a node's descendants into another existing project, which does not have to be a subproject. The node itself stays in the source project; its former children become children of the target project's root.

title.description: Task title; required, trimmed, at most 200 characters.

startUtc.description: Planned start as an instant with offset; required. Stored in UTC.

endUtc.description: Planned end as an instant with offset; required and later than `startUtc`. Stored in UTC.

afterTaskNodeId.description: Identifier of the canonical task after which the new task is placed in the Gantt row order; null or blank appends it at the end. An identifier that is not a canonical task of the project makes the creation fail and be undone (HTTP 409 `RowOrderingFailed`).

oneOf.description: Optional resource to attach to the new task: a person or agent as direct assignee, or a workflow (with its exact `versionId`) or process definition. Null or omitted creates the task without a resource.
Optional estimate; null or omitted starts with an empty estimate. With a resource, the owner prices the task from the resource and replaces the cost amount and currency when a price is available.

Project write admission returned as `expectedProjectAdmission` by the structure read, sent back unchanged. Required: when it is omitted, null or names another project, the request is rejected with HTTP 409 `ProjectLifetimeRefreshRequired` and nothing is created.

duration.description: Planned duration computed from `startUtc` and `endUtc`, as a time span such as `"2.08:00:00"`. Read-only: a value sent in the request is ignored.

ProjectStructureTaskCreateRequest.description: Task creation request: a canonical task with a title, a planned interval and optionally an estimate, a resource and its position in the Gantt row order. The task is created in the project's main backlog block.

taskNodeId.description: Identifier of the new canonical task, for example `custom:3f2504e04f8911d39a0c0305e82c3301`; use it with `PUT /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}`.

backlogNodeId.description: Identifier of the main backlog block that contains the task.

oneOf.description: The resource attached to the task; null when none was requested.

pricing.description: How the task's estimate was priced when it was created.

ProjectStructureTaskCreateResult.description: Result of a committed task creation.

taskId.description: String node identifier of the task whose interval moves, as returned in `nodes[].id`.

previousStart.description: Planned start from the caller's latest read (`nodes[].startUtc`). It must equal the stored start exactly; otherwise the update is rejected as stale with HTTP 409 `StaleTask`.

previousEnd.description: Planned end from the caller's latest read (`nodes[].endUtc`), compared exactly like the previous start.

proposedStart.description: Requested planned start. It must be earlier than the proposed end.

proposedEnd.description: Requested planned end. It must be later than the proposed start; an empty or inverted interval is rejected with HTTP 400 `TaskUpdateRequestInvalid`.

isCritical.description: Client-side critical-path marker carried with the change; the owner does not use it. Defaults to false when omitted.

ProjectStructureTaskDateAgentChange.description: Planned-interval change for one task in a schedule change: the interval the caller read and the interval it proposes. Timestamps are ISO 8601 instants with an offset.

ProjectStructureTaskEstimateRefreshReaso.description: Why pricing treated a task's estimate as it did, as a JSON integer: 0 ExecutionStateDoesNotAllowRefresh (the task has started or finished, so its cost is kept), 1 NoResourceSelected, 2 AuthoritativeResourceRemoved (the priced resource was removed, so the cost was cleared), 3 AuthoritativeQuoteApplied, 4 AuthoritativeQuoteUnavailable (no price was available for the resource, so the cost was cleared).

status.description: What pricing did, as a JSON integer: 0 Preserved, 1 Refreshed, 2 Cleared.

reason.description: Why, as a JSON integer: 0 ExecutionStateDoesNotAllowRefresh, 1 NoResourceSelected, 2 AuthoritativeResourceRemoved, 3 AuthoritativeQuoteApplied, 4 AuthoritativeQuoteUnavailable.

oneOf.description: The resource the task was priced for; null when it has none.
The resource's price that was requested; null when no price was requested.
Cost basis recorded with the estimate for this price; null when none was calculated.

replacesCostBasis.description: True when this pricing replaces or clears the task's stored cost basis.

ProjectStructureTaskEstimateRefreshResul.description: Outcome of pricing a task's estimate from its resource: the resulting estimate, what happened and why, and the price and cost basis used.

ProjectStructureTaskEstimateRefreshStatu.description: What pricing did to a task's estimate, as a JSON integer: 0 Preserved (the estimate was kept), 1 Refreshed (the cost amount and currency were set from the resource's price), 2 Cleared (the cost amount and currency were removed).

resource.description: Workflow (with its exact `versionId`) or process definition to attach; required. Person and Agent are rejected with HTTP 400 `TaskAttachedResourceKindInvalid`.

currentExecution.description: Execution state of the task from the caller's latest read, taken from `workItem.executionState`, `workItem.actualStartedAtUtc` and `workItem.actualEndedAtUtc` in its `metadataJson`; required. It is checked against the stored state before the task is repriced.

oneOf.description: Run input settings for a workflow resource; null uses the defaults. Sending them for a process is rejected with HTTP 400 `TaskWorkflowInputSettingsResourceKindInvalid`.

Project write admission returned as `expectedProjectAdmission` by the structure read, sent back unchanged. Required: when it is omitted, null or names another project, the request is rejected with HTTP 409 `ProjectLifetimeRefreshRequired` and nothing is attached.

ProjectStructureTaskResourceAttachReques.description: Task resource attachment request: a workflow or process definition to attach to a canonical task, the task's execution state as last read and, for a workflow, its run input settings. Persons and agents are assigned with the task update instead.

pricing.description: How the task's estimate was repriced for the resource.

createdNodeId.description: Identifier of the node created under the task for the resource (for example a workflow node); null when no node was created.

ProjectStructureTaskResourceAttachResult.description: Result of a committed task resource attachment, with the repricing it caused.

status.description: Whether a price was determined, as a JSON integer: 0 Available, 1 Unavailable.

amount.description: Expected total cost for the task; null when no price is available.

currencyCode.description: Currency of `amount`, for example `EUR`; may be empty when unavailable.

source.description: Human-readable description of where the price comes from.

summary.description: Human-readable explanation of the price or of why none is available.

calculatedAtUtc.description: Instant (with offset) when the price was calculated.

sourceKind.description: Source used, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown, 1 CrmWorkforceRate, 2 AgentRunHistory, 3 WorkflowRunHistory, 4 ProcessRunHistory.

isAvailable.description: True when `status` is Available and `amount` has a value.

ProjectStructureTaskResourceCostQuote.description: Price the owner determined for a task resource, used to set the task's expected cost.

ProjectStructureTaskResourceCostQuoteSta.description: Whether a price could be determined for a task resource, as a JSON integer: 0 Available, 1 Unavailable.

ProjectStructureTaskResourceCostSource.description: Source the owner used to price a task resource, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (no usable source), 1 CrmWorkforceRate (a CRM/HR person's rate), 2 AgentRunHistory, 3 WorkflowRunHistory and 4 ProcessRunHistory (recorded execution cost of the agent, workflow or process).

ProjectStructureTaskResourceKind.description: Kind of resource selected for a task, as a JSON integer: 0 Person (a CRM/HR person party), 1 Agent (an AI agent party), 2 Workflow (a workflow definition), 3 Process (a process definition). Only Person and Agent can be direct task assignees.

kind.description: Kind of the selected resource, as a JSON integer: 0 Person, 1 Agent, 2 Workflow, 3 Process. Each operation states which kinds it accepts; a direct task assignee must be a Person or an Agent.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the selected resource: the party identifier of a person or agent, or the definition identifier of a workflow or process. Must not be the empty GUID.

versionId.description: Exact workflow version for a Workflow selection; must be null or omitted for every other kind.

ProjectStructureTaskResourceSelection.description: Resource selected for a task: a person or agent that works on it, or a workflow or process definition that executes it.

gesture.description: How the planned interval is being edited, as a JSON integer: 0 Move (shift the whole interval), 1 ResizeStart (change only the start), 2 ResizeEnd (change only the end), 3 SetInterval (set an explicit start and end). Other values are rejected with HTTP 400 `TaskUpdateRequestInvalid`.

affectedTasks.description: Every task whose interval changes, including the edited task itself. Only the edited task and tasks that depend on it may appear, each at most once.

criticalTaskIds.description: Optional node identifiers the client considers critical-path tasks, as plain strings. The owner does not use them to validate or store the schedule; null or omitted means an empty list, and a blank identifier is rejected with HTTP 400 `TaskUpdateRequestInvalid`.

ProjectStructureTaskScheduleAgentChange.description: Schedule change for the updated task: how the interval was edited and every task whose planned interval moves, each with the interval the caller read and the interval it proposes.

taskId.description: String node identifier of the canonical task, exactly as returned in `nodes[].id` by the structure read, for example `custom:3f2504e04f8911d39a0c0305e82c3301`. It must equal the `taskId` route value (ordinal, case-sensitive comparison); a different value is rejected with HTTP 400 `TaskRouteMismatch`. It is not the task title and not an object with a `value` member.

currentTitle.description: Task title from the caller's latest read (`nodes[].title`). It must match the stored title exactly (ordinal comparison); otherwise the update is rejected as stale with HTTP 409 `StaleTask`. Cannot be blank.

proposedTitle.description: Title the task should have after the update. Send the current title unchanged when not renaming. Cannot be blank.

currentProgressPercent.description: Progress from the caller's latest read (`nodes[].progressPercent`): -1 means progress is untracked, otherwise a value from 0 through 100. It is a precondition compared with the stored value, not the requested progress.

proposedProgressPercent.description: Requested tracked progress from 0 through 100. -1 (untracked) is not accepted here even when the current value is -1; send 0 to start tracking an untracked task without reporting progress.

currentEstimate.description: Estimate from the caller's latest read, taken from `workItem` in the task's `metadataJson` (`expectedEffortHours`, `expectedEffortUnit`, `expectedCostAmount`, `expectedCostCurrencyCode`; a member missing there is null). The owner compares it, after normalization, with the stored estimate.

proposedEstimate.description: Requested estimate, validated and normalized by the same policy as the current estimate. While the task has not started, a changed cost amount and currency are accepted; once work has started or finished, the stored cost amount and currency are kept and only the effort changes.

oneOf.description: Requested schedule move, or null to leave the planned interval unchanged. When present it must describe the edited task and every task whose interval moves with it, each with the interval the caller read.

assigneeChanged.description: True to apply `proposedAssignee` as the task's direct assignee; false to leave direct assignments untouched, in which case `proposedAssignee` is ignored.

oneOf.description: Direct assignee to set when `assigneeChanged` is true: a person or agent with a nonempty `resourceId` and no `versionId`. Null together with `assigneeChanged: true` removes the direct assignee. A task with more than one direct assignee cannot be changed through this request (HTTP 409 `AssignmentConflict`). Workflows and processes are attached through the task resource operation instead.

currentExecution.description: Execution state from the caller's latest read, taken from `workItem.executionState`, `workItem.actualStartedAtUtc` and `workItem.actualEndedAtUtc` in the task's `metadataJson`. Required; it is compared with the stored execution state.

proposedExecution.description: Requested execution state and actual timestamps. Allowed transitions: from NotStarted to Started, Completed or Cancelled; from Started to Completed or Cancelled; from Unknown to any state; and to the same state. Completed and Cancelled are final. The timestamps must match the requested state.

oneOf.description: Expected-cost basis from the caller's latest read, taken from `workItem.expectedCostBasis` in the task's `metadataJson`. This member must always be present: send null when the read returned no basis. Omitting it is rejected before the update is attempted. Do not construct a substitute basis.

currentDirectAssignmentRevision.description: Revision of the task's direct assignments from the caller's latest read, taken from `workItem.directAssignmentRevision` in the task's `metadataJson` (0 when absent). It counts committed assignment changes; it is not the number of assignees. Must not be negative.

oneOf.description: Project write admission returned as `expectedProjectAdmission` by the structure read, sent back unchanged. The HTTP operation requires it even though the schema allows null: when it is omitted, null or names another project, the update is rejected with HTTP 409 `ProjectLifetimeRefreshRequired` and nothing is written. Read the structure again to obtain a fresh admission; never construct one.

ProjectStructureTaskUpdateAgentInput.description: Task update request: the task state the caller last read (the current members) paired with the values it wants (the proposed members), sent as plain JSON with string task identifiers. Every current member is an edit precondition copied unchanged from the owner's latest read, never a guess and never the desired value; the owner rejects the whole update with HTTP 409 when any of them no longer matches the stored task. To leave a field unchanged, send the same value as its current and its proposed member. Enum members are JSON integers. The agent task update tool accepts the same shape but supplies its own project admission.

workflowId.description: Workflow definition to preselect, a GUID string; null leaves the choice to the owner.

versionId.description: Workflow version to preselect, a GUID string; null selects the definition's version.

oneOf.description: Input settings to preview; null uses the defaults.

selectedNodeIds.description: Node identifiers to include in the preview's input, as in `nodes[].id`; when sent it replaces `inputSettings.selectedNodeIds`.

ProjectStructureWorkflowAddOptionsInput.description: Workflow add-options query: optional preselection and input settings for previewing a workflow node under the route's parent node. Every member is optional.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project.

parentNode.description: The parent node the workflow node would be created under.

workflows.description: Every workflow definition, active ones first and then by name.

oneOf.description: Preselected workflow definition, a GUID string; null when none.
Preselected workflow version, a GUID string; null when none.

preview.description: Preview of the run input with these settings.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes, for example that no workflow definitions are available.

ProjectStructureWorkflowAddOptionsResult.description: Choices for adding a workflow node under a parent node: the available workflow definitions, the preselected one, the normalized input settings and a preview of the run input. Nothing is created.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow definition, a GUID string.

versionId.description: Version identifier of the definition, a GUID string.

displayName.description: Display name of the workflow.

description.description: Description of the workflow.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the definition, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Archived.

preferredBackend.description: Runtime backend the definition prefers, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions.

isSelectable.description: True when a workflow node can be created for this definition now.

disabledReason.description: Why the definition cannot be selected; empty when it can.

ProjectStructureWorkflowDefinitionOption.description: One workflow definition that can be added to a project structure.

oneOf.description: Identifier of the run, a GUID string; null when the node has no run.

state.description: Run state, as a JSON integer: 0 NotStarted, 1 Running, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Idle, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 Cancelled.

currentStepIndex.description: Index of the current step, from 0.

stepCount.description: Number of steps of the workflow, at least 1.

artifacts.description: Artifacts the run produced, oldest first.

createdNodeIds.description: Identifiers of structure nodes the run created, as in `nodes[].id`.

createdAssetIds.description: Identifiers of assets the run created, as GUID strings.

createdFilePaths.description: Storage paths of files the run created.

ProjectStructureWorkflowExecutionSummary.description: What a workflow node's latest run has done so far: its state, steps, artifacts and created items.

summary.description: Short description of the input.

inputJson.description: The run input as a JSON string that contains JSON; parse it before use.

sections.description: The input broken into display sections.

ProjectStructureWorkflowInputPreview.description: Preview of the input a workflow node's run would receive with the given settings.

value.description: Displayed value.

ProjectStructureWorkflowInputPreviewRow.description: One labeled value in a section of a workflow input preview.

summary.description: Short description of the section.

ProjectStructureWorkflowInputPreviewSect.description: One section of a workflow input preview, such as the project or the parent node.

includeProject.description: Include the project's details; must be true (HTTP 400 `WorkflowInputProjectRequired`).

includeParentNode.description: Include the parent node; must be true (HTTP 400 `WorkflowInputParentRequired`).

includeParentNodeDetails.description: Include the parent node's details; must be true (HTTP 400 `WorkflowInputParentRequired`).

includeParentSubtree.description: Also include the parent's subtree. Defaults to false.

includeAssets.description: Also include asset information. Defaults to true.

selectedNodeIds.description: Identifiers of further nodes to include, as in `nodes[].id`; blank entries and duplicates are removed.

additionalSources.description: Additional named sources; only enabled ones are kept.

manualInputJson.description: Manual input as a JSON string that contains JSON; blank means `{}`. Invalid JSON is rejected with HTTP 400 `WorkflowManualInputInvalid`.

ProjectStructureWorkflowInputSettings.description: What a workflow node puts into the input of its runs: project and parent-node details (always), optionally the parent's subtree, assets, selected nodes, additional named sources and manual JSON. Invalid settings are rejected with HTTP 400.

kind.description: Kind of source, as a JSON integer: 0 ParentNode, 1 ParentSubtree, 2 SelectedNode, 3 FilePath, 4 FolderPath, 5 ManualJson.

key.description: Name of the value in the run input; required when enabled and unique per kind, ignoring case (HTTP 400 `WorkflowInputSourceInvalid` or `WorkflowInputSourceDuplicate`).

label.description: Display label of the source; may be empty.

value.description: Value to include; required when enabled.

isEnabled.description: False to keep the source out of the run input; disabled sources are dropped. Defaults to true.

ProjectStructureWorkflowInputSource.description: One additional named value included in a workflow node's run input.

ProjectStructureWorkflowInputSourceKind.description: Kind of an additional input source for a workflow node, as a JSON integer: 0 ParentNode, 1 ParentSubtree, 2 SelectedNode, 3 FilePath (a file path passed as input), 4 FolderPath (a folder path passed as input), 5 ManualJson.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow definition, a GUID string as listed by the workflow add options; required and active.

versionId.description: Workflow version to pin, a GUID string; null or omitted selects the version the workflow catalog returns for the definition.

title.description: Title of the node; blank uses the workflow's name.

subtitle.description: Subtitle of the node; blank generates one from the workflow.

notes.description: Notes of the node; blank generates them from the workflow and the parent node.

oneOf.description: Run input settings; null uses the defaults.

x.description: Preferred horizontal canvas position; the node is placed near its parent automatically.

y.description: Preferred vertical canvas position; the node is placed near its parent automatically.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

ProjectStructureWorkflowNodeCreateInput.description: Workflow node creation request: which workflow definition (and optionally which version) a new WorkflowDefinition node under the route's parent node runs, and what its runs receive as input.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project that contains the node.

node.description: The created WorkflowDefinition node; its `metadataJson` holds the workflow and the input settings.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow definition the node runs, a GUID string.

workflowVersionId.description: Workflow version pinned by the node, a GUID string.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes about the creation; empty when there are none.

ProjectStructureWorkflowNodeCreateResult.description: Result of a committed workflow node creation.

oneOf.description: Runtime backend to request, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions; null uses the definition's preferred backend. When the requested backend cannot be used, the result carries a warning.

requestedBy.description: Display name of who requested the run, recorded with it. Defaults to `project-structure`.

leaseToken.description: Optional token of the caller's active Project lease on this project, from `POST /api/project-structure/leases/acquire`. When omitted, the operation uses the project lease the caller's identity already holds, or else takes a five-minute project lease for its own duration, waiting for another identity's lease that ends within 30 seconds (a longer one fails with HTTP 409 `LeaseConflict`); when sent, it must match the caller's active project lease, otherwise HTTP 409 `LeaseMissing` or `LeaseConflict`.

simulatedNodeIds.description: Identifiers of workflow steps (workflow graph nodes, not structure nodes) to simulate instead of executing; null or empty executes every step.

intentId.description: Caller-generated launch intent, a GUID; the empty GUID is rejected with HTTP 400 `WorkflowIntentRequired`. When omitted, a new intent is generated, so repeating the request starts another run.

ProjectStructureWorkflowNodeStartInput.description: Workflow node start request. Send a new `intentId` for every intended launch and the same one to retry it: a retry with the same intent returns the launch it created instead of starting another run.

projectId.description: Identifier of the project.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the workflow node, as in `nodes[].id`.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow definition, a GUID string.

workflowVersionId.description: Workflow version that runs, a GUID string.

runId.description: Identifier of the run reserved for this launch, a GUID string.

route.description: Application route that shows the run in the web UI; informational.

status.description: Status snapshot of the run at the time of the response.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes, for example that the request had no `intentId` or that an observer failed after admission.

intentId.description: Launch intent of this start, a GUID: the one sent, or the one generated when none was sent.

callerSuppliedIntent.description: True when the caller sent the intent; false when the owner generated it.

runAdmissionObserved.description: True when the run could be read back after the launch; false when its admission awaits observation.

ProjectStructureWorkflowNodeStartResult.description: Result of an admitted workflow node launch: the run reserved for the launch intent and its current status. It means the launch was admitted, not that the run finished; poll the node's workflow status. When the launch was admitted but a later step failed, the result still reports the retained run, with `status.delivery` Pending and a warning that it needs reconciliation.

kind.description: Kind of artifact, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 Json, 2 File, 3 Image, 4 Binary, 5 ToolReceipt, 6 PreviewSimulation.

storagePath.description: Where the artifact is stored in the application's storage; empty when it is not stored.

summary.description: Short description of the artifact.

ProjectStructureWorkflowRunArtifactSumma.description: One artifact a workflow run produced.

kind.description: Kind of event, as a JSON integer: 0 Started, 1 ExecutorInvoked, 2 ExecutorCompleted, 3 ExecutorFailed, 4 SuperStep, 5 Output, 6 Warning, 7 Error, 8 WaitingForInput, 9 Completed, 10 Cancelled, 11 Unknown, 12 ProviderReadEvidence.

message.description: Human-readable event message.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the workflow step (workflow graph node) the event belongs to; may be empty.

createdAtUtc.description: Instant (with offset) the event was recorded.

payloadJson.description: Event payload as a JSON string that contains JSON; empty when there is none.

ProjectStructureWorkflowRunEventSummary.description: One recorded event of a workflow run.

oneOf.description: Identifier of the run, a GUID string; null when the node has no run yet.

state.description: Run state, as a JSON integer: 0 NotStarted, 1 Running, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Idle, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 Cancelled.

status.description: Status text the node shows for this run state.

progressMode.description: Progress mode the node shows for this run state.

progressPercent.description: Progress from 0 through 100, derived from the run state and the current step.

markerIcon.description: Marker icon token the node shows for this run state.

markerTone.description: Marker tone token the node shows for this run state.

markerLabel.description: Marker label the node shows for this run state.

currentStepIndex.description: Index of the current step, from 0.

stepCount.description: Number of steps of the workflow, at least 1.

message.description: Human-readable status message.

summary.description: Execution summary of the run.

recentEvents.description: The run's last 12 events at most, oldest first.

delivery.description: How far the run's result has been delivered to the structure node, as a JSON integer: 0 Prepared, 1 Pending, 2 Applied, 3 Superseded, 4 TargetChanged, 5 TargetDeleted, 6 LegacyObservation (a run started before launch admissions were recorded), 7 AuthorityBlocked.

intentId.description: Launch intent of the run, a GUID; null for a run started before launch admissions were recorded.

admissionSequence.description: Order number of the launch admission among the node's launches; null for a run started before launch admissions were recorded.

ProjectStructureWorkflowRunStatus.description: Status snapshot of a workflow node's latest run, as shown on the node: run state, derived node status, progress and marker, step position, message, execution summary and recent events. A snapshot, not a completion signal: poll `GET /api/project-structure/projects/{projectId}/nodes/{nodeId}/workflow/status` until the state is final.

id.description: Identifier of the project; use it with the other `/api/projects` operations and with `/api/project-structure`.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the project, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 OnHold, 3 Completed, 4 Archived.

currentPhase.description: Name of the current phase as free text; empty when not set.

phaseCount.description: Number of phases of the project.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the project record was last saved, in UTC.

primaryCustomerName.description: Display name of the primary customer among the project's participants, or of the first customer by name when none is primary; empty when the project has no customer participant.

primaryDeliveryUnitName.description: Display name of the primary delivery unit among the project's participants, or of the first one by name; empty when there is none.

primaryOwnerName.description: Display name of the primary owner (a participating manager, team member or reviewer), or of the first one by name; empty when there is none.

relatedParties.description: Parties that participate in the project as a whole in its current lifetime (task assignments are not included), primary ones first, then by name; an empty array when there are none.

relatedPartySearchText.description: One line per related party in the form label:display name, joined by line breaks, for client-side filtering.

ProjectSummary.description: Summary of one project, as returned by project lists, project saves and hierarchy reads of the Projects and Project Structure APIs.

expectedEffortHours.description: Expected effort in hours, or null when no effort estimate is recorded. A supplied value must be greater than zero. It stays in hours when `expectedEffortUnit` is ManDays (one man-day is 8 hours by default), so never send an unconverted man-day quantity here.

expectedEffortUnit.description: Unit selected for entering and displaying the effort, as a JSON integer: 0 Hours, 1 ManDays. It does not change the unit of `expectedEffortHours`.

expectedCostAmount.description: Expected total monetary cost of the task, or null when no cost is recorded. A supplied amount must be from 0 through 1,000,000,000,000,000. It is a total estimate, not a rate.

expectedCostCurrencyCode.description: Currency of `expectedCostAmount`. When an amount is supplied the code is trimmed and upper-cased and must then be exactly three ASCII letters, for example `EUR`; this is a format check, not a lookup in a currency registry. When the amount is null the owner stores an empty code, so send an empty string in that case.

ProjectTaskEstimate.description: Expected effort and expected monetary cost of a canonical project task. Effort is always stored in hours, whatever unit is selected, and a null amount means unknown, not zero. The task owner validates and normalizes an estimate before comparing or storing it.

state.description: Execution state, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (no state recorded yet), 1 NotStarted, 2 Started, 3 Completed, 4 Cancelled. Completed and Cancelled are final.

actualStartedAtUtc.description: Instant work actually started, or null when it has not started.

actualEndedAtUtc.description: Instant work actually ended, or null when it has not ended.

ProjectTaskExecutionSnapshot.description: Recorded execution state of a canonical task with its actual start and end instants, separate from the planned schedule and from displayed progress. The timestamps must match the state: Unknown and NotStarted have neither, Started has an actual start and no actual end, Completed has both, and Cancelled has an actual end and may have an actual start. An actual end cannot precede the actual start.

ProjectTaskExecutionState.description: Recorded execution state of a canonical task. In HTTP request and response bodies it is a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (no state recorded yet), 1 NotStarted, 2 Started, 3 Completed, 4 Cancelled. Inside a node's `metadataJson` string it appears as the text tokens `unknown`, `notStarted`, `started`, `completed` and `cancelled`. Completed and Cancelled are final.

resourceKind.description: Kind of the priced resource, as a JSON integer: 0 Person, 1 Agent, 2 Workflow, 3 Process.

resourceId.description: Identifier of the priced person, agent, workflow or process definition.

resourceVersionId.description: Exact workflow version that was priced. Present only when `resourceKind` is Workflow; null otherwise.

source.description: Cost source the owner used, as a JSON integer: 1 CrmWorkforceRate, 2 AgentRunHistory, 3 WorkflowRunHistory, 4 ProcessRunHistory. 0 Unknown is never valid in a stored basis.

calculatedAtUtc.description: Instant the owner calculated the expected cost. Always present in a stored basis.

ProjectTaskExpectedCostBasis.description: Owner-calculated basis of a task's expected cost: which resource was priced, from which cost source and when. Clients copy it unchanged from a read; they never compose or edit it.

ProjectWorkflowDeliveryState.description: How far a workflow run's result has been delivered to its project structure node, as a JSON integer. 0 Prepared (the launch admission is recorded), 1 Pending (the run or its outputs are not fully observed and delivered yet), 2 Applied (the run's status and outputs are applied to the node), 3 Superseded (a newer launch of the node replaced it), 4 TargetChanged (the node's workflow settings changed after the launch, so the result is not applied), 5 TargetDeleted (the node or its project lifetime no longer exists), 6 LegacyObservation (a run started before launch admissions were recorded), 7 AuthorityBlocked (the launching authority no longer allows the delivery).

ProjectWorkItemEffortUnit.description: Unit in which a task's expected effort is entered and displayed. In HTTP request bodies it is a JSON integer: 0 Hours, 1 ManDays. Inside a node's `metadataJson` string it appears as the text tokens `hours` and `manDays`. The unit never changes the stored quantity, which is always in hours.

databaseProfileId.description: Identifier of the database profile (workspace data store) that holds the admitted project.

projectId.description: Identifier of the admitted project; it must equal the project addressed by the write.

lifetimeId.description: Identifier of the project lifetime (incarnation) the caller read. The owner assigns a new lifetime when a project is created and records its retirement, so this value fences writes prepared against another incarnation.

ProjectWriteAdmission.description: Owner-issued evidence that binds a later project write to the project lifetime the caller read. Read it from the owner (for example `expectedProjectAdmission` in a Project Structure read) and send it back unchanged; never construct or edit it. It is not a bearer token, lease or version number: a write whose admission names another project, or a lifetime that is no longer the project's current one (for example after the project was retired or deleted), is rejected so that a stale page cannot write into a different project incarnation.

PromptArtifactProvenance.description: Origin of a Prompt Gallery item, as a JSON integer: 0 User (created through the Gallery or this API), 1 PackagedComponentCatalog (imported from the prompt component catalog shipped with the product), 2 LegacyFactoryMigration, 3 WorkflowMigration, 4 ExternalImport, 5 WorkflowCreated (items imported into the Gallery by other parts of the product).

PromptArtifactStatus.description: Status of a Prompt Gallery item, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft (the item was last saved as a draft; set by every draft save), 1 Final (an immutable version was created from the current draft; set by version creation and by imports). Only Final items that are not archived are copied into the search projection.

code.description: Kind of issue, as a JSON integer: 0 Archived, 1 MissingFinalVersion, 2 ConsumerNotSupported, 3 ItemKindMismatch, 4 ProviderModelNotSupported.

severity.description: Severity, as a JSON integer: 0 Warning, 1 Error.

message.description: English explanation, for display; its wording can change.

isSuppressible.description: True for a warning that a saved suppression can mark: ItemKindMismatch or ProviderModelNotSupported during Selection.

isSuppressed.description: True when a saved suppression of the item for the evaluated consumer marks this warning.

PromptCompatibilityIssue.description: One problem found by a compatibility evaluation.

PromptCompatibilityIssueCode.description: Kind of compatibility issue, as a JSON integer: 0 Archived, 1 MissingFinalVersion, 2 ConsumerNotSupported, 3 ItemKindMismatch, 4 ProviderModelNotSupported. Only ItemKindMismatch and ProviderModelNotSupported can be suppressed, and only for Selection.

issues.description: The issues found; an empty array when the item fits the context.

canUse.description: True when no issue has severity Error, so the item can be used in the evaluated context.

hasVisibleWarnings.description: True when at least one warning is not marked by a saved suppression.

PromptCompatibilityResult.description: Result of a compatibility evaluation of a Prompt Gallery item; the evaluation changes nothing.

PromptCompatibilitySeverity.description: Severity of a compatibility issue, as a JSON integer: 0 Warning (the item can still be used), 1 Error (the item cannot be used in this context).

promptArtifactId.description: Identifier of the saved item; for a new item, its new identifier.

updatedAtUtc.description: The item's new `updatedAtUtc`; send it as `expectedUpdatedAtUtc` of the next draft save or version.

PromptDraftSaveReceipt.description: Result of a Prompt Gallery draft save.

archived.description: True archives the item and false restores it. Omitted means true.

promptArtifactId.description: Identifier of the Prompt Gallery item to evaluate, as returned by search or in `promptArtifactId` of a draft save.

oneOf.description: The consumer, purpose, required kind and provider and model to check against. Required.

PromptGalleryCompatibilityApiRequest.description: Request of `POST /api/prompt-gallery/compatibility/evaluate`: the item to check and the context it would be used in.

PromptGalleryCompatibilityPurpose.description: Why a compatibility evaluation is made, as a JSON integer: 0 Selection (choosing an item; item-kind and model mismatches are warnings that a saved suppression can mark), 1 Execution (running the item; every issue is an error and the item needs a version).

PromptGalleryConsumer.description: Part of the product that uses Prompt Gallery items, as a JSON integer: 0 Workflow, 1 AgentRuntime, 2 Chat, 3 ProjectWorkbench. An item that declares no supported consumers can be used by all of them.

consumer.description: Consumer that would use the item, as a JSON integer: 0 Workflow, 1 AgentRuntime, 2 Chat, 3 ProjectWorkbench; required.

purpose.description: Why the item is evaluated, as a JSON integer: 0 Selection, 1 Execution. Omitted means Selection.

oneOf.description: Kind of item the consumer needs, as a JSON integer: 0 FullPrompt, 1 Part. Null or omitted skips the kind check.

provider.description: Provider that would run the item, for example `OpenAi`; at most 120 characters, compared case-insensitively with the declared supported models. Null or blank, together with a blank `model`, skips the model check.

model.description: Model that would run the item; at most 200 characters, compared case-insensitively. Null or blank matches any model of the provider.

requiresFinalVersion.description: True requires a version also for Selection. Omitted means false; Execution always requires one.

PromptGalleryConsumerContext.description: The context in which a Prompt Gallery item would be used, for a compatibility evaluation. Members other than `consumer` may be omitted; an omitted member takes the default stated on it.

id.description: Identifier of the item to update; null to create an item. An identifier that no item has is rejected with 404.

projectId.description: Identifier of a project to associate the item with; null for none. Stored as sent without a check.

collectionId.description: Identifier of a collection to file the item under; null for none. Stored as sent without a check.

summary.description: Summary, at most 10,000 characters; required but can be empty. Trimmed.

kind.description: Kind of item, as a JSON integer: 0 FullPrompt, 1 Part.

phase.description: Free-text phase label, at most 80 characters after trimming; required but can be empty.

content.description: Draft content, at most 64,000 characters; required but can be empty (an empty draft cannot get a version). Stored as sent, without trimming.

tags.description: Tag names: at most 50, each 1 to 120 characters; trimmed and merged ignoring case. The list replaces the item's tags; null or omitted clears them.

supportedModels.description: Supported provider and model combinations: at most 100, unique ignoring case, at most one preferred. The list replaces the declared models; null or omitted clears them, which removes the model restriction.

supportedConsumers.description: Consumers that can use the item, each as a JSON integer: 0 Workflow, 1 AgentRuntime, 2 Chat, 3 ProjectWorkbench. The list replaces the declared consumers; null, omitted or empty means every consumer.

oneOf.description: Recommended model parameters; null or omitted clears all of them.

expectedUpdatedAtUtc.description: Required when `id` is set: the item's `updatedAtUtc` from the last read or save, compared exactly. A different value is rejected with `prompts.gallery.concurrency-conflict`. Ignored when creating.

PromptGalleryDraft.description: Request of `POST /api/prompt-gallery/items`: the draft content and metadata of a new item, or of an existing item whose draft is overwritten. Send `id`, `projectId` and `collectionId` explicitly (null when not used).

favorite.description: True marks the item as a favorite and false removes the mark. Omitted means true.

id.description: Identifier of the item (its prompt artifact identifier).

projectId.description: Identifier of the project the item is associated with; null when none. Not validated.

collectionId.description: Identifier of the collection the item is filed under; null when none. Not validated.

summary.description: Summary of the item; may be empty.

kind.description: Kind of item, as a JSON integer: 0 FullPrompt, 1 Part.

phase.description: Free-text phase label of the item; may be empty.

status.description: Status of the item, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Final.

isArchived.description: True when the item is archived.

draftContent.description: The current editable draft. It can differ from every version; read a version for immutable content.

currentVersionNumber.description: Number of the latest version; 0 when the item has no version.

tags.description: Tag names of the item, alphabetical.

templateTokens.description: Names of the template placeholders recorded when the item was imported from the packaged catalog, alphabetical. Draft saves do not update them, so items created through this API have none.
