supportedModels.description: Declared supported models, preferred first; an empty array means no restriction.

supportedConsumers.description: Declared supported consumers, each as a JSON integer: 0 Workflow, 1 AgentRuntime, 2 Chat, 3 ProjectWorkbench. An empty array means every consumer.

warningSuppressions.description: Saved warning suppressions of the item, by consumer and issue code.

recommendations.description: Recommended model parameters of the current draft.

versions.description: The item's immutable versions, newest first, without content.

createdAtUtc.description: When the item was created, in UTC.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the item last changed, in UTC. Send it as `expectedUpdatedAtUtc` of the next draft save or version.

isFavorite.description: True when the item is marked as a favorite.

PromptGalleryItemDetails.description: A Prompt Gallery item with its current draft, metadata and list of versions, returned by `GET /api/prompt-gallery/items/{promptId}`.

PromptGalleryItemKind.description: Kind of Prompt Gallery item, as a JSON integer: 0 FullPrompt (a complete prompt), 1 Part (a reusable part to combine with other prompt content).

items.description: Items on this page: favorites first, then by last update (newest first), title and identifier.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based index of this page, as requested.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of items per page, as requested.

totalCount.description: Number of items matching the filters across all pages.

totalPages.description: Number of pages at this page size; 0 when nothing matches.

PromptGalleryPageOfPromptGallerySearchIt.description: One page of Prompt Gallery search results.

PromptGalleryProjectionHealth.description: Health of the Prompt Gallery search projection, as a JSON integer: 0 Disabled (no projection is configured), 1 Ready, 2 RebuildRequired, 3 Failed. The projection drivers of this product report only Disabled or Ready.

state.description: Outcome, as a JSON integer: 0 Disabled (nothing was done), 1 Applied (the rebuild ran).

processedCount.description: Number of items written to the search index; 0 when the projection is disabled.

status.description: State of the projection after the operation.

PromptGalleryProjectionOperationResult.description: Result of a Prompt Gallery search projection rebuild.

PromptGalleryProjectionOperationState.description: Outcome of a Prompt Gallery projection operation, as a JSON integer: 0 Disabled (nothing was done because the projection is disabled), 1 Applied (the operation ran).

driverName.description: Name of the projection driver in use, for diagnostics.

enabled.description: True when a projection driver is configured and active.

health.description: Health of the projection, as a JSON integer: 0 Disabled, 1 Ready, 2 RebuildRequired, 3 Failed.

detail.description: English description of the state, for display.

PromptGalleryProjectionStatus.description: State of the Prompt Gallery search projection, the derived copy of Final, not archived items in the application's search index.

id.description: Identifier of the item (its prompt artifact identifier); use it with `GET /api/prompt-gallery/items/{promptId}`.

summary.description: Summary of the item; may be empty.

contentPreview.description: The first 280 characters of the current draft, not of a version.

kind.description: Kind of item, as a JSON integer: 0 FullPrompt, 1 Part.

phase.description: Free-text phase label of the item; may be empty.

status.description: Status of the item, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Final.

isArchived.description: True when the item is archived.

collectionName.description: Name of the collection the item is filed under, when a collection with the item's collection identifier exists; otherwise null.

tags.description: Tag names of the item, alphabetical.

supportedModels.description: Declared supported models, preferred first; an empty array means no restriction.

recommendations.description: Recommended model parameters of the current draft.

currentVersionNumber.description: Number of the latest version; 0 when the item has no version.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the item last changed, in UTC.

isFavorite.description: True when the item is marked as a favorite.

PromptGallerySearchItem.description: One Prompt Gallery item in search results, with a preview of its current draft.

provenance.description: Origin of the item, as a JSON integer: 0 User, 1 PackagedComponentCatalog, 2 LegacyFactoryMigration, 3 WorkflowMigration, 4 ExternalImport, 5 WorkflowCreated.

catalog.description: Name of the source catalog of an imported item; null when not imported.

key.description: Stable key of the item in its source catalog; null when not imported.

groupKey.description: Key of the group the item belongs to in its source catalog; null when not provided.

groupName.description: Name of that group; null when not provided.

itemKind.description: Kind of item as named by the source catalog; null when not provided.

orderIndex.description: Position of the item in its source group; null when not provided.

PromptGallerySourceInfo.description: Where a Prompt Gallery item came from. The catalog fields are filled for imported items and null for items created through the Gallery or this API.

id.description: Identifier of the version; use it with `GET /api/prompt-gallery/items/{promptId}/versions/{versionId}` to read its content.

versionNumber.description: Sequential number of the version within the item, starting at 1.

creationReason.description: Reason given when the version was created.

outputFormat.description: Output format recorded with the version, for example `Markdown`.

createdAtUtc.description: When the version was created, in UTC.

PromptGalleryVersionInfo.description: One immutable version of a Prompt Gallery item as listed in the item read, without its content.

promptArtifactId.description: Identifier of the Prompt Gallery item whose warning is suppressed or restored.

consumer.description: Consumer for which the warning is suppressed or restored, as a JSON integer: 0 Workflow, 1 AgentRuntime, 2 Chat, 3 ProjectWorkbench.

issueCode.description: Warning to suppress or restore, as a JSON integer: 3 ItemKindMismatch or 4 ProviderModelNotSupported. The other issue codes (0 Archived, 1 MissingFinalVersion, 2 ConsumerNotSupported) cannot be suppressed.

suppressed.description: True saves the suppression and false removes it. Omitted means true.

PromptGalleryWarningSuppressionApiReques.description: Request of `POST /api/prompt-gallery/warning-suppressions`: suppress or restore one compatibility warning of an item for one consumer.

maxOutputTokens.description: Recommended maximum number of output tokens, from 1 through 1,000,000.

topP.description: Recommended nucleus sampling (top-p) value, from 0 through 1.

PromptModelRecommendations.description: Recommended model parameters for running a Prompt Gallery item. Every value is optional; null or omitted means no recommendation.

provider.description: Provider name, for example `OpenAi`; 1 to 120 characters, trimmed. Compared case-insensitively.

model.description: Model name of that provider; 1 to 200 characters, trimmed. Compared case-insensitively.

isPreferred.description: True for the preferred combination; at most one entry of an item can be preferred. Omitted means false.

PromptProviderModel.description: A provider and model combination that a Prompt Gallery item declares as supported. An item without any entry has no model restriction.

creationReason.description: Why the version is created, 1 to 200 characters after trimming.

expectedUpdatedAtUtc.description: The item's `updatedAtUtc` from the read or draft save you reviewed; required and compared exactly.

outputFormat.description: Format that the prompt content is written in, for example `Markdown`; 1 to 80 characters, trimmed. Omitted means `Markdown`.

PromptVersionCreateRequest.description: Request of `POST /api/prompt-gallery/items/{promptId}/versions`: create the next immutable version from the item's current draft.

promptArtifactId.description: Identifier of the item the version belongs to.

versionNumber.description: Sequential number of the version within the item, starting at 1.

title.description: Title of the item when the version was created.

summary.description: Summary of the item when the version was created.

kind.description: Kind of the item when the version was created, as a JSON integer: 0 FullPrompt, 1 Part.

content.description: The immutable content of the version.

outputFormat.description: Output format recorded with the version, for example `Markdown`.

recommendations.description: Model recommendations captured with the version.

createdAtUtc.description: When the version was created, in UTC.

PromptVersionSnapshot.description: An immutable version of a Prompt Gallery item with its content, as created or read.

consumer.description: Consumer the suppression applies to, as a JSON integer: 0 Workflow, 1 AgentRuntime, 2 Chat, 3 ProjectWorkbench.

issueCode.description: Suppressed warning, as a JSON integer: 3 ItemKindMismatch or 4 ProviderModelNotSupported.

PromptWarningSuppression.description: A saved suppression of one compatibility warning of an item for one consumer, created with `POST /api/prompt-gallery/warning-suppressions`.

model.description: Identifier of the model to call through the provider profile; must not be blank.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt for the call. A blank value uses a built-in instruction for provider checks.

messages.description: Earlier conversation messages sent to the provider before the prompt. Send an empty array for a single question; a missing or null member is rejected with `providers.request-invalid`.

prompt.description: The new user prompt; must not be blank.

ProviderChatCompletionApiRequest.description: One chat completion request sent directly to a provider profile, outside any agent: the model to call, an optional system prompt, earlier conversation messages and the new prompt. Send every member.

providerId.description: Identifier of the provider profile whose change was stored.

canonicalCommitSucceeded.description: Always true: the provider-profile change itself was stored.

reconciliationRequired.description: Always true: follow-up reconciliation of the change is still pending.

warning.description: Human-readable explanation, currently "The provider change is saved; secondary reconciliation is pending." Do not parse it.

ProviderCommittedApiResponse.description: HTTP 202 answer of a provider operation whose provider-profile change was stored but whose follow-up reconciliation did not finish. The response also carries the header `CDA-Provider-Outcome: committed-reconciliation-pending`. The change is saved: do not repeat the request; read the provider profile to see its stored state.

purpose.description: What the secret is, as a JSON integer: 0 ProviderApiKey, 1 SourceAccessToken (always for imported profiles).

consumerKind.description: Owner of the credential, as a JSON integer: 0 ProviderProfile, 1 Source (always for imported profiles).

consumerId.description: Identifier of the owner, here the shared provider source.

ProviderCredentialBinding.description: Credential of a provider profile imported from a shared provider source: the source's access token, kept as a stored secret whose value is never returned. Null for local profiles.

ProviderCredentialConsumerKind.description: Owner of a provider credential, as a JSON integer: 0 ProviderProfile, 1 Source (a shared provider source).

ProviderCredentialPurpose.description: What a provider credential is, as a JSON integer: 0 ProviderApiKey (an API key of the provider), 1 SourceAccessToken (the access token of a shared provider source).

allowsStructuredOutput.description: True when every published model supports structured JSON output.

allowsVision.description: True when every published model accepts image input.

allowsNativeTools.description: Whether provider-native tools (code interpreter, file search, web search) may be used; false for imported profiles.

allowsHostedMcp.description: Whether provider-hosted MCP servers may be used; false for imported profiles.

allowsServiceManagedHistory.description: Whether the provider may keep the chat history; false for imported profiles.

allowsCompaction.description: Whether provider-side conversation compaction may be used; false for imported profiles.

allowsParallelFunctionTools.description: True when every published model supports parallel function tool calls.

ProviderFeatureConstraints.description: Features that a shared provider source allows for a provider profile imported from it; null for local profiles.

success.description: True when the provider answered the check as expected.

summary.description: Human-readable result of the check; do not parse it.

suggestedModels.description: Models the provider reported during the check; may be empty.

modelThinkingEffortCapabilities.description: Thinking-effort capabilities discovered for the provider's models during the check, or null when the check does not discover them.

ProviderHealthResult.description: Result of a provider profile health check, returned by `POST /api/agents/providers/{providerId}/test`.

ProviderKind.description: Kind of model provider behind a provider profile. Agent, provider and workflow operations use a JSON integer: 0 OpenAi (the OpenAI API or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including imported shared providers), 1 AzureOpenAi, 2 Ollama, 3 ComfyUi (an image-generation server). LLM Chats definitions, editors and provider options write it as camel-case text instead (`openAi`, `azureOpenAi`, `ollama`, `comfyUi`), while LLM Chats invocation attempts use the integer form.

id.description: Model identifier to use in requests.

displayName.description: Name to show for the model.

ProviderModelDisplayMetadata.description: Display name of a model published by a shared provider source.

baseModel.description: Existing model to derive from; required, trimmed.

targetModel.description: Name of the model to create or replace on the Ollama server; required, trimmed.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt built into the model; required, trimmed.

contextLength.description: Context window of the model in tokens, from 2048 through 262144.

ProviderModelMaintenanceEditorRequest.description: Request to create or update a derived model on an Ollama server of a provider profile, sent to `POST /api/agents/providers/{providerId}/ollama-modelfile`. The server asks the Ollama server to create the target model from the base model with the system prompt and the context length.

modelName.description: Name of the created or updated model.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt built into the model.

contextLength.description: Context window of the model in tokens.

modelfile.description: Ollama Modelfile text equivalent to the request, rendered by this server for display; the Ollama server receives the settings directly.

statusMessage.description: Status reported by the Ollama server; empty when it reported none.

ProviderModelMaintenanceEditorResult.description: Result of creating or updating a derived model on an Ollama server.

allowedModels.description: Identifiers of the models the source publishes, compared exactly; requests for any other model are refused.

ProviderModelSelectionConstraint.description: Models that a provider profile imported from a shared provider source may use; null for local profiles, which accept any model identifier.

model.description: Model identifier the capability applies to.

status.description: Whether an effort can be set, as a JSON integer: 0 Supported, 1 Unsupported, 2 Unknown; only Supported allows an effort.

source.description: Where the capability comes from, as a JSON integer: 0 Defined, 1 Discovered, 2 Configured.

allowedEfforts.description: Accepted effort levels, as JSON integers (0 None, 1 Low, 2 Medium, 3 High, 4 ExtraHigh, 5 Max, 6 Minimal); must be empty unless `status` is 0 Supported and not empty when it is.

modelFamily.description: Model family the capability was derived from, for example `qwen3`; may be empty.

summary.description: Human-readable explanation of the capability; may be empty.

controlMode.description: How thinking is controlled, as a JSON integer: 0 Unspecified, 1 BooleanToggle (`allowedEfforts` must be exactly None and Medium), 2 EffortLevels.

oneOf.description: Default effort published by a shared provider source, as a JSON integer (0 None, 1 Low, 2 Medium, 3 High, 4 ExtraHigh, 5 Max, 6 Minimal), or null; used only for profiles imported from that source.

omitTemperature.description: True when requests to the model must not carry a temperature; used only for profiles imported from a shared provider source.

ProviderModelThinkingEffortCapability.description: Thinking (reasoning) effort capability of one model of a provider profile: whether an effort can be set and which levels are accepted.

model.description: Model identifier the prices apply to, matched ignoring case; unique within a profile.

inputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Rate for input tokens not served from the prompt cache; not negative.

cachedInputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Rate for input tokens served from the prompt cache; not negative.

outputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Rate for output tokens; not negative.

tariffKind.description: Tariff of the model, as a JSON integer: 0 Unspecified (priced by the rates), 1 Configured (not used), 2 ExplicitFree (free of charge; every rate must be 0).

cacheWritePerMillionTokensUsd.description: Rate for prompt-cache write tokens, or null when the model has no separate rate; not negative.

longContextThresholdTokens.description: Input size in tokens above which the long-context rates apply, or null when the model has none. When any long-context value is set, this must be positive and the long-context input, cached input and output rates must be set.

longContextInputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Long-context rate for uncached input tokens, or null; not negative.

longContextCachedInputPerMillionTokensUs.description: Long-context rate for cached input tokens, or null; not negative.

longContextCacheWritePerMillionTokensUsd.description: Long-context rate for prompt-cache write tokens, or null; not negative.

longContextOutputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Long-context rate for output tokens, or null; not negative.

hasConfiguredStandardPrice.description: Set by the server: true when at least one standard rate is above 0.

ProviderModelTokenPrice.description: Token prices of one model of a provider profile, in US dollars per 1,000,000 tokens, used to estimate run costs. A row whose standard rates are all 0 counts as unpriced unless `tariffKind` is 2 ExplicitFree.

model.description: Model identifier the prices apply to; trimmed.

inputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Rate for input tokens not served from the prompt cache.

cachedInputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Rate for input tokens served from the prompt cache.

tariffKind.description: Tariff of the model, as a JSON integer: 0 Unspecified (priced by the rates, the default), 1 Configured (not used), 2 ExplicitFree (free of charge; every rate must be 0).

cacheWritePerMillionTokensUsd.description: Rate for prompt-cache write tokens, or null when the model has no separate rate.

longContextThresholdTokens.description: Input size in tokens above which the long-context rates apply, or null when the model has none.

longContextInputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Long-context rate for uncached input tokens, or null.

longContextCachedInputPerMillionTokensUs.description: Long-context rate for cached input tokens, or null.

longContextCacheWritePerMillionTokensUsd.description: Long-context rate for prompt-cache write tokens, or null.

longContextOutputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Long-context rate for output tokens, or null.

ProviderModelTokenPriceEditorModel.description: Editable token prices of one model of a provider profile, in US dollars per 1,000,000 tokens. Rows must have a model name that is unique ignoring case, no negative rate, only zero rates for an explicitly free tariff and, when any long-context value is set, a positive threshold with long-context input, cached input and output rates.

attemptId.description: Server-generated identifier of the write attempt. Must not be the all-zero GUID.

providerId.description: Identifier of the provider profile the write targeted, including the identifier assigned to a profile being created. Must not be the all-zero GUID.

kind.description: Kind of write, as a JSON integer: 0 Create, 1 Update, 2 Delete, 3 HealthPersistence (storing a provider test's health result), 4 ModelMaintenancePersistence (storing the profile after an Ollama model maintenance request). Another value is rejected with HTTP 400.

expectedConcurrencyToken.description: Concurrency token the write expected the stored profile to have, as sent in the editor's `expectedConcurrencyToken`; null when the write expected none.

intendedConcurrencyToken.description: Concurrency token the write would have stored, when the server recorded it; null otherwise.

submissionFingerprint.description: Server-computed fingerprint (hexadecimal SHA-256) of the submitted editor body, for correlating the attempt with the request; null when not recorded. Verification does not use it.

isCreate.description: True when `kind` is 0 Create. Computed by the server; ignored when the receipt is sent back.

ProviderMutationAttempt.description: Receipt of a provider-profile write whose outcome is unknown. The server returns it as the `attempt` member of the HTTP 409 unconfirmed-write response (code `agents.provider-write-unconfirmed`); send it back unchanged to `POST /api/agents/providers/mutations/verify` to find out whether the write took effect. Clients never build or edit a receipt.

ProviderMutationKind.description: Kind of provider-profile write recorded in an unconfirmed-write receipt, as a JSON integer: 0 Create (a new profile was being saved), 1 Update (an existing profile was being saved), 2 Delete (the profile was being deleted), 3 HealthPersistence (the health result of a provider test was being stored on the profile), 4 ModelMaintenancePersistence (the profile was being updated after an Ollama model maintenance request).

message.description: Human-readable explanation, currently "The mutation receipt is invalid."

ProviderMutationReceiptInvalidApiRespons.description: HTTP 400 body of `POST /api/agents/providers/mutations/verify` when the receipt is structurally invalid (an all-zero `attemptId` or `providerId`, or an undefined `kind`). This operation does not use the general `errors` envelope for this rejection. Describes the response only; the server writes the same JSON members.

ProviderNetworkAccessPolicy.description: Network addresses that calls through a provider profile may reach, as a JSON integer: 0 Default (local profiles; no shared-source network policy applies), 1 PublicOnly (public addresses only), 2 AllowPrivateNetwork (private network addresses allowed). Profiles imported from a shared provider source take the policy of their source.

id.description: Identifier of the profile.

kind.description: Provider kind, as a JSON integer: 0 OpenAi (OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; also every imported profile), 1 AzureOpenAi, 2 Ollama, 3 ComfyUi.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider's API.

apiKeyEnvironmentVariable.description: Reference to the stored credential, `secret:` followed by the secret's GUID, or an empty string when the profile has none. The credential itself is never returned.

defaultModel.description: Model used when an agent or request names none.

transport.description: API style used to call the models, as a JSON integer: 0 Responses, 1 ChatCompletions (always for Ollama).

isEnabled.description: True when the profile can be used. An imported profile is false whenever its import is unavailable; the reason is in `healthStatus`.

supportsStreaming.description: True when responses are streamed from the provider.

supportsTools.description: True when the profile's models may be given tools.

preferFrameworkManagedChatHistory.description: Set by the server: true when the product keeps and resends the chat history, as for Ollama, ComfyUI and the ChatCompletions transport.

supportsBackgroundResponses.description: Set by the server: true only for OpenAI profiles on the Responses transport.

configurationJson.description: Additional settings as the text of a JSON object, for example `timeoutSeconds` (the request timeout in seconds); returned as stored apart from the secret reference.

notes.description: Display name of the provider connector for local profiles, or a fixed description for imported profiles and the built-in fallback profile; not a stored free-text note.

healthStatus.description: For local profiles the result of the last health check, or `Not checked`; for imported profiles the availability of the import, for example `Available` or `SourceOffline`.

lastCheckedAtUtc.description: When the last health check ran, in UTC; null when the profile was never checked and for imported profiles.

suggestedModels.description: Models offered when choosing a model for the profile.

purpose.description: What the profile is used for, as a JSON integer: 0 Chat, 1 ImageGeneration.

connectorPluginKey.description: Key of the connector that manages the profile, for example `provider.openai`, `provider.ollama.local`, `provider.ollama.remote`, `provider.comfyui.local` or `provider.candoitall-shared` (imported profiles).

oneOf.description: Credential of an imported profile (its shared provider source's access token); null for local profiles.

networkAccessPolicy.description: Network addresses the profile may reach, as a JSON integer: 0 Default (local profiles), 1 PublicOnly, 2 AllowPrivateNetwork; imported profiles take the policy of their source.

oneOf.description: Features the shared provider source allows for an imported profile; null for local profiles.
Models an imported profile may use; null for local profiles.

isPrivateProvider.description: True for a privately hosted provider; always true for Ollama and ComfyUI profiles.

isSourceManaged.description: True when the profile is imported from a shared provider source and managed by it; such profiles cannot be saved or deleted here.

modelCatalog.description: Display names of the models published by the shared provider source; empty for local profiles.

modelPrices.description: Token prices of the profile's models, used to estimate run costs; the default model's row comes first.

pricingSourceRevision.description: Version marker of the prices, recorded in the provider request history to tell which prices were used; null for profiles without one.

tags.description: Labels of the profile, lowercase and sorted, for example `openai`, `local` or `chat`.

modelThinkingEffortCapabilities.description: Thinking-effort capabilities stored for the profile's models, for example those discovered by a health check. Which capability applies to a model also depends on the provider kind and the profile configuration.

ProviderProfile.description: A model provider profile: a configured connection to a model provider, listed by `GET /api/agents/providers` and referenced by agents through `providerProfileId`. The model is chosen separately within the profile. Local profiles are edited with `GET /api/agents/providers/{providerId}/editor` and `POST /api/agents/providers`; profiles imported from a shared provider source (`isSourceManaged` true) are managed by that source. Publishing a local profile to other hosts is a separate shared-provider publication.

id.description: Identifier of the profile: null (the server assigns one) or a new identifier to create a profile, or the identifier of an existing local profile to replace it. The all-zero GUID is rejected.

expectedConcurrencyToken.description: Concurrency token from the editor read: send it unchanged to replace a profile; a stale token is rejected with HTTP 409. Send null to create, or the all-zero GUID to create only when no profile with `id` exists.

name.description: Display name of the profile; must not be blank.

kind.description: Provider kind, as a JSON integer: 0 OpenAi (the default; OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint), 1 AzureOpenAi, 2 Ollama, 3 ComfyUi.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the provider's API: an absolute http or https URL without user information, query or fragment.

apiKeyEnvironmentVariable.description: Reference to the stored API key: an empty string for none, or `secret:` followed by the identifier of an existing stored secret. Environment variable names and raw keys are rejected. OpenAI and Azure OpenAI profiles require a reference.

defaultModel.description: Model used when an agent or request names none; blank becomes the connector's default model.

transport.description: API style, as a JSON integer: 0 Responses (the default), 1 ChatCompletions; Ollama requires ChatCompletions.

purpose.description: What the profile is used for, as a JSON integer: 0 Chat (the default), 1 ImageGeneration.

isEnabled.description: True (the default) to make the profile usable.

supportsStreaming.description: True (the default) to stream responses from the provider.

supportsTools.description: True (the default) to allow giving tools to the profile's models.

preferFrameworkManagedChatHistory.description: Not stored: the server derives it from the kind and transport.

supportsBackgroundResponses.description: Not stored: the server derives it from the kind and transport.

configurationJson.description: Additional settings as the text of a JSON object, or empty. `timeoutSeconds` sets the request timeout (an integer of at least 5). When storing it the server adds its own metadata members, such as the connector key.

notes.description: Not stored. The editor read returns the provider connector's display name here.

isPrivateProvider.description: True for a privately hosted provider; Ollama and ComfyUI profiles are always treated as private.

suggestedModels.description: Models offered when choosing a model for the profile; blank entries and duplicates are dropped.

modelPrices.description: Token prices of the profile's models, in US dollars per 1,000,000 tokens, used to estimate run costs.

tags.description: Labels of the profile; trimmed, a leading `#` removed, lower-cased and de-duplicated.

modelThinkingEffortCapabilities.description: Thinking-effort capabilities to store for the profile's models; null or empty stores none. Ignored when `configurationJson` contains `modelThinkingEffortCapabilities`, which then takes precedence.

ProviderProfileEditorModel.description: Editable form of a local provider profile, read from `GET /api/agents/providers/{providerId}/editor` and sent whole to `POST /api/agents/providers`. A save replaces the stored profile with this form; profiles imported from a shared provider source can be read but not saved. Never put a raw API key in any member.

ProviderProfilePurpose.description: What a provider profile is used for, as a JSON integer: 0 Chat (text generation for agents and chats), 1 ImageGeneration (image generation tools and workflow steps).

ProviderTariffKind.description: Tariff of a priced model, as a JSON integer: 0 Unspecified (priced by the configured rates), 1 Configured (not used), 2 ExplicitFree (free of charge; every rate must be 0).

role.description: Author of the message, as a JSON integer: 0 System, 1 User, 2 Assistant; other values are sent as a user message.

content.description: Text of the message, trimmed; a blank message is left out.

createdAtUtc.description: When the message was written; messages are sent in the order of this time.

ProviderTestChatMessage.description: An earlier message of a provider test chat, sent to the provider before the prompt.

model.description: Model to use; blank uses the profile's default model, then its first suggested model.

systemPrompt.description: System instructions; blank uses a short built-in instruction for validating a provider profile.

messages.description: Earlier messages to send before the prompt, ordered by their `createdAtUtc`; may be empty.

prompt.description: The new user message; may be blank when `messages` is not empty.

ProviderTestChatRequest.description: Conversation to send through a provider profile with `POST /api/agents/providers/{providerId}/test-chat`. It is sent directly to the provider; no agent, chat session or execution run is involved. The prompt or at least one message is required.

model.description: Model that answered, as reported for the request.

responseText.description: The model's reply; never empty (an empty reply fails the request).

inputTokens.description: Input tokens reported by the provider; 0 when not reported.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens reported by the provider; 0 when not reported.

ProviderTestChatResult.description: Reply to a provider test chat.

ProviderTransportKind.description: API style used to call a provider profile's models, as a JSON integer: 0 Responses (the OpenAI Responses API), 1 ChatCompletions (the Chat Completions API).

providerId.description: Identifier of the provider profile named by the receipt.

outcome.description: Whether the write took effect, as text: `Committed` (the stored profile shows the write), `DefinitelyNotCommitted` (the stored profile shows it did not happen; it may be submitted again after reading the current profile) or `StillUnconfirmed` (not provable, or the profile could not be read; verify again later).

concurrencyToken.description: Concurrency token of the stored profile as read during verification; null when the profile does not exist or could not be read. Use a fresh editor read, not this value, before another write.

automaticReplaySafe.description: Always false: never repeat the original write automatically.

ProviderVerificationApiResponse.description: Result of verifying an unconfirmed provider-profile write, returned by `POST /api/agents/providers/mutations/verify` with the header `Cache-Control: no-store`.

ProviderVerificationDisposition.description: Result of checking an unconfirmed provider-profile write against the stored profile, written as the text name of the member. Committed: the stored profile shows that the write took effect (a created profile exists, a deleted one is gone, or an update's intended concurrency token is stored). DefinitelyNotCommitted: the stored profile shows that it did not (a created profile does not exist, or the token the write expected is still stored). StillUnconfirmed: the stored state proves neither, or the profile could not be read; check again later and do not repeat the write blindly.

id.description: Identifier of the recruitment application.

partyId.description: Identifier of the candidate's party; send it back unchanged when saving, otherwise a new candidate party is created.

candidateName.description: Display name of the candidate party. A save that sends `partyId` ignores it.

candidateEmail.description: The candidate's primary public email address, or another public one; empty when there is none. A save that sends `partyId` ignores it.

candidatePhone.description: The candidate's primary public phone number, or another public one; empty when there is none. A save that sends `partyId` ignores it.

candidateSummary.description: Always empty in this response; the candidate's summary is `candidateSummary` of the workspace.

targetUnitPartyId.description: Identifier of the organization or organization unit the candidate would join; null when none.

recruiterPartyId.description: Identifier of the person who recruits the candidate; null when none.

hiringManagerPartyId.description: Identifier of the person who decides on the hire; null when none.

source.description: Where the application came from, as free text; empty when not set.

stage.description: Stage of the application, as a JSON integer: 0 Applied, 1 Screening, 2 Interviewing, 3 Offer, 4 Hired, 5 Rejected, 6 Withdrawn.

availableFrom.description: Date the candidate can start (`yyyy-MM-dd`); null when unknown.

decision.description: Hiring decision, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 Approved, 2 Rejected, 3 Withdrawn.

stageNotes.description: Always empty in this response; recorded stage notes are in `stageHistory` of the workspace.

notes.description: Free-text notes of the application; empty when not set.

lastChangedBy.description: Not a stored value: always `crm-hr-ui` in this response. The save request does not carry it.

id.description: Identifier of the recruitment application; use it with `GET /api/crm-hr/recruiting/applications/{applicationId}`.

partyId.description: Identifier of the candidate's party; not the application identifier.

candidatePartyType.description: Kind of the candidate party, as a JSON integer: 0 Person or 3 AiAgent (1 Organization and 2 OrganizationUnit are not accepted as candidates).

candidateName.description: Display name of the candidate party.

stage.description: Stage of the application, as a JSON integer: 0 Applied, 1 Screening, 2 Interviewing, 3 Offer, 4 Hired, 5 Rejected, 6 Withdrawn.

decision.description: Hiring decision, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 Approved, 2 Rejected, 3 Withdrawn.

recruiterName.description: Display name of the recruiter; empty when none.

hiringManagerName.description: Display name of the hiring manager; empty when none.

targetUnitName.description: Display name of the target organization or unit; empty when none.

primaryEmail.description: The candidate's primary public email address, or another public one when none is primary; empty when there is none. Returned also for sensitive candidates.

primaryPhone.description: The candidate's primary public phone number, or another public one when none is primary; empty when there is none. Returned also for sensitive candidates.

availableFrom.description: Date the candidate can start (`yyyy-MM-dd`); null when unknown.

hasWorkforceProfile.description: True when the candidate party has a workforce profile, for example after conversion.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the application last changed, in UTC; the list is ordered by it, newest first.

RecruitmentApplicationListItemModel.description: One recruitment application in the list returned by `GET /api/crm-hr/recruiting/applications`.

items.description: Applications on this page, most recently updated first.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of applications per page that was applied.

totalCount.description: Number of applications matching the filters across all pages.

RecruitmentApplicationPage.description: One page of recruitment applications matching a query. It has no page count: request the next page while (`pageIndex` + 1) multiplied by `pageSize` is less than `totalCount`.

id.description: Identifier of the application to update, from `GET /api/crm-hr/recruiting/applications`. Omit it to create an application; an unknown identifier creates a new application with a new identifier.

partyId.description: Identifier of the candidate's existing person or AI agent party. When null or omitted, a new person party is created from `candidateName` and the other candidate fields, also when updating an application; so when updating, always send it.

candidateName.description: Display name of a new candidate party; required when `partyId` is omitted and ignored otherwise.

candidateEmail.description: Email address of a new candidate party, stored as its primary public email contact point; ignored when `partyId` is sent.

candidatePhone.description: Phone number of a new candidate party, stored as a public phone contact point (primary when no email is sent); ignored when `partyId` is sent.

candidateSummary.description: Summary of a new candidate party; ignored when `partyId` is sent.

targetUnitPartyId.description: Organization or organization unit the candidate would join; it must be an existing organization or organization unit. Null or omitted means none.

recruiterPartyId.description: Person who recruits the candidate; it must be an existing person. Null or omitted means none.

hiringManagerPartyId.description: Person who decides on the hire; it must be an existing person other than the candidate. Null or omitted means none.

desiredRole.description: Role the candidate applies for; required and trimmed.

source.description: Where the application came from, for example `Referral`; free text, trimmed. Omitted means empty.

stage.description: Current stage of the application, as a JSON integer: 0 Applied, 1 Screening, 2 Interviewing, 3 Offer, 4 Hired, 5 Rejected, 6 Withdrawn. Stored as sent without transition checks. Omitted means Applied (0).

availableFrom.description: Date the candidate can start (`yyyy-MM-dd`). Null or omitted means unknown.

decision.description: Current hiring decision, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 Approved, 2 Rejected, 3 Withdrawn; conversion requires Approved. Omitted means Pending (0).

stageNotes.description: Note recorded in the stage history when this save creates the application or changes its stage; otherwise ignored. It is not stored as a field of the application.

notes.description: Free-text notes of the application; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

RecruitmentApplicationSaveApiRequest.description: Request of `POST /api/crm-hr/recruiting/applications`: a recruitment application and its candidate. All application fields are overwritten; when updating, start from `application` of the recruitment workspace.

RecruitmentApplicationScope.description: Stage filter of the recruitment application list, as a JSON integer or, in the query string, as the case-sensitive member name: 0 All (every stage), 1 Applied, 2 Screening, 3 Interviewing, 4 Offer, 5 Hired, 6 Rejected, 7 Withdrawn; each value except All selects the applications in that stage. It filters records; it is not an authorization scope.

applicationId.description: Identifier of the recruitment application to convert; required. Its decision must be Approved.

workforceKind.description: Work classification of the new profile, as a JSON integer: 0 Employee, 1 Contractor, 2 Freelancer, 3 DeliveryUnit. Omitted means Employee (0); a person candidate cannot use DeliveryUnit.

jobTitle.description: Job title of the profile; blank or omitted uses the application's desired role.

discipline.description: Professional discipline of the profile as free text. Omitted means empty.

seniority.description: Seniority level of the profile as free text. Omitted means empty.

homeUnitPartyId.description: Organization or organization unit of the profile; null or omitted uses the application's target unit.

managerPartyId.description: Manager of the profile, an existing person; null or omitted uses the candidate's support manager, or else the application's hiring manager.

startDate.description: Date the work relationship starts (`yyyy-MM-dd`). Null or omitted means not set.

location.description: Work location as free text. Omitted means empty.

timeZone.description: Time zone as free text, for example `Europe/Prague`. Omitted means empty.

capacityHoursPerWeek.description: Weekly working capacity in hours; 0 or less means 40. Omitted means 40.

status.description: Employment status of the profile as free text; blank means `Active`. Omitted means `Active`.

notes.description: Notes of the profile; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

RecruitmentConversionApiRequest.description: Request of `POST /api/crm-hr/recruiting/conversions`: the application to convert and the workforce profile values of the candidate. Start from `conversion` of the recruitment workspace.

applicationId.description: Identifier of the application to convert.

workforceKind.description: Work classification, as a JSON integer: 0 Employee, 1 Contractor, 2 Freelancer, 3 DeliveryUnit; taken from the existing workforce profile, otherwise Employee.

jobTitle.description: Job title from the existing workforce profile, otherwise the application's desired role.

discipline.description: Discipline from the existing workforce profile, otherwise empty.

seniority.description: Seniority from the existing workforce profile, otherwise empty.

homeUnitPartyId.description: Home unit from the existing workforce profile, otherwise the application's target unit; null when neither.

managerPartyId.description: Manager from the existing workforce profile, otherwise the candidate's support manager, otherwise the application's hiring manager; null when none.

startDate.description: Start date from the existing workforce profile (`yyyy-MM-dd`); null otherwise.

location.description: Location from the existing workforce profile, otherwise empty.

timeZone.description: Time zone from the existing workforce profile, otherwise empty.

capacityHoursPerWeek.description: Weekly capacity in hours from the existing workforce profile, otherwise 40.

status.description: Employment status from the existing workforce profile, otherwise `Active`.

notes.description: Notes from the existing workforce profile, otherwise empty.

lastChangedBy.description: Not a stored value: always `crm-hr-ui` in this response. The conversion request does not carry it.

RecruitmentConversionEditorModel.description: A conversion request prepared from the application and from the candidate's existing workforce profile, returned in the recruitment workspace. Review it and send it to `POST /api/crm-hr/recruiting/conversions`.

RecruitmentDecision.description: Hiring decision of a recruitment application, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 Approved (required before conversion), 2 Rejected, 3 Withdrawn.

id.description: Identifier of the interview; send it as `id` to update the interview.

applicationId.description: Identifier of the recruitment application the interview belongs to.

scheduledAtUtc.description: Start of the interview, in UTC.

interviewType.description: Kind of interview, as a JSON integer: 0 Screening, 1 Technical, 2 Manager, 3 Panel, 4 Culture.

interviewerPartyId.description: Identifier of the interviewing person; null when none.

interviewerName.description: Display name of the interviewing person; empty when none.

outcome.description: Result of the interview, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 StrongYes, 2 Yes, 3 Mixed, 4 No, 5 StrongNo.

recommendation.description: Interviewer recommendation as free text; empty when not set.

feedback.description: Interviewer feedback; empty when not set.

interviewerPartyId.description: Person who conducts the interview; it must be an existing person. Null or omitted means none.

outcome.description: Result of the interview, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 StrongYes, 2 Yes, 3 Mixed, 4 No, 5 StrongNo. Omitted means Pending (0). It does not change the application's stage or decision.

feedback.description: Interviewer feedback; free text, trimmed. Omitted means empty.

recommendation.description: Interviewer recommendation as free text, for example `Proceed to offer`; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

id.description: Identifier of the history entry.

stage.description: Stage the application entered, as a JSON integer: 0 Applied, 1 Screening, 2 Interviewing, 3 Offer, 4 Hired, 5 Rejected, 6 Withdrawn.

managerPartyId.description: Identifier of the person the party is managed by; null when none. When the party has several ManagedBy relationships, one of them is returned.

managerName.description: Display name of the manager; empty when none.

buddyPartyId.description: Identifier of the buddy; null when none.

buddyName.description: Display name of the buddy; empty when none.

mentorPartyId.description: Identifier of the mentor; null when none.

application.description: The application, in the shape of the application save request.

candidatePrimaryPhone.description: The candidate's primary public phone number, or another public one when none is primary; empty when there is none.

oneOf.description: Kind of the candidate party, as a JSON integer: 0 Person or 3 AiAgent; null only when the party record is missing.

candidateTechnicalAgentId.description: For an AI agent candidate, the identifier of the technical agent definition in the Agents module that the party is linked to; null for people and for AI agents without a link.

supportAssignments.description: Manager, buddy and mentor of the candidate party.

conversion.description: Conversion request prepared from the application and any existing workforce profile.

title.description: New title. Trimmed, at most 200 characters; null, empty or blank becomes `New chat`.

expectedTranscriptRevision.description: The conversation's `transcriptRevision` from your last read. It must equal the current transcript revision.

RenameLlmChatConversationApiRequest.description: Body of `PATCH /api/llm-conversations/{conversationId}/title`: the new title and the preconditions from your last read of the conversation. Members not listed here are rejected.

RunOutcome.description: Final outcome of an agent execution run or run segment, as a JSON integer: 0 Succeeded, 1 Failed, 2 Cancelled. Query parameters accept the member name or the integer; server-sent event streams write camel-case text such as `cancelled`.

RuntimeDeploymentArchitecture.description: Processor architecture of a publish target, as a string token: `X64` or `Arm64`.

RuntimeDeploymentEvidenceLevel.description: Evidence behind a deployment support claim, as a string token: `ActualHostValidated` (validated on a real host of that kind) or `ActualHostUnverified` (built and tested, but not yet validated on a real host).

RuntimeDeploymentPublishMode.description: How the host is published, as a string token: `FrameworkDependent` (the host needs a matching installed .NET runtime).

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest format; currently 1.

publishMode.description: How the host is published, as a string token: `FrameworkDependent`.

headlessCoreRequiresDesktopCapabilities.description: Whether the headless core needs desktop capabilities; always false in a valid manifest.

prerequisites.description: Human-readable prerequisites for running the host, such as the required .NET runtime and PostgreSQL version.

deferredValidationIds.description: Identifiers of support validations that are still pending, for example `MACOS-KEYCHAIN-VALIDATION-001`.

RuntimeDeploymentSupportManifest.description: Deployment support manifest embedded in this build of the host: how it is published, the supported publish targets and headless host profiles, the prerequisites and the validations still pending. It describes the build, not the current host.

profile.description: The host profile, as a string token: `WindowsHeadless`, `LinuxHeadless` or `MacOsHeadless`.

baselineSecretProvider.description: Secret-vault provider the profile uses by default, as a string token, for example `Dpapi` or `LocalUserFile`; the full token list is on the `SecretVaultProviderKind` schema.

baselineProtectionLevel.description: Protection of that secret storage, as a string token: `Unknown`, `DevelopmentOnly`, `BasicLocal` or `Strong`.

runtimeEvidence.description: Evidence for the profile, as a string token: `ActualHostValidated` or `ActualHostUnverified`.

RuntimeDeploymentSupportProfile.description: One supported headless host profile in the deployment support manifest, with the secret storage it uses by default.

runtimeIdentifier.description: .NET runtime identifier of the target: `win-x64`, `linux-x64`, `osx-x64` or `osx-arm64`.

operatingSystem.description: Operating system of the target, as a string token: `Windows`, `Linux` or `MacOs`.

architecture.description: Processor architecture, as a string token: `X64` or `Arm64`.

runtimeEvidence.description: Evidence for the target, as a string token: `ActualHostValidated` or `ActualHostUnverified`.

RuntimeDeploymentSupportTarget.description: One supported publish target of the host in the deployment support manifest.

RuntimeHostOperatingSystem.description: Operating system of a runtime host or publish target, as a string token: `Windows`, `Linux` or `MacOs`.

RuntimeHostProfileKind.description: Runtime host profile, as a string token: `Auto` (configuration value only: resolve the profile from the operating system and the secret-vault usage profile), `WindowsInteractive`, `WindowsHeadless`, `LinuxInteractive`, `LinuxHeadless`, `MacOsInteractive`, `MacOsHeadless` or `Test` (development test hosts only). Interactive profiles run with a desktop session; headless profiles run as a service or in a container.

RuntimeOperationalState.description: Operational state of the host, as a string token: `Starting` (startup has not finished), `Ready` (startup finished, including the preparation of the active database) or `Unavailable` (not ready for another reason, for example a failed startup step).

state.description: Operational state, as a string token: `Starting`, `Ready` or `Unavailable`. Only `Ready` means the host finished starting.

databaseAndMigrationsReady.description: True when the host reports itself ready, which happens only after its startup prepared the active database, including the migrations. It is true exactly when `state` is `Ready`.

deploymentSupport.description: The deployment support manifest embedded in this build.

hostCapabilities.description: The current host capability snapshot, the same as `GET /api/runtime/capabilities` returns.

RuntimeOperationsSnapshot.description: Operational snapshot returned by `GET /api/runtime/operations`: whether the host finished starting, the deployment support manifest of this build and the current host capability snapshot.

value.description: The name: a lower-case ASCII letter followed by at most 127 lower-case letters, digits or underscores.

RuntimeToolName.description: Name of a runtime tool as offered to the model, in lower snake case, for example `read_file`. It is serialized as an object whose `value` member holds the name.

SecretVaultProtectionLevel.description: Protection offered by a secret vault. Where the runtime API reports it, it is a string token: `Unknown`, `DevelopmentOnly` (acceptable for development only), `BasicLocal` (encrypted in a permission-restricted local file whose key the same operating-system account can read) or `Strong` (for example the Windows Data Protection API).

SecretVaultProviderKind.description: Secret-vault provider. Where the runtime API reports it, it is a string token: `Auto` (chosen from the host profile), `Dpapi` (Windows Data Protection API), `MauiSecureStorage`, `MacOsKeychain`, `LinuxSecretService`, `ExternalWrappingKeyFile` (encrypted file whose key comes from outside the vault), `LocalUserFile` (encrypted permission-restricted local file), `DataProtectionFile` (legacy local file, development or migration only), `AzureKeyVault`, `HashiCorp` or `InMemory` (process memory only).

operationId.description: A new GUID generated by the client for this turn. It becomes the operation identifier and the turn identifier and is the idempotency key: resend the same value with an identical body to retry an ambiguous request, and use a new value for every new turn. The empty GUID is rejected.

expectedTranscriptRevision.description: The conversation's current `transcriptRevision`, from `GET /api/llm-conversations/{conversationId}` or the previous successful turn's `resultingTranscriptRevision`. Not negative; a stale value is rejected with 409 `llm-chat.transcript-revision-conflict`.

message.description: The user message, stored in the transcript exactly as sent. Not blank; at most 400,000 characters (UTF-16 code units).

SendLlmChatTurnApiRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/llm-conversations/{conversationId}/turns`: one user message with the preconditions of the turn. Resending an `operationId` is a replay only when the conversation, `expectedTranscriptRevision` and `message` are identical; otherwise it is rejected. Members not listed here are rejected.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the catalog protocol, as a string: always `1.1`.

sourceInstanceId.description: Identifier of the publishing host instance, as a GUID string. It stays the same for the host, so a consumer can detect that a source address now serves a different host.

catalogRevision.description: Revision of the whole catalog, as `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; it changes whenever the public catalog changes.

protocols.description: Protocol entry points of the publishing host.

providers.description: The shared publications, sorted by publication identifier; empty when nothing is shared.

SharedProviderCatalogDocument.description: Catalog of the providers a host shares, returned by `GET /api/shared-providers/v1/catalog`. It is versioned, sorted and content-addressed: `catalogRevision` identifies this exact content and equals the response's `ETag` without quotes. Unknown members are not allowed in a catalog.

state.description: Health state, as a string token: `available` (last health check passed), `unavailable` (last health check failed) or `degraded` (no health check recorded yet).

SharedProviderCatalogHealth.description: Health of the provider behind a shared-provider publication.

id.description: Opaque routing identifier of the model; send it as `model` in the inference operations.

displayName.description: Display name of the model, currently the model name of the publisher's upstream provider. Show it to people, but never send it as `model`; use `id`.

capabilities.description: What the model supports, 1 to 32 distinct string tokens: `chat-completions`, `responses`, `streaming`, `function-tools`, `parallel-function-tools`, `structured-output`, `vision-input`, `image-generations` or `b64-json`. A request that needs a capability not listed is rejected.

oneOf.description: Public token prices of the model; null when the publisher set no tariff, which means the cost is unknown, not free.
Reasoning (thinking) support of the model and the effort levels a request may choose. Omitted when the publisher reports none.

isSuggested.description: True when consumers should offer the model in their model pickers. A model with false is still listed and can be invoked.

SharedProviderCatalogModel.description: One model of a shared-provider publication: the routing identifier to invoke it with, its capabilities and its public price and reasoning support.

inputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Price of one million input tokens, in US dollars.

cachedInputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Price of one million cached input tokens, in US dollars.

outputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Price of one million output tokens, in US dollars.

isExplicitlyFree.description: True when the publisher declared the model free of charge; all rates are then zero. Omitted when false.

cacheWritePerMillionTokensUsd.description: Price of writing one million tokens to the provider's prompt cache, in US dollars; null when not priced.

longContextThresholdTokens.description: Input size in tokens above which an invocation is priced with the long-context rates instead of the normal ones; null when the model has no long-context tariff. When present it is greater than zero and the long-context input, cached-input and output rates are present too.

longContextInputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Price of one million input tokens, in US dollars, for an invocation whose input exceeds `longContextThresholdTokens`; null when the model has no long-context tariff.

longContextCachedInputPerMillionTokensUs.description: Price of one million cached input tokens, in US dollars, for an invocation whose input exceeds `longContextThresholdTokens`; null when the model has no long-context tariff.

longContextCacheWritePerMillionTokensUsd.description: Price of writing one million tokens to the prompt cache, in US dollars, for an invocation whose input exceeds `longContextThresholdTokens`; null when not priced.

longContextOutputPerMillionTokensUsd.description: Price of one million output tokens, in US dollars, for an invocation whose input exceeds `longContextThresholdTokens`; null when the model has no long-context tariff.

SharedProviderCatalogPrice.description: Public token prices of a shared model, in US dollars per million tokens. Every rate is zero or more; a model marked `isExplicitlyFree` has only zero rates. A model without a price object is unpriced (cost unknown), which is not the same as free. Invocations keep the prices in effect when they ran; later catalog changes do not rewrite them.

publicationId.description: Identifier of the publication, as a GUID string; stable while the publication exists.

revision.description: Revision of the publication's public representation, as `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; it changes whenever anything in this publication changes.

displayName.description: Display name of the shared provider, 1 to 256 characters.

purpose.description: What the publication is for, as a string token: `chat` or `image-generation`.

transport.description: Protocol to invoke it with, as a string token: always `openai-compatible`.

defaultModelId.description: Routing identifier of the publication's default model; one of the `models`.

models.description: The models of the publication, 1 to 128, sorted by `id`.

health.description: Health of the provider behind the publication.

isPrivateProvider.description: True when the publisher treats the provider as privately operated (self-hosted): always for Ollama and ComfyUI connectors, otherwise as the publisher configured it.

SharedProviderCatalogPublication.description: A provider that the publishing host shares: its identity and revision, purpose, models and health. Only published providers that are eligible for sharing appear in the catalog; internal profile identifiers, credentials, private endpoint addresses and diagnostics are never included.

SharedProviderHealthState.description: Health of the provider behind a shared-provider publication, as a string token: `available` (its last health check passed), `unavailable` (its last health check failed) or `degraded` (no health check is recorded yet).

message.description: Human-readable explanation, at most 512 characters. Its wording can change; branch on `code` instead.

type.description: Error class in OpenAI terms: `invalid_request_error`, `authentication_error`, `permission_error`, `conflict_error`, `rate_limit_error`, `api_error` or `timeout_error`.

param.description: Request member or header the error refers to, for example `model`, `messages` or `CanDoItAll-Access-Context-Ref`, at most 128 characters; null when the error concerns no single member.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason, for example `shared_provider_request_invalid`, `shared_provider_model_not_found` or `shared_provider_upstream_rate_limited`; at most 128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. Branch on this value.

SharedProviderOpenAiError.description: Details of a failed OpenAI-compatible shared-provider request. The message is sanitized: it never contains raw upstream errors, credentials or internal diagnostics.

SharedProviderOpenAiErrorEnvelope.description: Error body of the OpenAI-compatible shared-provider operations, in the OpenAI error shape: an object whose `error` member holds `message`, `type`, `param` and `code`. The native catalog operation uses the general `errors` envelope instead.

id.description: Routing identifier of the model; send it as `model` in the inference operations.

created.description: Creation time as Unix seconds; always 0, because the catalog records no creation time.

SharedProviderOpenAiModel.description: One shared model in the OpenAI-style model list of `GET /api/shared-providers/openai/v1/models`.

data.description: The models of all shared publications, including models not suggested in pickers, sorted by `id`; empty when nothing is shared.

SharedProviderOpenAiModelList.description: OpenAI-style list of every model the host shares, returned by `GET /api/shared-providers/openai/v1/models`.

openAiCompatibleBasePath.description: Path of the OpenAI-compatible operations on the publishing host; always `/api/shared-providers/openai/v1`.

SharedProviderProtocolDescriptor.description: Protocol entry points of the publishing host in a shared-provider catalog.

SharedProviderProtocolVersion.description: Version of the shared-provider catalog protocol, as a string; currently always `1.1`. A catalog with any other version is not accepted.

SharedProviderPublicationId.description: Identifier of a shared-provider publication, as a GUID string in the hyphenated form, for example `3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301`; never the empty GUID. It stays the same while the publication exists; its `revision` tracks changes.

SharedProviderPublicRevision.description: Content revision in a shared-provider catalog, as `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters: a hash of the public representation it describes. It changes whenever that representation changes.

SharedProviderPurpose.description: What a shared-provider publication is for, as a string token: `chat` (text generation through the chat completions and responses operations) or `image-generation` (image generation).

SharedProviderReasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level of a shared model, as a string token: `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` or `max`.

SharedProviderRoutingModelId.description: Opaque routing identifier of a shared model, 80 characters: `sp1.`, the publication identifier as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, a dot and a 43-character hash of the publisher's model name. Send it as `model` in the inference operations and never substitute the upstream model name. It stays the same while the publication and the model stay the same.

SharedProviderSourceInstanceId.description: Identifier of the host instance that publishes a shared-provider catalog, as a GUID string in the hyphenated form; never the empty GUID. It stays the same for that host, so a consumer can detect that a source address now serves a different host.

support.description: Whether the model supports configurable reasoning, as a string token: `unknown`, `unsupported` or `supported`.

control.description: How reasoning is controlled, as a string token: `unspecified`, `booleanToggle` (the allowed efforts are exactly `none` and `medium`) or `effortLevels`.

allowedEfforts.description: Effort levels a request may send as `reasoning_effort` (chat completions) or `reasoning.effort` (responses), as string tokens from `none`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh` and `max`; at most seven, without duplicates. Another level is rejected with `shared_provider_thinking_effort_not_supported`.

oneOf.description: Effort level the relay applies when a request sets none, as a string token from the same list; null when there is no default.

omitTemperature.description: True when the relay removes `temperature` from requests to this model, because the model does not accept it. Omitted when false.

SharedProviderThinkingCapability.description: Reasoning (thinking) support of a shared model and the effort levels a request may choose. When `support` is not `supported`, `control` is `unspecified`, `allowedEfforts` is empty and `defaultEffort` is null.

SharedProviderThinkingControl.description: How reasoning is controlled for a shared model, as a string token: `unspecified` (no control; used when reasoning is not supported), `booleanToggle` (on or off: the allowed efforts are exactly `none` and `medium`) or `effortLevels` (one of the allowed effort levels).

SharedProviderThinkingSupport.description: Whether a shared model supports configurable reasoning (thinking), as a string token: `unknown`, `unsupported` or `supported`.

SharedProviderTransport.description: Protocol a shared-provider publication is invoked with, as a string token: `openai-compatible` (the OpenAI-compatible operations under `/api/shared-providers/openai/v1`).

id.description: Identifier of the skill definition; use it as `skillId` of a party skill.

name.description: Skill name, unique in the catalog.

category.description: Category that groups skills; empty when not set.

description.description: Description of the skill; empty when not set.

isActive.description: False when the skill is deactivated; inactive skills stay in the catalog after the active ones.

SkillCatalogItemModel.description: A skill definition of the workforce skill catalog. Party skills refer to it by its identifier; it is not an agent skill or capability.

id.description: Identifier of the skill definition to update, from `GET /api/crm-hr/workforce/skills`. Omit it to create a definition or to update the one with the same name. An unknown identifier is never used for a new definition.

name.description: Skill name, unique in the catalog; required and trimmed. Without a known `id`, the definition with this exact name is updated instead of creating a new one.

category.description: Category that groups skills, for example `Backend`; free text, trimmed. Omitted means empty.

description.description: Description of the skill; free text, trimmed. Omitted means empty.

isActive.description: False deactivates the skill: it stays in the catalog, listed after the active skills, and party skills that refer to it are kept. Omitted means true.

SkillDefinitionSaveApiRequest.description: Request of `POST /api/crm-hr/workforce/skills`: a skill definition of the workforce skill catalog to create or update. All fields are overwritten.

SkillProficiencyLevel.description: Proficiency of a party in a workforce skill, lowest first, as a JSON integer: 0 Basic, 1 Working, 2 Strong, 3 Expert.

StorageLocatorKind.description: How a storage locator is to be read, as a JSON integer: 0 RelativePath (a path relative to the root of a file system storage), 1 ContentAddress (an IPFS content identifier), 2 RemotePath (a path on an FTP server), 3 AbsoluteUrl (an absolute URL).

storage.description: Recovery state of the placement; its storage state is Completed or Deleted.

phase.description: The missing owner step, as a JSON integer: 0 NativeCommit, 1 CoreCheckpoint, 2 WorkflowAcknowledgement or 3 OwnerEvidenceUnavailable.

StoragePlacementContinuationItem.description: A completed storage placement whose owner has not finished recording it, with the missing owner step.

items.description: The placements of this page. It can hold fewer items than `take`, or none, while `nextOffset` is not null.

nextOffset.description: Value to send as `offset` for the next page; null when all owner candidates were examined.

StoragePlacementContinuationPage.description: One page of completed storage placements waiting for their owner, returned by `GET /api/storage-placement-recovery/pending-continuations`.

StoragePlacementContinuationPhase.description: Owner step still missing for a completed storage placement, as a JSON integer: 0 NativeCommit (the owner has not recorded its own receipt for the placement), 1 CoreCheckpoint (process asset: the agent run's asset checkpoint is not complete), 2 WorkflowAcknowledgement (workflow asset: the workflow has not acknowledged the asset) or 3 OwnerEvidenceUnavailable (the owner's records cannot be read or used, for example an invalid owner association or imported history).

context.description: The current database runtime context from `GET /api/storage-placement-recovery/context`.

intentId.description: The placement intent, as an object whose `value` is the intent GUID. Must not be the empty GUID.

verifiedExternalDispatchStopped.description: Must be true: the operator attests having verified outside the host, for example on the FTP server, that no further data can arrive for the upload. False is rejected with HTTP 400 and nothing is recorded.

StoragePlacementExternalTerminationVerif.description: Request body of `POST /api/storage-placement-recovery/verify-external-termination`: an operator's attestation that the unacknowledged FTP upload of a placement has stopped. The attestation is recorded durably.

value.description: The intent identifier (GUID); never the empty GUID.

StoragePlacementIntentId.description: Identifier of a stable storage placement intent: the identity allocated before one planned write of content to storage, which the host keeps for the placement's whole life. In JSON it is an object with a single `value` member holding the GUID, for example `{ "value": "3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301" }`.

StoragePlacementOwnerContinuationAction.description: Owner continuation the caller may run for a completed storage placement, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 ReconcileCancelledRunReceipts (reconcile the receipts of the cancelled agent run with `POST /api/storage-placement-recovery/reconcile-cancelled-run-receipts`), 2 RecordWorkflowAssetReceipt (the asset node exists; record the workflow receipt with `POST /api/storage-placement-recovery/continue-workflow-asset`) or 3 CompletePreparedWorkflowAsset (create the workflow's prepared asset node with the same operation).

availableAction.description: Continuation the caller may run now, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 ReconcileCancelledRunReceipts, 2 RecordWorkflowAssetReceipt or 3 CompletePreparedWorkflowAsset.

state.description: Owner state, as a JSON integer from 0 Ready through 18 WorkflowManifestPending; the `StoragePlacementOwnerContinuationState` schema lists and explains every value. The most common are 0 Ready, 1 ReceiptRecorded, 2 NativeReceiptNotObserved, 6 StorageNotCompleted, 7 OriginalOwnerBlocked and 9 ReadOnlyAuthority.

originalExecutionRunId.description: Identifier (GUID) of the original agent execution run of a process asset, when it could be resolved; otherwise null.

oneOf.description: Identity of the prepared workflow output of a workflow asset, to send back as `expectedIntent`; null when the owner is not a workflow or the output could not be resolved.

StoragePlacementOwnerContinuationObserva.description: Owner continuation state of a completed storage placement: the placement, the owner's state and the continuation the caller may run. Returned by the owner-continuation read and by the continuation commands, which return it as read after their attempt.

StoragePlacementOwnerContinuationState.description: Owner state of a completed storage placement, as a JSON integer: 0 Ready (a continuation can run now; see the available action), 1 ReceiptRecorded (the owner recorded the asset), 2 NativeReceiptNotObserved (reconciling the cancelled run found no receipt; the effect stays uncertain and the action stays available), 3 CurrentReadDenied (the caller may not read the owner's current state), 4 OriginalProposalUnavailable (the original tool proposal or prepared workflow output is missing or does not match), 5 OriginalRunNotCancelled (the original agent run was not cancelled, so this continuation does not apply), 6 StorageNotCompleted (the storage write is not completed with a receipt), 7 OriginalOwnerBlocked (the placement is blocked, has no supported owner, or changed during the read), 8 WorkflowContinuationUnavailable (the workflow continuation is unavailable), 9 ReadOnlyAuthority (a continuation is possible, but the caller lacks the scopes to run it), 10 OwnerReceiptUnconfirmed (the owner has no receipt protocol to confirm the effect), 11 ContinuationUnavailable (the continuation could not run or its result did not match the original), 12 WorkflowOutputMissing (the workflow's output record was not found), 13 WorkflowRunMissing (the workflow run was not found), 14 WorkflowSourceMissing (the workflow's source authority is missing), 15 WorkflowSourceCannotContinue (the workflow's source no longer authorizes the output), 16 WorkflowRunCancelled (the workflow run was cancelled), 17 WorkflowTargetChanged (the target node changed or no longer exists) or 18 WorkflowManifestPending (the asset is in the project structure but the workflow has not acknowledged it).

StoragePlacementRecoveryAction.description: Recovery action the caller may take for a stable storage placement, as a JSON integer: 0 None (no action; the placement's `block` says why), 1 Reconcile (read back the original target with `POST /api/storage-placement-recovery/reconcile`) or 2 VerifyExternalTermination (an operator must first attest with `POST /api/storage-placement-recovery/verify-external-termination` that an unacknowledged FTP upload has stopped).

StoragePlacementRecoveryBlock.description: Why no recovery action is available for a stable storage placement, as a JSON integer: 0 None (not blocked), 1 ReadOnlyAuthority (the caller may read but lacks the scopes to act), 2 MissingOwnerAssociation (no project record owns the placement), 3 InvalidOwnerAssociation (the owning record is inconsistent or ambiguous), 4 OriginalProjectLifetimeMissing (the owning workflow record carries no project lifetime), 5 OriginalProjectUnavailable (the original project no longer exists in the lifetime it had, or belongs to another database profile), 6 ImportedHistory (imported history, which is not recovered here), 7 OriginalStorageUnavailable (the original storage is missing, disabled, unavailable, read-only or lacks a required capability), 8 OriginalTargetConflict (the storage endpoint, configuration or host binding changed; rebind the storage first), 9 DispatchNotStarted (the write was never dispatched; there is nothing to read back), 10 RetainedConflict (the target holds different content, which is preserved) or 11 DeletionRequested (the placement was deleted or its deletion was requested).

context.description: The current database runtime context from `GET /api/storage-placement-recovery/context`.

intentId.description: The placement intent, as an object whose `value` is the intent GUID, for example `{ "value": "3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301" }`. Must not be the empty GUID.

StoragePlacementRecoveryCommand.description: Request body of the storage placement recovery commands that act on one placement: the database runtime context and the placement intent. Send both members as read from the recovery operations.

databaseProfileId.description: Identifier (GUID) of the host's active database profile; not the empty GUID.

generation.description: Generation of the host's database runtime, an integer that changes when the active database changes; not negative.

StoragePlacementRecoveryContext.description: Database runtime context of a storage placement recovery request: the host's active database profile and its generation, as returned by `GET /api/storage-placement-recovery/context`. Send it unchanged with every recovery request. A context that is no longer current is rejected with HTTP 409 (`StaleContext`), for example after the host switched its database profile; read the context again.

StoragePlacementRecoveryFailure.description: Reason a storage placement recovery request failed, as a JSON integer: 0 Denied (HTTP 403), 1 StaleContext (HTTP 409), 2 NotFound (HTTP 404), 3 Blocked (HTTP 409), 4 InvalidRequest (HTTP 400) or 5 Unavailable (HTTP 503; the effect of the request is unknown until the placement is read again).

failure.description: Why the request failed, as a JSON integer: 0 Denied (HTTP 403: the caller is not authorized, including when API authorization is disabled or authority changed during the request), 1 StaleContext (HTTP 409: the database context is not the host's current one), 2 NotFound (HTTP 404: no such placement intent), 3 Blocked (HTTP 409: the action is not available for the placement now), 4 InvalidRequest (HTTP 400) or 5 Unavailable (HTTP 503: the request could not complete; its effect is unknown until the placement is read again).
