StoragePlacementRecoveryFailureResponse.description: Failure body of the storage placement recovery operations: a JSON object with a single `failure` member, for example `{ "failure": 1 }`. It carries no message; the status and `failure` say what happened. This family does not use the general `errors` envelope or problem details. A failure does not prove that nothing changed: after a failed command, read the placement again before the next step.

intentId.description: Identifier of the placement intent, as an object whose `value` is the GUID.

originalProjectId.description: Identifier (GUID) of the project the placement was planned for; null when it was not planned for a project.

originalStorageId.description: Identifier (GUID) of the storage catalog entry the placement was planned for.

originalProvider.description: Storage provider of that entry, as a JSON integer: 0 FileSystem, 1 Ipfs or 2 Ftp.

StoragePlacementRecoveryIdentity.description: Identity of a stable storage placement: its intent and the project, storage and provider it was planned for. It never contains paths or storage addresses.

context.description: The database runtime context the item was read under.

storageState.description: State of the write, as a JSON integer: 0 Prepared (target reserved, write not dispatched), 1 Dispatching (write dispatched, outcome not confirmed), 2 Completed (content verified at the target and storage receipt recorded), 3 Uncertain (outcome could not be verified; the target is kept), 4 Conflict (the target holds different content, which is preserved) or 5 Deleted. Only Completed means the content is stored.

createdAtUtc.description: Instant (UTC, with offset) at which the placement was prepared.

updatedAtUtc.description: Instant (UTC, with offset) of the last change to the placement record.

storageReceiptPresent.description: True when the storage receipt of the completed write is recorded.

owner.description: Owner of the placement, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown, 1 ProcessAsset or 2 WorkflowAsset.

nativeReceiptPresent.description: True when the owner recorded its own receipt for the placement.

availableAction.description: Action the caller may take now, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 Reconcile or 2 VerifyExternalTermination.

block.description: Why no action is available, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 ReadOnlyAuthority, 2 MissingOwnerAssociation, 3 InvalidOwnerAssociation, 4 OriginalProjectLifetimeMissing, 5 OriginalProjectUnavailable, 6 ImportedHistory, 7 OriginalStorageUnavailable, 8 OriginalTargetConflict, 9 DispatchNotStarted, 10 RetainedConflict or 11 DeletionRequested; the `StoragePlacementRecoveryBlock` schema explains each value.

StoragePlacementRecoveryItem.description: Recovery state of one stable storage placement: the state of its write, its receipts, its owner and the action the caller may take. Returned by the storage placement recovery reads and commands; it contains no content, storage addresses or paths.

StoragePlacementRecoveryOwner.description: Owner of a stable storage placement, the component that planned the write and records its result, as a JSON integer: 0 Unknown (no single owner record), 1 ProcessAsset (an asset produced by a process step's agent run) or 2 WorkflowAsset (an asset produced by a workflow run).

items.description: The placements of this page, oldest first; at most `take` items.

nextOffset.description: Value to send as `offset` for the next page; null when this is the last page.

StoragePlacementRecoveryPage.description: One page of unresolved stable storage placements, returned by `GET /api/storage-placement-recovery/pending`.

context.description: The current database runtime context from `GET /api/storage-placement-recovery/context`.

intentId.description: The placement intent, as an object whose `value` is the intent GUID. Must not be the empty GUID.

action.description: Continuation to run, as a JSON integer: 2 RecordWorkflowAssetReceipt or 3 CompletePreparedWorkflowAsset. It must equal `availableAction` of the latest owner-continuation read; other values are rejected with HTTP 400.

expectedIntent.description: `workflowIntent` of the latest owner-continuation read, unchanged. Required.

StoragePlacementWorkflowContinuationComm.description: Request body of `POST /api/storage-placement-recovery/continue-workflow-asset`: which workflow continuation to run for a completed placement, bound to the state the caller read. Send every member.

runId.description: Identifier (GUID) of the workflow run; not the empty GUID.

occurrencePath.description: Opaque identifier of the workflow step occurrence within the run: 64 hexadecimal characters.

slot.description: Output slot of the step occurrence, from 0 through 4095.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the prepared output: 64 hexadecimal characters.

StoragePlacementWorkflowContinuationInte.description: Identity of the prepared workflow output that a completed storage placement belongs to, returned as `workflowIntent` by `GET /api/storage-placement-recovery/{intentId}/owner-continuation`. Send it back unchanged as `expectedIntent`; the host rejects a continuation whose output differs.

StorageProviderKind.description: Kind of storage provider, as a JSON integer: 0 FileSystem (a directory of a file system; objects are addressed by relative paths), 1 Ipfs (IPFS content-addressed storage; stored content cannot be changed), 2 Ftp (an FTP server; objects are addressed by remote paths).

StorageStablePlacementState.description: State of the write of a stable storage placement, as a JSON integer: 0 Prepared (the target was reserved; the write has not been dispatched), 1 Dispatching (the write was dispatched; its outcome is not confirmed), 2 Completed (the content was verified at the target and the storage receipt recorded), 3 Uncertain (the outcome could not be verified; the target is kept and no second write is made), 4 Conflict (the target holds different content, which is preserved) or 5 Deleted (the placement was deleted and will not be recreated). Only Completed means the content is stored.

Stream.description: Raw bytes of a file, sent as the whole response body. The response's `Content-Type` header gives the actual media type.

identity.description: Kind and key of the capability, in the identity numbering. For a require rule that matched no allowed candidate it is the placeholder kind 1 Tool with key `required-capability-missing`.

oneOf.description: Identifier of the rule that decided, or null when no rule matched.
Level of that rule, as a JSON integer (0 System, 1 AgentDefault, 2 WorkflowDefinition, 3 WorkflowNode, 4 ProcessDefinition, 5 ProcessStep, 6 RuntimeOverride, 7 UiPreview), or null.
What that rule matched on, as a JSON integer (0 All, 1 Kind, 2 CapabilityKey, 3 Tag, 4 OperationClassification, 5 RuntimeToolName, 6 McpServerKey, 7 McpToolName, 8 ImplementationKey), or null.

category.description: Category, as a JSON integer, for example 15 AccessPolicy, 16 CapabilityUnavailable or 17 RequiredCapabilityDenied; the full list is given for the `category` of a capability diagnostic.

reason.description: Why the capability was suppressed.

SuppressedCapabilityDiagnostic.description: Reason why an access policy suppressed a capability, or why a required capability is missing.

value.description: The path, trimmed and with forward slashes.

TemplatePath.description: Path of the template or definition a capability or diagnostic comes from, with forward slashes; serialized as an object whose `value` member holds the path.

ToolExecutionSideEffectMode.description: Side effect a tool declares, as a JSON integer: 0 Unspecified, 1 NoMutation (reads only), 2 ManagedProcessArtifacts (writes managed workspace or process files), 3 ExternalArtifactDestination (acts outside the product, for example external actions or media generation), 4 ProductMutation (changes product data such as processes or project structure).

kind.description: How the icon is identified, as a JSON integer: 0 MaterialIcon, 1 StaticAsset, 2 PackageAsset.

value.description: The Material icon name, for example `extension`, or the asset path, depending on `kind`; trimmed.

packageId.description: Plugin package that holds a PackageAsset icon; empty for the other kinds.

label.description: Accessible label of the icon; may be empty.

UiIconDescriptor.description: Icon shown for an executor or its source in the user interface.

UiIconKind.description: How an icon is identified, as a JSON integer: 0 MaterialIcon (`value` is a Material icon name), 1 StaticAsset (`value` is the path of an application image asset), 2 PackageAsset (`value` is a path inside the plugin package named by `packageId`, whose icon `GET /api/plugins/packages/{packageId}/icon` serves).

asOfUtc.description: UTC time the snapshot was computed; durations of runs that have not ended are measured up to it.

definitionCount.description: Number of workflows counted (0 or 1 when one workflow is requested).

activeDefinitionCount.description: How many of them have an Active current version.

definitionsByStatus.description: Workflow count per lifecycle status of the current version, keyed by status name (`Draft`, `Active`, `Suspended`, `Archived`). Statuses with no workflow are left out.

runningRunCount.description: Matching runs in the Running state.

waitingForInputRunCount.description: Matching runs waiting for an external response.

failedRunCount.description: Matching runs in the Failed state.

runsByState.description: Matching run count per run state, keyed by state name (`NotStarted`, `Running`, `WaitingForInput`, `Idle`, `Completed`, `Failed`, `Cancelled`). States with no run are left out.

runsByBackend.description: Matching run count per runtime backend, keyed by backend name (`InProcess`, `DurableTask`, `AzureFunctions`). Backends with no run are left out.

usage.description: Model usage totals of the matching runs.

duration.description: Duration statistics of the matching runs.

runs.description: Every matching run with its duration and usage, most recently updated first.

providerModels.description: Usage of the matching runs per provider and model.

nodes.description: Usage of the matching runs per node and executor.

recentRuns.description: The most recently updated matching runs as stored run records, at most `Take` of them (8 by default).

WorkflowAnalyticsSnapshot.description: Workflow analytics computed at request time by `GET /api/workflows/analytics`. Definition figures cover the current version of every workflow, or of the one requested; run, duration and usage figures cover the runs that match all query filters.

endpoints.description: Route strings made of an HTTP method and a path with placeholders in braces, for example `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}`. The list is fixed by the host version and is not filtered by authority.

boundarySummary.description: One sentence about the boundary of the family, for example that agent capability setup is validated through `/api/agents/capabilities`.

WorkflowApiContractResponse.description: Informational list of the workflow API routes returned by `GET /api/workflows/contract`.

id.description: Identifier of the artifact within its run.

runId.description: Identifier of the run that recorded the artifact.

kind.description: What the artifact holds, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 Json, 2 File (a workspace file written by the run), 3 Image, 4 Binary, 5 ToolReceipt, 6 PreviewSimulation.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the definition node that produced it; null when not tied to a node.

name.description: Display name, such as a file name; redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

contentType.description: Media type of the content, for example `application/json`; the content download uses it as its `Content-Type`.

summary.description: Short description of the artifact; redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the artifact was recorded, as an instant with offset.

WorkflowArtifactApiResponse.description: Safe projection of an artifact recorded by a workflow run: its metadata without its storage location or content. Read the content with `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/content`.

WorkflowArtifactId.description: Identifier of an artifact recorded by a workflow run, written as a GUID string; read the artifact content with `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/artifacts/{artifactId}/content`.

WorkflowArtifactKind.description: Kind of a workflow run artifact, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 Json, 2 File (a workspace file written by the run), 3 Image, 4 Binary, 5 ToolReceipt, 6 PreviewSimulation (output of a simulated node in a preview run).

captureNodeOutputs.description: True to store every node output as an artifact when its kind is allowed, even when it fits inline; false stores only outputs and other payloads that were cut to the inline limit.

maxInlinePayloadCharacters.description: Maximum number of characters of a payload kept inline, after credential-like values are redacted; longer payloads are cut and end with `...[TRUNCATED]`. Must be greater than zero; values above 1,000,000 are treated as 1,000,000.

allowedArtifactKinds.description: Artifact kinds that may be stored, as JSON integers: 0 Text, 1 Json, 2 File, 3 Image, 4 Binary, 5 ToolReceipt, 6 PreviewSimulation.

WorkflowArtifactPolicy.description: Payload and artifact capture policy of the workflow settings: how much of each payload is kept inline in run records and when a payload is stored as an artifact.

id.description: Identifier of the artifact.

runId.description: Identifier of the run that recorded it.

kind.description: What it holds, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 Json, 2 File, 3 Image, 4 Binary, 5 ToolReceipt, 6 PreviewSimulation.

oneOf.description: Node that produced it; null when not tied to a node.

name.description: Display name, such as a file name.

contentType.description: Media type of the content, for example `application/json`.

storagePath.description: Workspace-relative logical path of the stored content, or of the workspace file the run wrote, for example `workflow-runs/3f2504e04f8911d39a0c0305e82c3301/payloads/run-input-7d9e1f2a3b4c4d5e8f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a.json`.

summary.description: Short description of the artifact.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the artifact was recorded, as an instant with offset.

WorkflowArtifactRecord.description: Stored record of a workflow run artifact, returned without the public safe projection only inside test-run results. Unlike the artifact projection it includes the storage path.

id.description: Identifier of the workflow.

versionId.description: Identifier of the version the entry describes.

description.description: Description; may be empty.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the version, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Archived.

preferredBackend.description: Backend from the version's runtime policy, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions.

updatedAtUtc.description: Time the version was stored, as an instant with offset.

templateKey.description: Template key when the workflow was installed from a workflow template; empty otherwise. Not unique.

templatePackKey.description: Key of the template pack the workflow came from; empty when not installed from a template.

templatePackVersion.description: Version of that template pack; empty when not installed from a template.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the template source as lower-case hexadecimal; empty when not installed from a template.

externalNamespace.description: Namespace of the workflow's external identity, lower-case; empty when it has none.

externalKey.description: Key of the workflow's external identity, lower-case; empty when it has none.

WorkflowCatalogItem.description: Catalog entry of a workflow: the metadata of one version, normally the current one, without its graph. Returned by `GET /api/workflows/definitions` and inside stable-identity resolutions; read the full definition with `GET /api/workflows/definitions/{workflowId}`.

id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint.

runId.description: Identifier of the run.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow of the run.

versionId.description: Identifier of the definition version the run executes.

backend.description: Runtime backend that took the checkpoint, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions.

kind.description: Why the checkpoint was taken, as a JSON integer: 0 RuntimeBoundary, 1 SuperStep, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Completed, 4 Failed, 5 Cancelled.

trustBoundary.description: What the checkpoint holds, as a JSON integer: 0 MetadataOnly (bookkeeping only, not resumable state) or 1 TrustedRuntimeState (runtime state the host can resume from).

resumeAvailability.description: Whether the run can resume from it, as a JSON integer: 0 NotSupported, 1 BlockedByPolicy, 2 Available. Resuming happens only through an answer to the run's external request.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node at which the checkpoint was taken; null when not tied to a node.

externalRequestId.description: Identifier of the external request the checkpoint waits for; null when it is not a wait for input.

summary.description: Short description; redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

resumeUnavailableReason.description: Why the run cannot resume from this checkpoint; empty when it can. Redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the checkpoint was recorded, as an instant with offset.

resumedAtUtc.description: Time the run resumed from it; null when it has not.

WorkflowCheckpointApiResponse.description: Safe projection of a checkpoint recorded by the runtime for a workflow run: where and why it was taken and whether the run could resume from it. Payload references, hashes and backend checkpoint identifiers are never returned.

WorkflowCheckpointId.description: Identifier of a checkpoint recorded for a workflow run, written as a GUID string.

WorkflowCheckpointKind.description: Why a workflow checkpoint was recorded, as a JSON integer: 0 RuntimeBoundary, 1 SuperStep, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Completed, 4 Failed, 5 Cancelled.

id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint.

runId.description: Identifier of the run.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow of the run.

versionId.description: Identifier of the definition version the run executes.

backend.description: Runtime backend that took the checkpoint, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions.

kind.description: Why the checkpoint was taken, as a JSON integer: 0 RuntimeBoundary, 1 SuperStep, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Completed, 4 Failed, 5 Cancelled.

trustBoundary.description: What it holds, as a JSON integer: 0 MetadataOnly, 1 TrustedRuntimeState.

resumeAvailability.description: Whether the run can resume from it, as a JSON integer: 0 NotSupported, 1 BlockedByPolicy, 2 Available.

oneOf.description: Node at which it was taken; null when not tied to a node.
External request it waits for; null when it is not a wait for input.

backendCheckpointId.description: Internal identifier of the checkpoint in its backend; may be empty.

payloadReference.description: Internal reference to the stored checkpoint payload.

payloadHash.description: Hash of the stored checkpoint payload; empty for metadata-only checkpoints.

summary.description: Short description of the checkpoint.

resumeUnavailableReason.description: Why the run cannot resume from it; empty when it can.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the checkpoint was recorded, as an instant with offset.

resumedAtUtc.description: Time the run resumed from it; null when it has not.

WorkflowCheckpointRecord.description: Stored record of a checkpoint of a workflow run, returned without the public safe projection only inside test-run results. Unlike the checkpoint projection it includes backend checkpoint identifiers, payload references and hashes.

WorkflowCheckpointTrustBoundary.description: What a workflow checkpoint holds, as a JSON integer: 0 MetadataOnly (bookkeeping; the run cannot resume from it), 1 TrustedRuntimeState (runtime state the host can resume a waiting run from).

WorkflowComponentId.description: Identifier of an LLM call component, written as a GUID string. It is returned as `id` by `GET /api/workflows/components` and referenced by LLM call nodes as `settings.componentId`. It must not be the empty GUID. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member; send the plain string.

id.description: Identifier of the workflow, the same for all its versions.

description.description: Description of the workflow; may be empty.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this version, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Archived.

runtimePolicy.description: Backend and run-kind policy of the workflow.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the workflow was first stored, as an instant with offset.

updatedAtUtc.description: Time this version was stored.

inputParameters.description: Input parameters the workflow expects in its run input; they drive start forms and are stored with the version. Empty when none are declared.

templateKey.description: Template key when the workflow was installed from a workflow template; empty otherwise. It is lower-case, not unique and cannot be set by a save.

templatePackKey.description: Key of the template pack the workflow came from; empty when it was not installed from a template.

templatePackVersion.description: Version of that template pack; empty when not installed from a template.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the template source as lower-case hexadecimal; empty when not installed from a template.

externalNamespace.description: Namespace of the workflow's external identity, lower-case, for example `partner.system`; empty when the workflow has none. Together with `externalKey` it is unique across workflows.

externalKey.description: Key of the workflow's external identity within its namespace, lower-case, for example `invoice:review`; empty when the workflow has none.

WorkflowDefinition.description: One stored version of a workflow definition: its graph, runtime policy, input parameters and stable identities. Returned by the definition reads, saves, imports and status changes, and accepted as a draft by `POST /api/workflows/validate` and the test-run operation. A workflow keeps its `id` across versions; each version has its own `versionId`.

validation.description: Validation against the current components, providers, backends and settings; an invalid version cannot be published or started.

WorkflowDefinitionDetail.description: A stored workflow definition version with its validation result, computed when it was read.

sourceFormat.description: Exchange format of the envelope; the import accepts exactly `CanDoItAll.WorkflowDefinition/v1`.

validation.description: Validation result at export time; informational and ignored by the import.

exportedAtUtc.description: Time of the export, as an instant with offset; ignored by the import.

WorkflowDefinitionExportEnvelope.description: Portable export of one workflow definition version, produced by `GET /api/workflows/definitions/{workflowId}/export` and accepted in `envelope` of `POST /api/workflows/definitions/import`. Send it back unchanged.

envelope.description: The export envelope, as produced by the export operation.

name.description: Name of the imported workflow; null or blank keeps the name from the envelope.

oneOf.description: Lifecycle status of the imported version, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Archived; null imports it as Draft.

preserveWorkflowId.description: True to keep the source's workflow identifier, external identity and template provenance, which makes the import a new version of that workflow when it exists here; false to create a new workflow with a new identifier and no external identity or template provenance.

WorkflowDefinitionImportRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/workflows/definitions/import`: an export envelope and how to import it.

oneOf.description: Identifier of the workflow to update; null creates a new workflow with a server-generated identifier. An unknown identifier creates a workflow with that identifier.
`versionId` of the current version as last read. When another save happened in between, the save is rejected with HTTP 400; null saves without this check. It must be null when creating a workflow.

description.description: Description; send an empty string for none. It is trimmed.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the new version, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 Suspended, 3 Archived. It is stored as sent, so Active publishes the new version.

runtimePolicy.description: Backend and run-kind policy of the workflow.

inputParameters.description: Input parameters the workflow expects; omitted or empty stores none. The list replaces the stored parameters.

externalNamespace.description: Namespace of the workflow's external identity, for example `partner.system`; send it together with `externalKey`. It is trimmed and lower-cased; at most 100 characters of ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore, period and colon. Empty keeps the identity of the current version.

externalKey.description: Key of the workflow's external identity within the namespace, for example `invoice:review`; send it together with `externalNamespace`. It is trimmed and lower-cased; at most 200 characters of the same characters. The pair must not be used by another workflow. Empty keeps the identity of the current version.

WorkflowDefinitionSaveRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/workflows/definitions`: the complete content of a new workflow or of a new version of an existing one, with an optional concurrency precondition. Send every member; the content replaces the definition.

WorkflowDefinitionSelectionKind.description: How a launch chose the definition version to run, as a JSON integer: 0 ExactSavedVersion (a `versionId` was given), 1 LatestActive (the latest Active version), 2 DraftPreview (an unsaved draft in a preview run).

availableRunCount.description: Runs with a duration; the statistics cover these runs.

finalRunCount.description: Runs with a final duration because they have ended.

activeRunCount.description: Runs that have not ended, measured up to the snapshot time.

unavailableRunCount.description: Ended runs without a recorded end time, left out of the statistics.

WorkflowDurationAnalyticsSummary.description: Duration statistics over the matching runs. Durations are strings in the form `[-][d.]hh:mm:ss[.fffffff]`; all four are `00:00:00` when no run has a duration.

id.description: Identifier of the edge, unique within the graph.

sourceNodeId.description: Node the edge leaves; must exist in the graph.

oneOf.description: Optional port of the source node; descriptive only, null for none.

targetNodeId.description: Node the edge enters; must exist in the graph.

oneOf.description: Optional port of the target node; descriptive only, null for none.

kind.description: Kind of edge, as a JSON integer: 0 Direct, 1 Conditional, 2 FanOut, 3 FanIn.

conditionExpression.description: Legacy condition text, used only as the route label when `routing.label` is empty; it is not evaluated. Send an empty string.

routing.description: When the edge is taken. Omitted means an unconditional route in `built-in-json-v1`; null is rejected by validation.

WorkflowEdge.description: Directed connection between two nodes of a workflow definition graph.

WorkflowEdgeId.description: Identifier of an edge within one workflow definition graph, written as a non-empty string chosen by the author, for example `review-to-end`; surrounding whitespace is removed. It must be unique within the graph. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member; send the plain string.

WorkflowEdgeKind.description: Kind of a workflow edge, as a JSON integer: 0 Direct, 1 Conditional, 2 FanOut (one of several parallel targets of the source node), 3 FanIn (joins parallel branches). How an edge is taken is defined by its `routing`.

kind.description: How the route decides, as a JSON integer: 0 Always, 1 Predicate, 2 SwitchCase, 3 SwitchDefault, 4 FanOutSelector.

label.description: Display label of the route; empty for none.

jsonPath.description: Path of the value to test in the source node's JSON output: `$` followed by `.property` and `[index]` segments, for example `$.decision.status` or `$.items[0]`. Required for Predicate, SwitchCase and FanOutSelector routes; must be empty for Always and SwitchDefault routes.

operator.description: Comparison, as a JSON integer: 0 Exists, 1 DoesNotExist, 2 Equals, 3 NotEquals, 4 Contains, 5 StartsWith, 6 EndsWith, 7 GreaterThan, 8 GreaterThanOrEqual, 9 LessThan, 10 LessThanOrEqual, 11 IsTruthy, 12 IsFalsy. SwitchCase routes use Equals.

expectedValueJson.description: Expected value as JSON text in a string, for example `"\"approved\""`, `"5"` or `"true"`. Required by every operator except Exists, DoesNotExist, IsTruthy and IsFalsy; must be empty for Always and SwitchDefault routes.

expectedValueKind.description: JSON type of the expected value, as a JSON integer: 0 String, 1 Number, 2 Boolean, 3 Null, 4 Json (any). It must match the expected value; numeric comparisons need Number and StartsWith or EndsWith need String.

caseSensitive.description: True to compare strings case-sensitively; false compares them ignoring case.

fanOutTargetIndex.description: Position of this target among the fan-out targets of the source node, from 0; only for FanOutSelector routes, and unique among them. Null orders the target by edge order.

routingLanguage.description: Language of the route: `built-in-json-v1`. `legacy-condition-expression` is accepted only for Always routes, and `artl-v1` is reserved and rejected.

WorkflowEdgeRouting.description: Route of a workflow edge: when the edge is taken. Conditions are evaluated against the JSON output of the source node with the built-in JSON routing language.

id.description: Identifier of the event; server-sent notifications carry the same value as `eventId`.

runId.description: Identifier of the run the event belongs to.

kind.description: What happened, as a JSON integer: 0 Started, 1 ExecutorInvoked, 2 ExecutorCompleted, 3 ExecutorFailed, 4 SuperStep, 5 Output, 6 Warning, 7 Error, 8 WaitingForInput, 9 Completed, 10 Cancelled, 11 Unknown.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the definition node the event belongs to; null for run-level events.

message.description: Human-readable event message, redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the event was recorded, as an instant with offset.

WorkflowEventApiResponse.description: Safe projection of one recorded event of a workflow run: what happened, where and when, without the event payload.

WorkflowEventKind.description: Kind of a recorded workflow run event, as a JSON integer (server-sent notifications use the camel-case name instead): 0 Started, 1 ExecutorInvoked, 2 ExecutorCompleted, 3 ExecutorFailed, 4 SuperStep (a runtime step boundary), 5 Output, 6 Warning, 7 Error, 8 WaitingForInput, 9 Completed, 10 Cancelled, 11 Unknown, 12 ProviderReadEvidence (internal evidence; left out of the event lists).

id.description: Identifier of the event.

runId.description: Identifier of the run.

kind.description: What happened, as a JSON integer: 0 Started, 1 ExecutorInvoked, 2 ExecutorCompleted, 3 ExecutorFailed, 4 SuperStep, 5 Output, 6 Warning, 7 Error, 8 WaitingForInput, 9 Completed, 10 Cancelled, 11 Unknown.

oneOf.description: Node the event belongs to; null for run-level events.

message.description: Event message, not bounded in this record.

payloadJson.description: Recorded event payload as JSON text in a string; may be empty.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the event was recorded, as an instant with offset.

WorkflowEventRecord.description: Stored record of one workflow run event, returned without the public safe projection only inside test-run results. Unlike the safe event projection it includes the event payload.

WorkflowExecutorApprovalRequirement.description: Whether running a workflow executor needs a person's approval, as a JSON integer: 0 NotRequired, 1 RequiredForExternalEffect, 2 AlwaysRequired. With either of the last two, a run raises an approval request that must be approved before the executor runs.

kind.description: Availability, as a JSON integer: 0 Available, 1 Planned, 2 Disabled, 3 Unavailable, 4 Incompatible.

isRunnable.description: True when the executor can run now.

reasonCode.description: Short machine-readable reason when the executor cannot run, for example `planned` or `disabled`; empty when it is available.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the availability.

WorkflowExecutorAvailabilityDescriptor.description: Whether a workflow executor can run in this host now, evaluated when the executor catalog is read.

WorkflowExecutorAvailabilityKind.description: Availability of a workflow executor, as a JSON integer: 0 Available, 1 Planned (not implemented yet), 2 Disabled, 3 Unavailable (for example missing configuration or a dependency), 4 Incompatible.

WorkflowExecutorCapabilityFlags.description: Capabilities a workflow executor needs, as a JSON integer bit mask that adds these values: 0 None, 1 ReadsWorkspace, 2 WritesWorkspace, 4 ReadsExternalData, 8 WritesExternalData, 16 UsesNetwork, 32 UsesSecrets, 64 RunsHostCommand, 128 EmitsArtifacts, 256 SupportsDeterministicTestMode, 512 IdempotentExternalMarker. For example 17 means ReadsWorkspace and UsesNetwork.

WorkflowExecutorCategoryKind.description: Category of a workflow executor, as a JSON integer: 0 Storage, 1 ProjectStructure, 2 Http, 3 Image, 4 Spreadsheet, 5 Data, 6 Markdown, 7 Human, 8 Utility, 9 Command.

id.description: Identifier to put in `settings.executorId` of a node, for example `storage.file`.

description.description: What the executor does.

category.description: Category, as a JSON integer: 0 Storage, 1 ProjectStructure, 2 Http, 3 Image, 4 Spreadsheet, 5 Data, 6 Markdown, 7 Human, 8 Utility, 9 Command.

iconName.description: Material icon name shown for the executor.

setupRendererKey.description: Key of the settings editor the workflow workspace uses; empty for none.

inputShape.description: Shape of the value the executor receives.

resultShape.description: Shape of the value the executor produces.

settingsSchemaJson.description: JSON Schema of the settings as JSON text in a string; may be empty.

defaultSettingsJson.description: Default settings as JSON text in a string; used when a node's `executorSettingsJson` is empty.

defaultPolicy.description: Timeout and retry policy used when a node has none.

isImplemented.description: False for executors that are planned but not implemented; they cannot run.

source.description: Where the executor comes from and how far it is trusted.

availability.description: Whether the executor can run now, evaluated when the catalog was read.

settingsSchema.description: Versioned JSON Schema of the settings.

configurationSchema.description: Settings fields as a form description. When it lists fields, a node's settings must be a JSON object whose values satisfy them, otherwise the definition fails validation.

settingsPresentationMode.description: How the workflow editor presents the settings, as a JSON integer: 0 Schema, 1 CustomRenderer.

simulation.description: Whether a preview run can simulate the executor, and with which output template.

permissionPolicy.description: Capabilities the executor needs and whether running it needs approval.

sideEffects.description: What the executor changes and how it can be previewed, committed and retried.

deterministicTestMode.description: Whether the executor supports a deterministic test mode.

canExecute.description: True when the executor is implemented and currently runnable. Computed. Definitions that use an executor that cannot run fail validation.

WorkflowExecutorDescriptor.description: A workflow executor that Executor nodes can run, as listed by `GET /api/workflows/executor-catalog`: what it does, how it is configured, what it may change, whether it needs approval and whether it can run now.

isSupported.description: True when the executor supports a deterministic test mode.

description.description: How the test mode behaves; empty when it is not supported.

WorkflowExecutorDeterministicTestModeDes.description: Whether a workflow executor can run deterministically with fake or preview inputs for tests.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of one attempt, in seconds, from 1 through 3,600.

maxRetryAttempts.description: Number of retries after a failed attempt, from 0 through 10. More than 0 is rejected for executors that write external state unless their side effects allow idempotent retries.

retryDelayMilliseconds.description: Delay before a retry, in milliseconds, from 0 through 600,000.

captureOutputArtifact.description: Whether the executor's output should be captured as an artifact; recorded in the execution audit. Node outputs are stored according to the workflow artifact policy.

WorkflowExecutorExecutionPolicy.description: Timeout and retry policy for running a workflow executor: an executor's default policy in the executor catalog and plugin manifests, or a node's own policy. Values outside the limits make a definition fail validation.

WorkflowExecutorExternalMutationKind.description: Kind of external change a workflow executor makes, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 ProcessedMarker (marks an external item, such as a message, as processed).

WorkflowExecutorId.description: Identifier of a workflow executor, written as a non-empty string such as `storage.file`, `http.fetch` or `human.approval`; surrounding whitespace is removed. Built-in and plugin executors and their identifiers are listed by `GET /api/workflows/executor-catalog`. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member; send the plain string.

requiredCapabilities.description: Capabilities the executor needs, as a JSON integer bit mask: 0 None, 1 ReadsWorkspace, 2 WritesWorkspace, 4 ReadsExternalData, 8 WritesExternalData, 16 UsesNetwork, 32 UsesSecrets, 64 RunsHostCommand, 128 EmitsArtifacts, 256 SupportsDeterministicTestMode, 512 IdempotentExternalMarker.

approvalRequirement.description: Whether a run needs approval before the executor runs, as a JSON integer: 0 NotRequired, 1 RequiredForExternalEffect, 2 AlwaysRequired.

requiresApproval.description: True when `approvalRequirement` is not NotRequired. Computed.

WorkflowExecutorPermissionPolicy.description: Permissions a workflow executor needs and whether running it needs approval.

WorkflowExecutorSettingsPresentationMode.description: How the workflow editor presents an executor's settings, as a JSON integer: 0 Schema (a form generated from the configuration schema), 1 CustomRenderer (a dedicated settings editor of the application).

kind.description: Kind of schema, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 JsonSchema.

version.description: Version of the schema, for example `1.0`; may be empty.

schemaJson.description: The JSON Schema as JSON text in a string; empty when there is none.

hasSchema.description: True when a schema is present. Computed.

WorkflowExecutorSettingsSchemaDescriptor.description: Versioned JSON Schema of an executor's settings.

WorkflowExecutorSettingsSchemaKind.description: Kind of an executor settings schema, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 JsonSchema.

kind.description: Strongest side effect, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 WorkspaceRead, 2 WorkspaceWrite, 3 ExternalRead, 4 ExternalWrite.

externalMutationKind.description: Kind of external change, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 ProcessedMarker.

supportsPreview.description: True when the executor can report what it would do without doing it.

supportsDryRun.description: True when the executor can run without committing its effect.

supportsCommit.description: True when the executor commits its effect in a separate, explicit step.

requiresCommitIdempotencyKey.description: True when committing requires an idempotency key, found at `idempotencyKeyJsonPath`.

allowsIdempotentRetry.description: True when repeating the executor cannot repeat its external effect.

idempotencyKeyJsonPath.description: JSON path of the idempotency key in the executor input; empty for none.

receiptSchema.description: Identifier of the schema of the receipt the executor records, for example `workflow-email-external-read/v1`; empty for none.

WorkflowExecutorSideEffectDescriptor.description: Side-effect contract of a workflow executor: what it changes and how it can be previewed, committed and retried.

WorkflowExecutorSideEffectKind.description: Strongest side effect of a workflow executor, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 WorkspaceRead, 2 WorkspaceWrite, 3 ExternalRead, 4 ExternalWrite (changes state outside the host, such as a remote system).

supportsPreviewSimulation.description: True when a preview run can replace the executor with a template.

outputTemplateJson.description: Template of the simulated output as JSON text in a string, which may contain placeholders such as `{{utcNow}}`, `{{node.id}}` or `{{inputPayload}}` that are filled in when a run simulates the node; use it as `outputTemplateJson` of a preview simulation step. Empty when simulation is not supported.

description.description: What the simulation produces; empty when simulation is not supported.

WorkflowExecutorSimulationDescriptor.description: Whether and how a preview (test) run can simulate a workflow executor instead of running it.

kind.description: Kind of source, as a JSON integer: 0 BuiltIn, 1 BundledPlugin, 2 LocalPackage, 3 RemotePackage.

sourceId.description: Identifier of the source: `candoitall.builtins` for built-in executors, otherwise the plugin or package identifier.

sourceVersion.description: Version of the source; may be empty.

pluginId.description: Identifier of the plugin that provides the executor; empty for built-in executors.

packageId.description: Identifier of the plugin package; empty when the executor does not come from a package.

trustLevel.description: Trust level of the source, as a JSON integer: 0 Application, 1 BundledPlugin, 2 LocalPackage, 3 RemotePackage, 4 Untrusted.

displayName.description: Display name of the source, for example `Built-in`; may be empty.

WorkflowExecutorSourceDescriptor.description: Origin of a workflow executor: built into the application or provided by a plugin or plugin package.

WorkflowExecutorSourceKind.description: Where a workflow executor comes from, as a JSON integer: 0 BuiltIn (part of the application), 1 BundledPlugin (a plugin shipped with the application), 2 LocalPackage, 3 RemotePackage (plugin packages installed from a local or remote source).

WorkflowExecutorTrustLevel.description: Trust level of a workflow executor's source, as a JSON integer: 0 Application, 1 BundledPlugin, 2 LocalPackage, 3 RemotePackage, 4 Untrusted.

WorkflowExternalRequestId.description: Identifier of an external request (a human-input or approval request raised by a waiting run), written as a GUID string. Answer the request with `POST /api/workflows/external-requests/{requestId}/response`.

WorkflowExternalRequestKind.description: Kind of an external request raised by a waiting run, as a JSON integer: 0 HumanInput (a value that satisfies the request's response schema), 1 Approval and 2 ToolApproval (both answered with `approved` and an optional `message`). On a HumanInput node it selects which kind of request the node raises; omitted or null means HumanInput.

id.description: Identifier of the external request.

runId.description: Identifier of the run that raised it.

kind.description: What the request asks for, as a JSON integer: 0 HumanInput, 1 Approval, 2 ToolApproval.

nodeId.description: Node that raised the request.

eventName.description: Name of the request event recorded by the runtime.

requestJson.description: Raw request payload as JSON text in a string, including the prompt and any context passed from earlier nodes.

responseJson.description: Raw response as JSON text in a string; empty until a response is recorded.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the request was raised, as an instant with offset.

respondedAtUtc.description: Time a response was recorded; null while none was.

version.description: Current version of the request; answers must name it.

state.description: Stored state of the request, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending, 1 ResponseClaimed, 2 Responded, 3 Denied, 4 Superseded, 5 Cancelled, 6 LegacyNonResumable.

oneOf.description: What a response must satisfy; null for a request without a response contract.

WorkflowExternalRequestRecord.description: Stored record of an external request of a workflow run, returned without the public safe projection only inside test-run results. Unlike the pending-request projection it includes the raw request and response JSON.

WorkflowExternalRequestState.description: State of an external request of a workflow run, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending (accepts a response), 1 ResponseClaimed (an answer is being processed), 2 Responded, 3 Denied, 4 Superseded (replaced by a newer request), 5 Cancelled, 6 LegacyNonResumable (an old wait that the response operation cannot resume).

value.description: The request version, starting at 1.

WorkflowExternalRequestVersion.description: Version of an external request, as an object whose `value` member holds the positive integer. The public projections return it as the plain integer `version`.

operationId.description: Identifier of the answer attempt, for `GET /api/workflows/external-response-operations/{operationId}`. Null when no attempt was recorded or found, for example when the body was rejected.

requestId.description: Identifier of the external request that was answered; null when it is unknown.

expectedRequestVersion.description: Request version the attempt was made for or, when no attempt was recorded, the request's current version; null when unknown.

runId.description: Identifier of the workflow run the request belongs to; null when unknown.

outcome.description: Result of this call, as a JSON integer: 0 Completed, 1 WaitingAgain, 2 Denied, 3 Resuming, 4 Unauthenticated, 5 Forbidden, 6 InvalidResponse, 7 RequestNotFound, 8 RunNotFound, 9 OperationNotFound, 10 RequestVersionMismatch, 11 RequestNotPending, 12 RunNotWaiting, 13 IdempotencyConflict, 14 ActiveOperationConflict, 15 Cancelled, 16 Superseded, 17 LegacyNonResumable, 18 AuthorizationContextUnavailable, 19 CheckpointMissing, 20 CheckpointCorrupt, 21 CheckpointIncompatible, 22 TopologyMismatch, 23 WorkflowVersionMismatch, 24 RequestMismatch, 25 BackendUnavailable, 26 RetryableFailure, 27 TerminalFailure. The HTTP status follows from it; the two operations describe the mapping.

oneOf.description: Stored state of the attempt, as a JSON integer: 0 Accepted, 1 Claimed, 2 Resuming (processing has not finished), 3 WaitingAgain, 4 Completed, 5 Denied, 6 FailedRetryable (resend the submission with the same key to continue), 7 FailedTerminal, 8 Cancelled. Null when no attempt was recorded.

Detailed result code of the attempt, as a JSON integer: 0 None (no final result yet), 1 WaitingAgain, 2 Completed, 3 Denied, 4 Cancelled, 5 BackendUnavailable, 6 ResumeFailed, 7 CheckpointMissing, 8 CheckpointCorrupt, 9 CheckpointIncompatible, 10 TopologyMismatch, 11 WorkflowVersionMismatch, 12 RequestMismatch, 13 ResponseRejected, 14 AttemptLimitReached. Null when no attempt was recorded.
State of the run when this answer was produced, as a JSON integer: 0 NotStarted, 1 Running, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Idle, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 Cancelled. Null when the run is unknown.

acceptedAtUtc.description: Time the attempt was accepted, as an instant with offset; null without an attempt.

startedAtUtc.description: Time processing of the attempt started; null until then or without an attempt.

completedAtUtc.description: Time the attempt reached its final state; null while it has not or without an attempt.

replayed.description: True when this submission repeated an earlier one with the same key and body and returned its attempt instead of creating one. Always false when the attempt is read with the operation read.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, redacted and at most 4,096 characters; a fixed text for unclassified failures. Do not parse it.

oneOf.description: The next external request the run waits for after this answer, typically with `outcome` 1 WaitingAgain; answer it in the same way. Null otherwise.

WorkflowExternalResponseApiResponse.description: Status of an attempt to answer a workflow external request, returned for every outcome, success or failure, by `POST /api/workflows/external-requests/{requestId}/response` and `GET /api/workflows/external-response-operations/{operationId}`. Branch on `outcome`; members that do not apply are null, so a request rejected before any lookup carries only `outcome`, `replayed` and `message`. It is an allowlisted projection: it never contains the raw request or response JSON, event payloads, checkpoint references or hashes, artifact storage paths, the idempotency key, leases or authorization material.

kind.description: Kind of request the contract belongs to, as a JSON integer: 0 HumanInput, 1 Approval, 2 ToolApproval.

schemaId.description: Identifier of the response schema, for example `CanDoItAll.WorkflowApprovalResponse/v1`; trimmed.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the response schema; positive, and 1 is the only version responses are accepted for.

schemaJson.description: The JSON Schema of the response as JSON text in a string.

schemaHash.description: SHA-256 hash of `schemaJson`, as lower-case hexadecimal.

maximumPayloadBytes.description: Maximum size of a response value's JSON text, in UTF-8 bytes; positive.

WorkflowExternalResponseContract.description: Stored response contract of an external request: the schema and size limit a response must satisfy. It appears in full, including the schema text and hash, only in the stored request records of test-run results; the public request projection returns a bounded form of it.

schemaId.description: Identifier of the response schema, for example `CanDoItAll.WorkflowApprovalResponse/v1` or `CanDoItAll.WorkflowHumanInputResponse/v1`; redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the response schema; 1 is the only version the server accepts.

oneOf.description: The JSON Schema that the response value must satisfy, as a JSON value (not a string). Null when `schemaAvailable` is false.

schemaAvailable.description: False when the schema is longer than 32,768 characters and was deliberately omitted; responses are still validated against it.

maximumPayloadBytes.description: Maximum size of the response value's JSON text, in UTF-8 bytes, for example 65,536. A larger response is rejected with HTTP 400.

WorkflowExternalResponseContractApiRespo.description: Response contract of an external request, taken from the request's persisted boundary: the schema a response must satisfy and its size limit. The schema itself is returned only when it is small enough for the public projection.

WorkflowExternalResponseOperationOutcome.description: Detailed result code of an attempt to answer an external request, as a JSON integer: 0 None (no final result yet), 1 WaitingAgain, 2 Completed, 3 Denied, 4 Cancelled, 5 BackendUnavailable, 6 ResumeFailed, 7 CheckpointMissing, 8 CheckpointCorrupt, 9 CheckpointIncompatible, 10 TopologyMismatch, 11 WorkflowVersionMismatch, 12 RequestMismatch, 13 ResponseRejected, 14 AttemptLimitReached.

WorkflowExternalResponseOperationState.description: Stored state of an attempt to answer an external request, as a JSON integer: 0 Accepted, 1 Claimed, 2 Resuming (processing has not finished), 3 WaitingAgain (the run waits for another request), 4 Completed, 5 Denied, 6 FailedRetryable (resend the submission with the same key to continue), 7 FailedTerminal, 8 Cancelled.

WorkflowExternalResponseServiceOutcome.description: Result of submitting an external response or reading the attempt, as a JSON integer, grouped by the HTTP status the workflow API returns with it. 200: 0 Completed (the run completed), 1 WaitingAgain (the run waits for another request), 2 Denied (the approval was denied). 202: 3 Resuming (still processing). 401: 4 Unauthenticated. 403: 5 Forbidden, 18 AuthorizationContextUnavailable. 400: 6 InvalidResponse. 404: 7 RequestNotFound, 8 RunNotFound, 9 OperationNotFound. 409: 10 RequestVersionMismatch, 11 RequestNotPending, 12 RunNotWaiting, 13 IdempotencyConflict, 14 ActiveOperationConflict. 410: 15 Cancelled, 16 Superseded. 422: 17 LegacyNonResumable, 19 CheckpointMissing, 20 CheckpointCorrupt, 21 CheckpointIncompatible, 22 TopologyMismatch, 23 WorkflowVersionMismatch, 24 RequestMismatch. 503: 25 BackendUnavailable, 26 RetryableFailure. 500: 27 TerminalFailure.

startNodeId.description: Node where runs begin; must be one of `nodes`.

WorkflowGraph.description: Node graph of a workflow definition. It needs at least one node and one End node, a start node that exists, unique node and edge identifiers, edges between existing nodes, and every node reachable from the start node.

allowHumanInputNodes.description: True to allow HumanInput nodes. When false, every definition containing one fails validation and can no longer be saved, published or started.

requireApprovalForToolUse.description: Recorded preference for approving tool use. Executors take their approval requirement from their own permission policy; the runtime does not read this flag.

defaultRequestTimeoutMinutes.description: Default waiting time for external requests, in minutes; must be greater than zero. It is recorded and displayed; the runtime does not expire requests after it.

WorkflowHumanInLoopPolicy.description: Human-in-the-loop policy of the workflow settings.

WorkflowId.description: Identifier of a workflow definition, stable across all of its versions, written as a GUID string, for example `3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301`. The workflow operations return it as `id` or `workflowId`; Project Structure workflow nodes carry the same identifier. It must not be the empty GUID. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member that holds the GUID; send the plain string.

key.description: Key of the parameter; unless `jsonPath` is set, the value is the run input's root member with this name.

kind.description: Kind of value, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 EmailAddress, 2 CrmContactEmail, 3 ProjectId, 4 ProjectNodeId, 5 Category, 6 Integer, 7 TimeZone, 8 DurationMinutes, 9 ExternalConnectionId.

isRequired.description: True when the run input must contain a value after defaults are applied.

description.description: Explanation shown with the parameter; may be empty.

jsonPath.description: Location of the value in the run input as `$.name` of a root member, for example `$.customerEmail`; empty means `$.` followed by `key`.

defaultValue.description: Default used when the input has no value, as text (an integer for Integer and DurationMinutes); empty for none.

minimumValue.description: Inclusive lower bound for Integer and DurationMinutes values; null for none.

maximumValue.description: Inclusive upper bound for Integer and DurationMinutes values; null for none.

placeholder.description: Hint text for input forms; may be empty.

WorkflowInputParameterDescriptor.description: Declared input parameter of a workflow definition: one member of the run input with its kind, requirement, default and options. Start forms and scheduled runs use these declarations to build and check the run input; the HTTP start operations pass the input through without applying defaults or checking it.

WorkflowInputParameterKind.description: Kind of value a workflow input parameter takes, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 EmailAddress, 2 CrmContactEmail (e-mail address of a CRM contact), 3 ProjectId (project GUID as a string), 4 ProjectNodeId (Project Structure node identifier), 5 Category, 6 Integer, 7 TimeZone (time zone identifier), 8 DurationMinutes (integer number of minutes), 9 ExternalConnectionId.

value.description: Value written into the run input when the option is chosen.

description.description: Longer description of the option; may be empty.

WorkflowInputParameterOption.description: One selectable value of a workflow input parameter.

kind.description: Where the values come from, as a JSON integer: 0 None, 1 Static, 2 CrmContacts, 3 ProjectStructureProjects, 4 ProjectStructureNodes, 5 Office365Connections.

dependsOnParameterKey.description: Key of another parameter whose value narrows these options, for example the project parameter for node options; empty for none.

staticOptions.description: The options of a Static source; empty for the other kinds.

WorkflowInputParameterOptionSource.description: Source of the selectable values of a workflow input parameter.

WorkflowInputParameterOptionSourceKind.description: Where the selectable values of a workflow input parameter come from, as a JSON integer: 0 None (free entry), 1 Static (the parameter's `staticOptions`), 2 CrmContacts, 3 ProjectStructureProjects, 4 ProjectStructureNodes, 5 Office365Connections.

kind.description: Kind of actor, as a JSON integer: 0 User, 1 Agent, 2 Service.

subjectId.description: Subject identifier of the actor, for example the bearer token subject of an API caller or an agent identifier; trimmed and never empty.

WorkflowLaunchActor.description: Actor recorded with a workflow launch: who started the run.

WorkflowLaunchActorKind.description: Kind of actor that launched or answered a workflow run, as a JSON integer: 0 User, 1 Agent, 2 Service.

value.description: The correlation text, trimmed and never empty.

WorkflowLaunchCorrelationId.description: Correlation reference of the request that launched a workflow run, as an object whose `value` member holds the text. For runs started through the HTTP API it is the server trace identifier of the start request. It is for diagnostics only; it is not an idempotency key and does not prove that anything was committed.

WorkflowLaunchIdempotencyDisposition.description: How a start request's `Idempotency-Key` was applied, as a JSON integer: 0 NotRequested (no key was sent; a new run was started), 1 EnforcedNewRun (the key was recorded with a new run), 2 ReplayedExistingRun (the key was known; the original run is returned and nothing new was started).

idempotencyKeyHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the trimmed key, as upper-case hexadecimal.

requestFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the original start request (version choice, canonical input, backend and authorization context), as upper-case hexadecimal. A later request with the same key must produce the same fingerprint.

canonicalInputHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the run input with its object members sorted by name, as upper-case hexadecimal.

workflowId.description: Workflow the key was used for.

selectionKind.description: How the version was chosen, as a JSON integer: 0 ExactSavedVersion (a `versionId` was sent), 1 LatestActive (none was sent).

oneOf.description: Version sent in the request; null for latest-Active starts.
Version that was started; null while the record is Pending.
Backend the run was started on, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions; null while the record is Pending.

originalRunId.description: Run reserved for and created by the original request.

claimState.description: State of the record, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending (the start is in progress or did not finish recording its run), 1 Completed.

oneOf.description: Current state of the original run, as a JSON integer: 0 NotStarted, 1 Running, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Idle, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 Cancelled; null when the run is not recorded.

isTerminal.description: True when the run is Completed, Failed or Cancelled.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the key was claimed for a start, as an instant with offset (the latest claim when an abandoned claim was taken over).

completedAtUtc.description: Time the start was recorded as completed; null while Pending.

wasReplayed.description: True when at least one later request with the key returned the original run.

replayCount.description: Number of later requests with the key that returned the original run.

lastReplayedAtUtc.description: Time of the latest such request; null when there was none.

WorkflowLaunchIdempotencyEvidence.description: What the server recorded for an `Idempotency-Key` sent to the HTTP start operations, returned by `GET /api/workflows/runs/by-idempotency-key/{key}`. It identifies the original run and never contains the key or the run input, only hashes of them.

WorkflowLaunchIdempotencyRecordState.description: State of a start request's idempotency record, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending (the start is in progress, or it did not finish recording its run), 1 Completed (the run was recorded; later requests with the key replay it).

WorkflowLaunchObservation.description: How reliably the server observed a workflow start, as a JSON integer: 0 Confirmed (the run was admitted and recorded normally), 1 RecoveredAfterObserverFailure (an error was reported after the run had been admitted, for example because the run failed or its detail could not be read; the result was rebuilt from the stored run), 2 AdmissionReceiptPending (the run was admitted but its idempotency record could not be completed yet; a later request with the same key returns the same run).

WorkflowLaunchOrigin.description: Launch lineage recorded with a workflow run: who or what started it, with the authority captured at launch. The member `$origin` names the variant (`api`, `preview`, `scheduler-plan-run`, `project-structure-node`, `agent-runtime-invocation`, `process-assignment`, `process-tool-invocation-v1` or `process-dispatch-assignment-v1`). It appears only in the stored run records returned by the test-run, cancellation and analytics operations; it is internal lineage, not a stable client contract.

$origin.description: Discriminator of this variant: always `agent-runtime-invocation`. Read it to tell the variants apart.

agent.description: The agent that started the run.

runtimeSessionId.description: Agent runtime session in which the tool ran.

purpose.description: Execution purpose of the agent invocation, trimmed.

WorkflowLifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a stored workflow definition version, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft (being edited; can be test-run but not started in production), 1 Active (published; production starts without a version use the latest Active version), 2 Suspended (temporarily withdrawn; while the current version is Suspended no version can be started), 3 Archived (retired but kept; while the current version is Archived no version can be started).

items.description: The entries on this page, in the list's order. Empty when nothing matched or the page is past the last one.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based index of this page, as used after the server applied its limits.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of entries per page, as used after the server applied its limits.

totalCount.description: Number of entries on all pages together.

totalPages.description: Number of pages: `totalCount` divided by `pageSize`, rounded up; 0 when nothing matched.

hasNextPage.description: True when a later page exists; request `pageIndex` + 1 to read it.
