WorkflowModality.description: Input modality of an LLM call component, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 Vision, 2 Audio, 3 Image, 4 Multimodal. Audio and Image are not supported by the current workflow runtime and fail validation; Vision and Multimodal need a provider that supports vision.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature from 0 through 2, or null to use the provider default. A value outside the range fails validation.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens, or null for the provider default. A supplied value must be greater than zero.

requireJsonOutput.description: True to require JSON output. The component then needs a Json result shape or a `responseFormatJsonSchema`, and its provider must support structured output.

responseFormatJsonSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema of the required output, as a JSON string; empty for none.

WorkflowModelSettings.description: Model call settings of an LLM call component.

id.description: Identifier of the node, unique within the graph.

kind.description: Kind of node, as a JSON integer: 0 Start, 1 LlmCall, 2 Triage, 3 StrictLogic, 4 Executor, 5 Artifact, 6 HumanInput, 7 AgentStep, 8 Subworkflow, 9 End.

ports.description: Descriptive ports of the node; may be empty.

canvasX.description: Horizontal position on the editor canvas; layout only. Defaults to 0.

canvasY.description: Vertical position on the editor canvas; layout only. Defaults to 0.

WorkflowNode.description: One node of a workflow definition graph.

WorkflowNodeId.description: Identifier of a node within one workflow definition graph, written as a non-empty string chosen by the author, for example `review`; surrounding whitespace is removed. It must be unique within the graph and is not unique across workflows. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member; send the plain string.

WorkflowNodeKind.description: Kind of a workflow node, as a JSON integer: 0 Start (entry node), 1 LlmCall (calls a model through its LLM call component), 2 Triage, 3 StrictLogic, 4 Executor (runs the executor named by `settings.executorId`), 5 Artifact, 6 HumanInput (makes the run wait for an external response), 7 AgentStep, 8 Subworkflow, 9 End (exit node; a graph needs at least one). A node of any kind that names an executor runs it. Nodes of the other kinds without an executor pass their input on unchanged; Artifact, AgentStep and Subworkflow nodes without an executor are rejected in Active definitions.

oneOf.description: LLM call component the node calls; required for LlmCall nodes, null otherwise.

agentId.description: Agent the node refers to, for AgentStep nodes; stored with the definition but not executed by the current runtime.

oneOf.description: Workflow the node refers to, for Subworkflow nodes; stored with the definition but not executed by the current runtime.
For HumanInput nodes, the kind of external request the node raises, as a JSON integer: 0 HumanInput, 1 Approval, 2 ToolApproval; null means HumanInput.

instructions.description: Instructions of the node: for LlmCall nodes the system instructions (empty is filled from the component when the definition is saved); for HumanInput nodes the prompt shown to the responder.

oneOf.description: Shape of the value the node receives; null when not declared.
Shape of the value the node produces; null when not declared. For HumanInput nodes its schema is the response schema.

providerProfileId.description: For LlmCall nodes, the provider profile to call instead of the component's; null uses the component's provider (filled in when the definition is saved).

model.description: For LlmCall nodes, the model to call instead of the component's; empty uses the component's model (filled in when the definition is saved).

oneOf.description: Executor the node runs, an identifier from `GET /api/workflows/executor-catalog` such as `storage.file`. Required for Executor nodes; a node of another kind that names an executor runs it too.

executorSettingsJson.description: Settings of the executor as a JSON string containing a JSON object that satisfies the executor's settings schema; empty uses the executor's default settings.

oneOf.description: Timeout and retry policy of the executor for this node; null uses the executor's default policy.

WorkflowNodeSettings.description: Kind-specific settings of a workflow node. Which members matter depends on the node kind; members that do not apply are stored but ignored. Send null or empty values for them.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node in the workflow graph that recorded the usage.

oneOf.description: Executor of that node, as listed by `GET /api/workflows/executor-catalog`. Null for usage of an LLM call component, which runs without an executor.

usage.description: Usage totals of this node and executor.

WorkflowNodeUsageAnalyticsRow.description: Model usage of the matching runs for one workflow node and executor, ordered by node identifier and then executor identifier.

id.description: Identifier of the external request; use it in `POST /api/workflows/external-requests/{requestId}/response`.

runId.description: Identifier of the run that waits for the request.

kind.description: What the request asks for, as a JSON integer: 0 HumanInput (a value that satisfies `responseContract.schema`), 1 Approval or 2 ToolApproval (both answered with `approved` and an optional `message`).

nodeId.description: Identifier of the definition node that raised the request.

eventName.description: Name of the request event recorded by the runtime; informational, redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

version.description: Current version of the request, starting at 1. Send it as `expectedRequestVersion` when answering.

state.description: State of the request, as a JSON integer: 0 Pending (accepts a response), 1 ResponseClaimed (an answer is being processed), 2 Responded, 3 Denied, 4 Superseded (replaced by a newer request), 5 Cancelled, 6 LegacyNonResumable (an old wait that this API cannot resume).

createdAtUtc.description: Time the run raised the request, as an instant with offset.

respondedAtUtc.description: Time a response was recorded; null while none was.

prompt.description: The request's prompt text for the responder, redacted and at most 4,096 characters; null when the request has no prompt text.

oneOf.description: What a response must satisfy; null when the request has no usable response contract, for example a legacy request, which cannot be answered through the API.

WorkflowPendingExternalRequestApiRespons.description: External request of a workflow run: what a waiting run asks a person or approver for and how to answer it. Returned by the pending-request, run-detail and start operations and as `nextPendingRequest`. It is an allowlisted projection that never contains the request's prior-node context, raw request JSON, authorization policy, executor arguments or checkpoint material.

id.description: Identifier of the port within its node; edges may name it in `sourcePortId` or `targetPortId`.

direction.description: Direction of the port, as a JSON integer: 0 Input, 1 Output.

shape.description: Shape of the value that passes through the port.

required.description: True when the port is marked as required; informational.

WorkflowPort.description: Descriptive input or output port of a workflow node, stored with the definition for editors. The runtime routes along edges between nodes; ports are not validated.

WorkflowPortDirection.description: Direction of a node port, as a JSON integer: 0 Input, 1 Output.

WorkflowPortId.description: Identifier of a port of a workflow node, written as a non-empty string chosen by the author, for example `input`; surrounding whitespace is removed. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member; send the plain string.

steps.description: Nodes to simulate; empty for none.

hasSteps.description: True when `steps` is not empty. Computed; it is ignored when sent.

WorkflowPreviewSimulationPlan.description: Nodes whose execution a preview (test) run replaces with a rendered output template, so that a test does not call the real executor. It is rejected for production runs.

nodeId.description: Node whose execution is replaced.

oneOf.description: Executor the node uses; when set it must equal the node's `settings.executorId`, otherwise the run fails.

reason.description: Why the node is simulated; informational.

outputTemplateJson.description: Template of the simulated output as JSON text in a string, for example an executor's `simulation.outputTemplateJson` from the executor catalog.

WorkflowPreviewSimulationStep.description: One simulated node of a preview run.

value.description: The process step assignment identifier, a GUID string.

WorkflowProcessAssignmentId.description: Identifier of a process step assignment recorded in a workflow launch origin, as an object whose `value` member holds the GUID.

profileId.description: Identifier of the database profile of the process.

rootRun.description: Root process run of the process tree.

processRun.description: Process run that owns the step.

assignment.description: Process step assignment that dispatched the workflow.

claimToken.description: Token of the process claim; internal.

ownerFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the claim owner; internal.

contractHash.description: Hash of the assignment contract; internal.

requestedVersionId.description: Exact version the step requested; null for the latest Active version.

inputFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the run input; internal.

WorkflowProcessDispatchBinding.description: Process assignment claim that dispatched a workflow run for a process step. Internal lineage recorded in the launch origin.

value.description: The process run identifier, a GUID string.

WorkflowProcessRunId.description: Identifier of a process run recorded in a workflow launch origin, as an object whose `value` member holds the GUID.

session.description: Background agent session in which the tool was proposed.

profile.description: Profile binding of the agent tool.

batchId.description: Batch of tool calls the proposal belongs to.

intentId.description: Business intent of the proposal; it also becomes the workflow run identifier.

toolName.description: Name of the tool, at most 128 characters.

executorAgentId.description: Identifier of the agent that executes the tool.

launchCapabilityId.description: Identifier of the capability that allows the agent to launch workflows.

processRun.description: Process run that owns the step.

stepInstance.description: Process step instance that made the proposal.

readinessHash.description: Hash of the step readiness at approval; internal.

WorkflowProcessToolBinding.description: Approved agent tool proposal and process step that admitted a workflow run. Internal lineage recorded in the launch origin.

value.description: The string node identifier, trimmed; not a GUID in general.

WorkflowProjectStructureNodeId.description: Project Structure node recorded in a workflow launch origin or output binding, as an object whose `value` member holds the string node identifier.

providerName.description: Provider name recorded with the usage, in one of the spellings seen.

oneOf.description: Provider kind, as a JSON integer: 0 OpenAi, 1 AzureOpenAi, 2 Ollama, 3 ComfyUi. Null for usage imported from the older aggregate usage metrics.

model.description: Model name recorded with the usage, in one of the spellings seen.

usage.description: Usage totals of this provider and model.

WorkflowProviderModelAnalyticsRow.description: Model usage of the matching runs for one provider and model. Rows are grouped by provider name and model ignoring case, and by provider kind, and are ordered by provider name and then model.

providerProfileId.description: Identifier of the provider profile; use it as `providerProfileId`.

name.description: Display name of the provider profile.

kind.description: Provider kind, as a JSON integer: 0 OpenAi, 1 AzureOpenAi, 2 Ollama, 3 ComfyUi.

transport.description: Protocol used to call the provider, as a JSON integer: 0 Responses, 1 ChatCompletions.

purpose.description: Purpose of the profile, as a JSON integer: 0 Chat, 1 ImageGeneration. Only Chat profiles are listed.

defaultModel.description: Model used when a component names none.

modelOptions.description: The default model followed by the suggested models, without duplicates.

isEnabled.description: False when the profile is disabled; a component referencing it fails validation.

supportsStreaming.description: True when the provider can stream responses.

supportsTools.description: True when the provider can call tools.

supportsStructuredOutput.description: True when the provider supports structured JSON output; true also when this is not known.

supportsVision.description: True when the provider accepts images; true also when this is not known.

supportsBackgroundResponses.description: True when the provider supports background responses.

WorkflowProviderOption.description: A chat provider profile that LLM call components and nodes can use, returned by `GET /api/workflows/provider-options`. It contains no credentials.

WorkflowResumeAvailability.description: Whether a run can resume from a checkpoint, as a JSON integer: 0 NotSupported, 1 BlockedByPolicy, 2 Available.

WorkflowRouteKind.description: How an edge route decides whether it is taken, as a JSON integer: 0 Always (unconditional), 1 Predicate (taken when its JSON path condition holds), 2 SwitchCase (one case of a switch; taken when the value at the JSON path equals the expected value), 3 SwitchDefault (the switch branch taken when no case matches; at most one per source node), 4 FanOutSelector (selects fan-out targets by condition). Switch routes cannot be mixed with other routes leaving the same node.

WorkflowRouteOperator.description: Comparison of a route condition, as a JSON integer: 0 Exists, 1 DoesNotExist, 2 Equals, 3 NotEquals, 4 Contains (substring of a string or element of an array), 5 StartsWith, 6 EndsWith (strings only), 7 GreaterThan, 8 GreaterThanOrEqual, 9 LessThan, 10 LessThanOrEqual (numbers only), 11 IsTruthy, 12 IsFalsy. All except Exists, DoesNotExist, IsTruthy and IsFalsy need an expected value.

WorkflowRouteValueKind.description: JSON type the expected value of a route condition must have, as a JSON integer: 0 String, 1 Number, 2 Boolean, 3 Null, 4 Json (any JSON value).

run.description: The stored run record, not the safe projection of the run read routes: it includes the backend run identifier and the launch origin.

duration.description: Time from the run's creation to its end, as a string in the form `[-][d.]hh:mm:ss[.fffffff]`, for example `00:02:15.5000000`. For a run that has not ended it is measured up to `asOfUtc`. Null when an ended run has no end time recorded.

isDurationFinal.description: True when the run has an end time, so `duration` will not change; false while it is measured up to the snapshot time or unavailable.

usage.description: Model usage recorded for this run; all zero when none was recorded.

WorkflowRunAnalyticsRow.description: Analytics entry for one matching run: the stored run record, its duration and its model usage.

runId.description: Identifier of the run; use it with the `/api/workflows/runs/{runId}` operations.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow that runs.

versionId.description: Identifier of the exact definition version that runs; read it with `GET /api/workflows/definitions/{workflowId}/versions/{versionId}`.

state.description: Run state, as a JSON integer: 0 NotStarted, 1 Running, 2 WaitingForInput (an external request must be answered), 3 Idle, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 Cancelled. Completed, Failed and Cancelled are final.

backend.description: Runtime backend that executes the run, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions.

summary.description: Short human-readable status of the run, for example why it failed; redacted and at most 4,096 characters.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the run was created, as an instant with offset.

updatedAtUtc.description: Time the run record last changed.

terminalAtUtc.description: Time the run reached a final state; null while it has not.

WorkflowRunApiResponse.description: Safe projection of a workflow run: one execution of one workflow version. Returned by the run reads and lists and inside start and detail responses. It deliberately omits the backend run identifier and the run's launch origin (caller, authority and source details).

WorkflowRunCancellationOutcome.description: Outcome of a cancellation request, as a JSON integer: 0 CancellationRequested (the run was cancelled or signalled to stop), 1 AlreadyTerminal (the run had already finished), 2 NotFound (no such run), 3 NotActive (the run is not executing in this host, or its pending request is being answered), 4 BackendNotCancellable (the run's backend cannot cancel), 5 TransitionRejected (the waiting run could not be cancelled consistently).

outcome.description: What happened, as a JSON integer: 0 CancellationRequested, 1 AlreadyTerminal, 2 NotFound, 3 NotActive, 4 BackendNotCancellable, 5 TransitionRejected. Only 0 means the request took effect.

oneOf.description: The stored run record as known when the outcome was decided, including the backend run identifier and the launch origin; null when the run was not found. After a signal it can still show the earlier state.

message.description: Readable explanation of the outcome for display and logs; do not parse it.

WorkflowRunCancellationResult.description: Result of `POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/cancel`, returned with every status code of that operation.

run.description: State of the run, as `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}` returns it.

events.description: Every recorded event of the run, oldest first.

artifacts.description: Metadata of every artifact of the run, oldest first.

pendingExternalRequests.description: The run's external requests without a recorded response; answer those whose `state` is Pending.

checkpoints.description: Metadata of every checkpoint of the run, in creation order.

WorkflowRunDetailApiResponse.description: A workflow run with everything recorded for it, as returned by `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/detail`. All parts are safe projections, read one after another.

WorkflowRunId.description: Identifier of a workflow run, one execution of one workflow version, written as a GUID string. The workflow run operations return it as `runId`; Project Structure workflow nodes report the run they started. It is not an agent execution run or process run identifier. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member; send the plain string.

runId.description: Identifier of the run.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow that runs.

versionId.description: Identifier of the definition version that runs.

state.description: Run state, as a JSON integer: 0 NotStarted, 1 Running, 2 WaitingForInput, 3 Idle, 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 Cancelled.

backend.description: Runtime backend of the run, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions.

backendRunId.description: Identifier of the run inside its backend; internal and not stable across backends.

summary.description: Short status text of the run, not bounded or redacted in this record.

createdAtUtc.description: Time the run was created, as an instant with offset.

updatedAtUtc.description: Time the run record last changed.

terminalAtUtc.description: Time the run reached a final state; null while it has not.

oneOf.description: Who or what launched the run, with the authority captured for it. Internal launch lineage, not a stable client contract; null for runs recorded without an origin.

WorkflowRunSnapshot.description: Stored record of a workflow run, returned without the public safe projection only by the test-run, cancellation and analytics operations. Unlike the safe run projection it includes the backend run identifier and the launch origin; the other run operations return the projection instead.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow to run, as returned in `id` by `GET /api/workflows/definitions`. Required by `POST /api/workflows/runs/start`; optional on the route that names the workflow, where it must equal the route value when present.

versionId.description: Exact version to run, as returned in `versionId`. It must be an Active version. Omit it, or send null, to run the latest Active version of the workflow.

inputJson.description: Run input as a JSON string that contains a JSON object (not a nested JSON object), for example `"{\"customerEmail\":\"client@example.com\"}"`. Omitted, null or blank means `{}`. Anything that is not a JSON object is rejected with HTTP 400. Its members are the input the definition's `inputParameters` describe; member order does not matter for idempotency.

oneOf.description: Runtime backend to run on, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions. Omitted or null uses the definition's `runtimePolicy.preferredBackend`. The backend must be registered and runnable in this host; by default only InProcess is (see `GET /api/workflows/runtime-backends`).

WorkflowRunStartApiRequest.description: Body of the production start operations `POST /api/workflows/runs/start` and `POST /api/workflows/definitions/{workflowId}/runs/start`. Every member is optional in JSON, but the body itself is required. Members other than the four listed are rejected before the operation runs.

run.description: The run. In a replay it shows the state recorded when the original start returned; read the run again for its current state.

events.description: Recorded events of the run, oldest first; empty when `detailsComplete` is false.

artifacts.description: Artifact metadata of the run; empty when `detailsComplete` is false.

pendingExternalRequests.description: External requests the run waits for when it stopped in state WaitingForInput; empty when there are none or when `detailsComplete` is false.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoint metadata of the run; empty when `detailsComplete` is false.

idempotencyDisposition.description: How the request's `Idempotency-Key` was applied, as a JSON integer: 0 NotRequested (no key was sent; a new run was started), 1 EnforcedNewRun (the key was recorded with a new run), 2 ReplayedExistingRun (the key was known and its original run is returned; nothing new was started).

created.description: True when this request started the run; false for a replay.

replayed.description: True when the run was started by an earlier request with the same key.

detailsComplete.description: False when the run was admitted but its details could not be read for this response; the lists are then empty. Read `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/detail` to get them. True otherwise.

observation.description: How reliably the server observed the start, as a JSON integer: 0 Confirmed (the run was admitted and its admission recorded normally), 1 RecoveredAfterObserverFailure (the start reported an error after the run had been admitted, for example because the run failed; the response was rebuilt from the stored run), 2 AdmissionReceiptPending (the run was admitted but the idempotency record could not be completed yet; a repeated request with the same key waits for it or takes it over).

WorkflowRunStartApiResponse.description: Result of a production start: the run after it stopped, with its events, artifacts, open external requests and checkpoints, plus how the `Idempotency-Key` was applied. All run parts are safe projections.

WorkflowRunState.description: State of a workflow run, as a JSON integer: 0 NotStarted, 1 Running, 2 WaitingForInput (an external request must be answered before the run continues), 3 Idle (the runtime reported the run idle without a final state), 4 Completed, 5 Failed, 6 Cancelled. Completed, Failed and Cancelled are final.

WorkflowRuntimeBackendAvailabilityKind.description: Availability of a runtime backend in this host, as a JSON integer: 0 Registered (can run workflows), 1 Planned (known but not registered in this host), 2 Unavailable.

kind.description: Backend, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions.

isDurable.description: True when runs on this backend survive a host restart.

supportsStreaming.description: True when the backend can report progress while a run executes.

supportsExternalRequests.description: True when runs on this backend can wait for external requests.

supportsDashboardObservability.description: True when the backend offers its own monitoring dashboard.

operationalNotes.description: Guidance on when to use the backend.

supportsExternalResponseResume.description: Whether the catalog declares that runs can resume after an external response. The catalog entries of this host report false, even for the in-process backend whose waiting runs do resume; do not rely on it.

supportsActiveCancellation.description: Whether the catalog declares support for cancelling an executing run. The catalog entries of this host report false, even for the in-process backend whose runs can be cancelled; do not rely on it.

availability.description: Availability in this host, as a JSON integer: 0 Registered, 1 Planned, 2 Unavailable.

isRegistered.description: True when the backend is registered in this host.

isRunnable.description: True when workflows can run on the backend in this host.

WorkflowRuntimeBackendDescriptor.description: A workflow runtime backend known to this host, with its capabilities and whether it can run workflows here. Returned by `GET /api/workflows/runtime-backends`.

WorkflowRuntimeBackendKind.description: Workflow runtime backend, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess (runs inside this host; not durable), 1 DurableTask (durable backend), 2 AzureFunctions (durable Azure Functions hosting). Only backends reported as registered and runnable by `GET /api/workflows/runtime-backends` can run workflows; by default that is InProcess only.

preferredBackend.description: Backend used when a start request names none, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions. It must be registered and runnable in this host; by default only InProcess is.

allowInProcessPreviewRuns.description: True to allow preview (test) runs on the in-process backend; when false, test runs on InProcess are rejected.

requireDurableProductionRuns.description: True to reject production runs on a non-durable backend. It cannot be combined with InProcess as the preferred backend.

exposeAzureFunctionsStatusEndpoint.description: Request for an Azure Functions status endpoint; true is accepted only when an Azure Functions backend is runnable, which none is by default.

exposeAzureFunctionsMcpTool.description: Request for a Model Context Protocol tool on an Azure Functions backend; true is accepted only when an Azure Functions backend is runnable, which none is by default.

WorkflowRuntimePolicy.description: Runtime policy of a workflow definition, or the recorded default policy of the workflow settings: which backend runs it and which kinds of runs are allowed.

value.description: The scheduler fire identifier, a GUID string.

WorkflowSchedulerFireId.description: Identifier of the scheduler firing that launched a workflow run, as an object whose `value` member holds the GUID.

defaultRuntimePolicy.description: Default runtime policy recorded for the host and shown by the workflow workspace; its preferred backend must be runnable. Definitions and runs use their own `runtimePolicy`, not this value.

artifactPolicy.description: Payload and artifact capture policy for all runs.

oneOf.description: Agent voice settings (speech-to-text and text-to-speech), stored exactly as sent; `normalizedVoiceSettings` shows the values in effect. Null or omitted stores none, which means the defaults: voice input and output disabled.

normalizedVoiceSettings.description: The voice settings with defaults applied to missing or blank values; this is what agent voice mode uses. Computed; it is ignored when sent.

WorkflowSettings.description: The workflow settings document of this host, read with `GET /api/workflows/settings` and replaced as a whole with `POST /api/workflows/settings`.

WorkflowStableIdentityKind.description: Kind of stable workflow identity, written as the string token `Template` (the template key a workflow was installed from) or `External` (an external namespace and key assigned by a client).

identityKind.description: Which identity was resolved, as a string token: `Template` or `External`.

namespace.description: Normalized (lower-case) namespace that was resolved; empty for template keys.

key.description: Normalized (lower-case) template key or external key that was resolved.

status.description: Outcome, as a string token: `Resolved`, `NotFound`, `Ambiguous` or `Stale`.

oneOf.description: The matching workflow for `Resolved` and `Stale`; null for `NotFound` and `Ambiguous`.
Version a latest-Active start would run; only for `Resolved`, null otherwise.

materializations.description: Catalog entries of every matching workflow, ordered by workflow identifier; empty for `NotFound`.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the outcome.

WorkflowStableIdentityResolution.description: Result of resolving a stable workflow identity (a template key or an external namespace and key) to a workflow and the version that a latest-Active start would run. Every outcome is returned with HTTP 200; check `status`.

WorkflowStableIdentityResolutionStatus.description: Outcome of a stable-identity resolution, written as a string token: `Resolved` (exactly one workflow matches and it has a runnable Active version), `NotFound` (no workflow matches), `Ambiguous` (several workflows match; none is selected) or `Stale` (one workflow matches but it has no runnable Active version).

intentId.description: Identifier of the start intent that admitted the run.

runId.description: Identifier of the admitted workflow run.

sequence.description: Admission sequence number within the node.

nativeNodeId.description: Identifier of the node record in Project Structure.

bindingFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the output binding; internal.

outputParent.description: Project Structure node under which outputs are created.

outputRole.description: Role of the outputs, as a JSON integer: 0 RequiredResult.

authority.description: Output authority captured for the run; an opaque internal object.

oneOf.description: Holder of the Project Structure lease used at admission; null when none was used.

WorkflowStructureAdmissionBinding.description: Admission that binds a workflow run started from a Project Structure node to the project outputs it may create. Internal lineage recorded in the launch origin.

WorkflowStructureAuthority.description: Project Structure output authority captured when a workflow run was launched: the actor, database profile, project scope and output permissions the run may use. It is written as an opaque, versioned JSON object whose members are internal; clients must not rely on them.

agentId.description: Identifier of the lease holder.

agentName.description: Display name of the lease holder.

machineName.description: Machine the lease holder ran on.

repositoryRoot.description: Repository root recorded by the lease holder; may be empty.

branchName.description: Branch recorded by the lease holder; may be empty.

WorkflowStructureLeaseOwner.description: Holder of a Project Structure lease recorded with a workflow admission.

WorkflowStructureOutputRole.description: Role of Project Structure outputs bound to a workflow run, as a JSON integer: 0 RequiredResult.

oneOf.description: Workflow of a stored version to test; used with `versionId`.
Exact stored version to test; used with `workflowId`. It need not be Active, but the workflow's current version must be Draft or Active.
Unsaved definition to test; its `status` must be Draft (0) to be run. Null tests the stored version.

inputJson.description: Run input as JSON text in a string, containing a JSON object; empty means `{}`. Ignored when `validateOnly` is true.

oneOf.description: Backend to run on, as a JSON integer: 0 InProcess, 1 DurableTask, 2 AzureFunctions; null uses the definition's preferred backend.

validateOnly.description: True to validate only; no run is created.

previewSimulationPlan.description: Nodes whose execution the preview run replaces with an output template; omitted or empty simulates nothing.

WorkflowTestRunRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/workflows/test-runs`: what to test and how. Identify the definition either with `draftDefinition` or with both `workflowId` and `versionId`; the draft wins when both are sent.

succeeded.description: True when validation passed (validate-only) or the preview run ended Completed, WaitingForInput or Idle.

validation.description: Validation issues of the definition, or the reason a launch was rejected reported as a single issue; empty when a run was admitted.

oneOf.description: The preview run; null when no run was created.

events.description: Recorded events of the run, oldest first; empty without a run.

artifacts.description: Artifacts of the run; empty without a run.

pendingExternalRequests.description: External requests of the run without a recorded response.

errorMessage.description: Why the test did not succeed; empty on success.

checkpoints.description: Checkpoints of the run; empty without a run.

detailsComplete.description: False when the run was admitted but its events, artifacts and requests could not be read; read the run instead.

observation.description: How reliably the start was observed, as a JSON integer: 0 Confirmed, 1 RecoveredAfterObserverFailure (an error was reported after the run had been admitted; the result was rebuilt from the stored run), 2 AdmissionReceiptPending.

WorkflowTestRunResult.description: Result of `POST /api/workflows/test-runs`, returned with HTTP 200 when `succeeded` is true and HTTP 400 otherwise. The run records are the stored records without the public safe projection.

observationCount.description: Number of usage observations added up.

usageKnownObservationCount.description: Observations whose token counts the provider reported or the host estimated.

usageUnknownObservationCount.description: Observations without token counts (usage unavailable, or missing after provider activity). Their tokens count as zero in the sums.

pricingKnownObservationCount.description: Observations with a known cost, reported by the provider or calculated from the provider profile's model prices.

pricingUnknownObservationCount.description: Observations without a known cost. When it is above zero, `knownCostUsd` understates the real cost.

cachedInputTokens.description: Sum of the input tokens served from the provider's cache; part of the input.

reasoningTokens.description: Sum of reasoning tokens as reported by the provider.

totalTokens.description: Sum of total tokens as reported or estimated for each observation.

toolCallCount.description: Sum of tool calls made by the model.

knownCostUsd.description: Sum of the known costs in US dollars, rounded to 6 decimal places. Observations without a known cost add nothing.

WorkflowUsageAnalyticsTotals.description: Model usage added up over a set of usage observations. An observation is the usage recorded for one model call attempt of a workflow node; the set is all matching runs, one run, one provider and model, or one node, depending on where the totals appear.

code.description: Stable issue code, as a JSON integer: 0 MissingName, 1 MissingStartNode, 2 MissingEndNode, 3 EmptyGraph, 4 DuplicateNodeId, 5 DuplicateEdgeId, 6 DisconnectedNode, 7 UnknownEdgeEndpoint, 8 InvalidComponentReference, 9 InvalidExecutorReference, 10 InvalidExecutorSettings, 11 InvalidExecutionPolicy, 12 InvalidProviderModel, 13 InvalidWorkflowSettings, 14 InvalidRouteDefinition, 15 UnsupportedRuntimeBackend, 16 UnsupportedModality, 17 UnsupportedNodeKind, 18 ShapeMismatch.

message.description: Human-readable explanation; its wording can change.

nodeId.description: Node the issue concerns; null when it is not about one node.

edgeId.description: Edge the issue concerns; null when it is not about one edge.

WorkflowValidationIssue.description: One problem found by workflow validation.

WorkflowValidationIssueCode.description: Stable code of a workflow validation issue, as a JSON integer: 0 MissingName, 1 MissingStartNode, 2 MissingEndNode, 3 EmptyGraph, 4 DuplicateNodeId, 5 DuplicateEdgeId, 6 DisconnectedNode (not reachable from the start node), 7 UnknownEdgeEndpoint, 8 InvalidComponentReference, 9 InvalidExecutorReference, 10 InvalidExecutorSettings, 11 InvalidExecutionPolicy, 12 InvalidProviderModel, 13 InvalidWorkflowSettings, 14 InvalidRouteDefinition, 15 UnsupportedRuntimeBackend, 16 UnsupportedModality, 17 UnsupportedNodeKind, 18 ShapeMismatch. The start operations report the member name in error codes such as `workflows.validation.MissingStartNode`.

issues.description: Every problem found; empty when the definition is valid.

succeeded.description: True when `issues` is empty. Computed; it is ignored when sent.

WorkflowValidationResult.description: Result of validating a workflow definition against the current components, executors, providers, runtime backends and workflow settings. A definition must be valid to be saved, published or started.

kind.description: Kind of value, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 Json, 2 Object, 3 Boolean, 4 Number, 5 FileReference, 6 ArtifactReference. An input of kind Object accepts any output kind; other kinds must match.

schemaJson.description: Optional JSON Schema of the value, as a JSON string (for example `"{\"type\":\"object\"}"`); empty when the shape has no schema. The result shape of a HumanInput node becomes the response schema of its external requests.

description.description: Human-readable description of the value, for example `Plain text`.

WorkflowValueShape.description: Shape of a value that a node, component or executor consumes or produces. Validation compares the output shape of an edge's source with the input shape of its target.

WorkflowValueShapeKind.description: Kind of value a node consumes or produces, as a JSON integer: 0 Text, 1 Json, 2 Object, 3 Boolean, 4 Number, 5 FileReference, 6 ArtifactReference. An edge must connect an output to an input of the same kind, unless the input kind is Object, which accepts any kind.

WorkflowVersionId.description: Identifier of one stored version of a workflow definition, written as a GUID string. Every save, import and status change of a workflow stores a new version with a new identifier; a run records the exact version it executes. It must not be the empty GUID. Readers also accept an object with a `value` member that holds the GUID; send the plain string.

WorkforceAvailabilityState.description: Availability of a party for new work on the current UTC date, as a JSON integer: 0 Bench (at most 10 percent allocated and less than 25 percent blocked), 1 NearAvailable (a current allocation or a capacity block ends within 30 days), 2 Allocated (any other committed state), 3 Overallocated (allocated plus blocked above 100 percent). Overallocated is checked first, then Bench, then NearAvailable.

capacityHoursPerWeek.description: Weekly capacity in hours from the workforce profile; 40 when there is no profile or it has 0 or less.

activeAllocationPercent.description: Sum of the allocation percentages of the party's active allocations in current project lifetimes; can exceed 100.

activeBlockedPercent.description: Sum of the percentages of the party's active capacity blocks.

availablePercent.description: 100 minus the allocated and blocked percentages, never below 0.

availabilityState.description: Availability classification, as a JSON integer: 0 Bench, 1 NearAvailable, 2 Allocated, 3 Overallocated.

availabilityMessage.description: English sentence describing the availability, for display; its wording can change.

nextAvailabilityOn.description: Earliest end date, today or later, of a current-lifetime allocation or of a capacity block; null when there is none.

WorkforceCapacitySummaryModel.description: Capacity figures of a party for the current UTC date, calculated from its active capacity blocks and from its active allocations bound to current project lifetimes.

WorkforceKind.description: Work classification of a workforce profile, as a JSON integer: 0 Employee, 1 Contractor, 2 Freelancer, 3 DeliveryUnit (an organization or organization unit that delivers work). People can use the first three; organizations and organization units must use DeliveryUnit. Saving a profile gives the party the role of the same name when it is missing.

id.description: Identifier of the workforce profile; null when the party has no saved profile. It is not the party identifier, and the profile save finds the profile by `partyId` instead.

partyId.description: Identifier of the party the profile belongs to.

workforceKind.description: Work classification, as a JSON integer: 0 Employee, 1 Contractor, 2 Freelancer, 3 DeliveryUnit. Without a saved profile: DeliveryUnit for organizations and organization units, Contractor or Freelancer when the party has that role, otherwise Employee.

employeeCode.description: Personnel number or similar code from an HR system; empty when not set.

jobTitle.description: Job title; empty when not set.

discipline.description: Professional discipline as free text; empty when not set.

seniority.description: Seniority level as free text; empty when not set.

homeUnitPartyId.description: Identifier of the organization or organization unit the party belongs to; null when none. Its name is `homeUnitName` of the workspace.

managerPartyId.description: Identifier of the person who manages the party; null when none. Its name is `managerName` of the workspace.

startDate.description: Date the work relationship starts (`yyyy-MM-dd`); null when not set.

endDate.description: Date the work relationship ends (`yyyy-MM-dd`); null when open-ended.

location.description: Work location as free text; empty when not set.

timeZone.description: Time zone as free text; empty when not set.

internalCostRate.description: Internal cost of one `rateUnit` of the party's work in `rateCurrencyCode`; null when unknown. A rate, not a total.

externalBillingRate.description: Price billed to customers for one `rateUnit` of the party's work in `rateCurrencyCode`; null when unknown.

rateUnit.description: Time unit of both rates, as a JSON integer: 0 Hour, 1 ManDay.

rateCurrencyCode.description: Three-letter currency code of both rates, for example `EUR`; `USD` when not set.

capacityHoursPerWeek.description: Weekly working capacity in hours; 40 when not set.

status.description: Employment status as free text. Without a saved profile: `Active` or `Inactive` when the party has that lifecycle status, otherwise `Planned`.

notes.description: Free-text notes; empty when not set.

lastChangedBy.description: Actor that last changed the party record, which is not necessarily a change of the profile, for example `crm-hr-api`. The profile save request does not carry it.

WorkforceProfileEditorModel.description: The workforce profile of a party as returned in the workforce workspace. The profile save request (`POST /api/crm-hr/workforce/profiles`) has the same fields except `id` and `lastChangedBy`. When no profile was saved yet, the fields hold defaults and `id` is null.

partyId.description: Identifier of the party whose profile is saved, as returned by `GET /api/crm-hr/workforce` or `GET /api/crm-hr/parties`; required. Not a workforce profile identifier.

workforceKind.description: Work classification, as a JSON integer: 0 Employee, 1 Contractor, 2 Freelancer, 3 DeliveryUnit. People use the first three; organizations and organization units must use DeliveryUnit. Omitted means Employee (0). The save adds the matching party role when it is missing.

employeeCode.description: Personnel number or similar code from an HR system; trimmed, not checked for uniqueness. Omitted means empty.

jobTitle.description: Job title; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

discipline.description: Professional discipline as free text, for example `Engineering`; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

seniority.description: Seniority level as free text, for example `Senior`; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

homeUnitPartyId.description: Identifier of the organization or organization unit the party belongs to; it must be an existing organization or organization unit other than the party itself. Null or omitted means none.

managerPartyId.description: Identifier of the person who manages the party; it must be another existing person. Null or omitted means none. It is separate from the manager support assignment of recruiting.

startDate.description: Date the work relationship starts, without time (`yyyy-MM-dd`). Null or omitted means not set.

endDate.description: Date the work relationship ends (`yyyy-MM-dd`); not checked against the start. Null or omitted means open-ended.

location.description: Work location as free text; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

timeZone.description: Time zone as free text, for example `Europe/Prague`; trimmed, not validated. Omitted means empty.

internalCostRate.description: Internal cost of one `rateUnit` of the party's work in `rateCurrencyCode`, for example the cost of one hour; not negative. It is a rate, not a task or project total. Null or omitted means unknown.

externalBillingRate.description: Price billed to customers for one `rateUnit` of the party's work in `rateCurrencyCode`; not negative and separate from the internal cost. Null or omitted means unknown.

rateUnit.description: Time unit that both rates refer to, as a JSON integer: 0 Hour, 1 ManDay. Omitted means Hour (0).

rateCurrencyCode.description: Currency of both rates as three letters, for example `EUR`; trimmed and upper-cased. A format check only: any three letters A to Z are accepted. Blank or omitted means `USD`.

capacityHoursPerWeek.description: Weekly working capacity in hours; 0 or less is saved as 40. Omitted means 40.

status.description: Employment status as free text, for example `Planned`, `Active` or `Inactive`; trimmed. Omitted means `Planned`.

notes.description: Free-text notes; trimmed. Omitted means empty.

WorkforceProfileSaveApiRequest.description: Request of `POST /api/crm-hr/workforce/profiles`: every field of a party's workforce profile. The profile is found by `partyId` and all of its fields are overwritten; an omitted member takes the default stated on it, so send every field you want to keep. Start from `profile` of `GET /api/crm-hr/workforce/{partyId}`.

displayName.description: Name shown for the party.

summary.description: Short description of the party; returned also for sensitive parties.

partyType.description: Kind of party, as a JSON integer: 0 Person, 1 Organization, 2 OrganizationUnit (AI agent parties have no workforce workspace).

lifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the party, as a JSON integer: 0 Draft, 1 Active, 2 Inactive, 3 Archived, 4 Former, 5 Candidate, 6 Prospect.

isSensitive.description: True when the party is marked for restricted handling; `primaryEmail` and `primaryPhone` are then empty.

lastChangedBy.description: Actor that last changed the party record, for example `crm-hr-api`.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the party record last changed, in UTC; saving the workforce profile updates it.

roles.description: Business roles of the party, one entry per role assignment ordered by role, each as a JSON integer: 0 Customer, 1 CustomerContact, 2 Partner, 3 Vendor, 4 Employee, 5 Contractor, 6 Freelancer, 7 DeliveryUnit, 8 Candidate, 9 AiSteward, 10 AccountManager, 11 Recruiter, 12 Stakeholder.

primaryEmail.description: The party's primary public email address, or another public one when none is primary; empty when there is none or the party is sensitive.

primaryPhone.description: The party's primary public phone number, or another public one when none is primary; empty when there is none or the party is sensitive.

homeUnitName.description: Display name of the profile's home unit; empty when none.

managerName.description: Display name of the profile's manager; empty when none.

profile.description: The workforce profile, or default values with a null `id` when none was saved.

skillCatalog.description: The whole skill catalog, active skills first, then by category and name.

skills.description: The party's skills, ordered by skill category and name.

capacityBlocks.description: The party's capacity blocks, past, current and future, ordered by start date and kind.

projectAllocations.description: The party's project allocations, active ones first, then by start date and project name. Past allocations and allocations of earlier project lifetimes are included.

capacitySummary.description: Capacity figures for the current UTC date.

WorkforceWorkspaceModel.description: The workforce view of one party returned by `GET /api/crm-hr/workforce/{partyId}`: party summary, workforce profile, skill catalog and party skills, capacity blocks, project allocations and a capacity summary for the current UTC date. It contains personal and HR data.

kind.description: Kind of scope, as a JSON integer: 0 Sandbox, 1 Process, 2 Project, 3 Tenant, 4 Organization.

key.description: Scope key, lower-cased, with every character other than a letter or digit turned into a hyphen and repeated or outer hyphens removed; for example a project identifier. Empty only for the default sandbox; the other kinds require a key.

isDefaultSandbox.description: Computed: true for kind 0 Sandbox with an empty key.

displayName.description: Computed label: the lower-case kind and the key separated by a slash, for example `project/alpha`, or `sandbox/default` for the default sandbox.

partitionRelativePath.description: Computed: `scopes/{kind}/{key}`, the scope's partition below each managed root; empty for the default sandbox.

dataRootRelativePath.description: Computed: `data` followed by the partition path, or `data` alone for the default sandbox.

artifactRootRelativePath.description: Computed: `artifacts` followed by the partition path, or `artifacts` alone for the default sandbox.

integrationMapRootRelativePath.description: Computed: `integration-map` followed by the partition path, or `integration-map` alone for the default sandbox.

outputRootRelativePath.description: Computed: `output` followed by the partition path, or `output` alone for the default sandbox.

managedRootRelativePaths.description: Computed: the data, artifacts, integration-map and output root paths, in that order.

WorkspaceScopeDescriptor.description: Workspace scope: the partition of workspace data that work runs in, identified by `kind` and `key`. The other members are relative workspace paths and labels derived from those two; they are computed by the server and ignored when sent.

WorkspaceScopeKind.description: Kind of workspace scope, as a JSON integer: 0 Sandbox, 1 Process, 2 Project, 3 Tenant, 4 Organization.
